izzyondroid:dev.uint.qrserv.name: QRServ
izzyondroid:dev.uint.qrserv.summary: Transfer files with ease over a network.
izzyondroid:dev.uint.qrserv.description:
QRServ takes any selected files on your device and makes them available through its own HTTP server at an unused port number. The selected files can then be downloaded via web browser on another device and/or software that allows file downloads over HTTP from QR codes. Devices involved would need to be on the same network (i.e. access point, tethering [no mobile data required], VPN [with a supported configuration]).
 Features:
 QR Code -- Tap to show the URL in a tooltip -- Press and hold to copy the URL to the clipboard
 Share sheet -- Share the download URL via the system share sheet -- Import files via the system share sheet from other apps -- Sharing text with the app creates a text file to share
 Shows live import progress, whether for a single file or multiple
 Multi-file selection -- Bundled into a ZIP archive -- Press and hold the archive's filename to see the originally selected files in a tooltip
 Direct Access Mode -- serves the file directly from storage instead of copying it into app cache first, ideal for large files -- Single file selection only -- Always available on the GitHub release; Play Store builds only support it on Android 10 or earlier (due to Manage External Storage restrictions) -- Toggle-able in settings
 Detects if the selected file is removed while being served, or modified (Direct Access Mode only)
 Show or hide the filename in the download URL
 Notifies when a client requests or finishes downloading the file, including their IP address
 Resumes interrupted downloads in supported software
 Choose which network interface's IP address to serve from -- the server only listens there unless set to listen on all interfaces
 Switches to another IP address if the selected one disappears, and suggests better ones as they appear
 Private hotspot (Android 13 or later) -- shares over a Wi-Fi network the app creates, reachable only by devices you let join -- Scan a Wi-Fi QR code to join, or enter the network name and password by hand -- Switch an ongoing share to or from the private hotspot without selecting the file again -- Chooses 5 GHz for faster transfers on Android 16 or later (not all devices support 5 GHz or choosing the band)
 Launcher shortcuts for quick sharing
 Keeps sharing while the app is in the background, with a notification to stop sharing
 Stops sharing when idle (10 minutes by default, adjustable)
 HTTP server binds to a random free port by default, or a user-configured one
 In-app theme selection
 Check for updates in settings (GitHub version)
 Supports various languages: English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, Turkish, Persian, Hebrew
 Permission usage:
 INTERNET -- Listing network interfaces, running the HTTP server and checking for updates (GitHub version)
 ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK -- Letting other devices connect to the HTTP server (Android 17+)
 READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE -- Read-only Direct Access Mode on internal storage (up to Android 10)
 FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE -- Importing and sharing in the background
 POST_NOTIFICATIONS -- The sharing notification, and idle stop and failed import notices
 WAKE_LOCK -- Keeping the device awake during imports and downloads
 CHANGE_WIFI_STATE -- Private hotspot (Android 13+), background sharing (Android 14+)
 NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES -- Private hotspot (Android 13+); never used for location
 ACCESS_WIFI_STATE -- Checking hotspot capabilities (Android 13+)
 ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE -- Keeping the IP address list and QR code current
 MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE -- Read-only Direct Access Mode on internal storage (Android 11+, not on Google Play)
 QRServ is open source. https://github.com/uintdev/qrserv

fdroid:com.bithack.principia.name: Principia
fdroid:com.bithack.principia.description:
Principia is a physics-based sandbox building game. Build and play advanced contraptions, circuiting, minigames, robot adventures and more.
The sandbox contains 200+ different objects ranging from basic wooden building blocks to circuitry, electrical and mechanical components, small robots you can control and fight against, and a LuaScript object featuring Lua scripting that can interact with the world. Build a controllable car, a calculator or make your own game with circuitry or in Lua.
The Principia community site contains tens of thousands of creative levels made by players like you, from impressive contraptions to amusing games all for you to browse through and play. If something really peaks your interest, open the level in the sandbox to see how it ticks. What will you create in the sandbox?
Principia started out as a paid proprietary game developed during 2013-2014 before being abandoned due to financial issues. Now the game is an open source project since 2022 developed by the same community who fell in love with it back in the day, free for anyone to play well into the future.
In addition to being available on Android, Principia is also available on Linux, Windows as well as experimental ports to other platforms.
(By default Principia makes connections to the main community site at principia-web.se. You can change or disable this by creating a file called community_host.txt in the app's scoped storage containing a domain name. If you have the main community site disabled you can still play levels by going via your web browser.)

fdroid:com.bwt.threadscooponionchatcom.name: ThreatScoopOnionChat
fdroid:com.bwt.threadscooponionchatcom.summary: A Forked Version focused on privacy from SESSION
fdroid:com.bwt.threadscooponionchatcom.description:
# ThreadScoopOnionChat
This version is a fork from " https://github.com/session-foundation/session-android ", enfocado en la privacidad.
## How Did ThreadScoopOnionChat Come About?
I have always been a fan of privacy and security in communications, and I am constantly researching potential security breaches in messaging applications.
ThreadScoopOnionChat emerged after the analysis of this blog "https://soatok.blog/2025/01/14/dont-use-session-signal-fork/", in which several aspects are described as to why using Session is not recommended, and I wondered how it is possible that a foundation focused on privacy—with the grants and support it receives—has not been able to improve this protocol.
I still do not understand the answer, since my resources are much smaller than those of a foundation compared to that of a person who is simply a fan of privacy and security.
In this blog, certain problems were described:
1> "https://soatok.blog/2025/01/14/dont-use-session-signal-fork/#insufficient-entropy-ed25519"
2> "https://soatok.blog/2025/01/14/dont-use-session-signal-fork/#in-band-negotiation"
3> "https://soatok.blog/2025/01/14/dont-use-session-signal-fork/#public-keys-aes-gcm"
This is a forked version privacy focussed from Session.
Go Github to check all features implemented.

fdroid:com.domivega.gps_car.name: GPS Car Tracking
fdroid:com.domivega.gps_car.summary: GPS tracks with live OBD-II metrics; offline queue to your own server
fdroid:com.domivega.gps_car.description:
GPS Car Tracking records GPS tracks enriched with live OBD-II metrics from an ELM327 adapter (Bluetooth LE GATT or Classic SPP), queues samples on the device, and uploads them in batches to a backend you control.
 Features 
 Foreground tracking with platform location (system fused on Android 12+, GPS on older devices)
 Native OBD over BLE or Classic Bluetooth — no proprietary Google Play location libraries
 ECU-aware sessions: tracking can follow adapter connectivity
 Durable offline queue (Room) with batch upload and retry
 Fuel and vehicle settings for estimated consumption from OBD signals
 Dashboard gauges, settings (including QR provisioning), and OBD debug log
 No ads, no analytics SDKs, no crash-reporting trackers baked in
 Backend (you choose) 
 Prefer self-hosting the free/open companion platform: my-car-tracking-platform 
 Or use any wire-compatible HTTP API (/start, /stop, /samples) with a device token
 Optional community-hosted instance: mycar.domivega.com (configure URLs and token in Settings; nothing is hard-required at build time)
 Permissions (why) 
 Location (including background while tracking) — write track points
 Bluetooth / nearby devices — talk to the ELM327 dongle
 Notifications & foreground service — keep a trip alive reliably
 Camera (optional) — scan provisioning QR codes from your web console
 Internet — upload queued samples when you configure a server
 Boot completed — re-arm lightweight auto-connect / presence after reboot
 Privacy 
 Samples and credentials stay on your phone until you point the app at a server you trust. Defaults ship empty / placeholder hostnames. BLE addresses and API tokens are stored only in app settings on device.
 License 
 MIT. Source: my-car-tracking-mobile-app 
 Disclaimer 
 OBD fuel rate is estimated unless you extend the stack. Do not interact with the phone while driving.

fdroid:com.emanuelef.remote_capture.name: PCAPdroid
fdroid:com.emanuelef.remote_capture.summary: No-root network monitor, firewall and PCAP dumper for Android
fdroid:com.emanuelef.remote_capture.description:
PCAPdroid is a privacy-friendly open source app which can track, analyze and block the connections made by the other apps on the device.
It can also export a PCAP dump of the traffic, inspect HTTP requests, decrypt TLS traffic and much more.
PCAPdroid simulates a VPN in order to capture the network traffic without root. It does not use a remote VPN server, instead data is processed locally on the device.
 Main features: 
* Log and analyze the connections made by user and system apps
* Get a summary of how much data each app sent and received
* Low battery usage for continuous, all-day capture
* Extract hosts and IP addresses from DNS, TLS and HTTP
* Record the traffic to PCAP files with additional app metadata
* Send traffic via PCAP-over-IP for real-time analysis (e.g. on Wireshark)
* Decrypt the HTTPS/TLS traffic, extract the URLs and save the SSLKEYLOGFILE
* Inspect the HTTP requests/replies and export them to HAR
* Identify the country and ASN of the remote server via offline DB lookups
* On rooted devices, capture the traffic while other VPN apps are running
If you plan to use PCAPdroid to perform packet analysis, check out the specific section of the manual.
Join the international PCAPdroid community on Telegram or on Matrix .

fdroid:dev.serge.textlog.name: textlog
fdroid:dev.serge.textlog.summary: A text-first mobile client for textlog.cc — no algorithm, no metrics, no ads
fdroid:dev.serge.textlog.description:
A community-built client for textlog.cc , a small, text-first place to write short notes and follow the people and hashtags you care about.
The website already works on a phone. This exists because a community deserves a way in that belongs on the device: native scrolling, a live feed of new posts, threads you can follow with your thumb, and posts that render exactly as they do on the web. Nothing more. No algorithm, no metrics, no accounts of its own.
 Reading 
• The hot and latest feeds, plus a live firehose of new posts as they are written
• Nested threads you can fold, with a flat view for when five levels of indent is four too many on a phone
• A whole thread in one request, and threads kept for the session so going back costs nothing
• Feeds join a reply to its parent when both are on the page, so one conversation is one block
• Profiles, hashtag pages, and people and hashtags to explore
• Server-side search, plus a filter for a timeline you already have
 Writing 
• Post, reply, edit and delete; follow, block and report
• Drafts kept on the server, so one started on the website is here too
• Polls you can vote in, and quizzes that tell you whether you got it and why
• #todo checklists you tick from the post itself
 Posts render the way the site renders them 
Inline and fenced code, LaTeX, markdown links, bold, underline, italics, strikethrough, redactions you press to reveal, quoted lines, spoilers, link previews, and ASCII art kept on its own line grid. Optional block markdown — headings, lists, tables — on top, for the structure the site keeps flat.
 Notifications 
Replies, mentions and follows, with a reply field and a mark-read button in the notification itself. textlog has no push endpoint an app can reach, so these come from a background poll: honest, and battery-cheap, but not instant. The setting says so rather than implying a schedule Android does not keep.
 Made to be read 
Light, dark, sepia and dracula themes, a choice of accent colour, three monospace faces and four text sizes. A barebones mode swaps every icon for a character and turns off ripples and animation, for a reader who wants the terminal and not the app.
 No account of its own, and nothing phoning home 
It talks to textlog.cc and nothing else. No analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising identifiers, and no Google Play Services — notifications are raised locally rather than through Firebase.
Signing up stays in a browser on purpose, because that is where the server keeps its abuse controls.
Free software under the GNU AGPL v3, the same licence as textlog itself.

fdroid:eu.domob.heliodos.name: Heliodos
fdroid:eu.domob.heliodos.summary: AR overlay of the sun's and moon's path on your camera
fdroid:eu.domob.heliodos.description:
Heliodos is an augmented reality (AR) app that overlays the sun's and moon's trajectories onto your live camera feed, so you can see exactly where sunlight will fall at any time of year — right through your phone's viewfinder.
Stand in your garden, on a building plot, or any outdoor space, point your camera at the sky, and instantly see the sun's arc for the summer solstice, winter solstice, equinox, and the current date and time, plus the moon's current trajectory — including any obstacles in the sun's path.
 Features 
 AR sun and moon trajectories : The sun's path for the solstices, the equinox, and the current moment — plus the moon's current trajectory — are drawn directly over the live camera image, with hour tick marks and time labels on the current paths.
 Customisable paths : Toggle individual paths on or off and pick custom colours for each in the settings.
 Flexible location : Uses your GPS location automatically, or lets you set any place on Earth manually.
 Custom time : Simulate the sun's position at any time of day, not just right now.
 Camera selection : Pinch to zoom to cycle through available back cameras (wide-angle, normal, telephoto).
 Use cases 
 Gardening : Find out which spots get full sun in summer versus winter before you plant.
 Real estate : Check how much natural light a room or terrace receives throughout the year.
 Architecture & construction : Plan shading, windows, and solar panels with real-world sun data.
 Photography : Scout locations and predict golden-hour angles in advance.
Heliodos requires camera and location permissions to function. No data is collected or transmitted.

fdroid:net.quietflare.cycluna.name: Cycluna
fdroid:net.quietflare.cycluna.summary: Your cycle and the moon, tracked privately on your phone.
fdroid:net.quietflare.cycluna.description:
Cycluna is a calm, private place to follow your cycle — and the moon alongside it.
Everything stays on your phone. There is no account to create, no sign-up, and no cloud. Cycluna has no internet permission at all, so your data cannot be sent anywhere — because there is nowhere for it to go.
 What you can track 
• Period start dates, cycle length and period length
• Mood, with a note when you want one
• Headaches — time, intensity, symptoms and possible triggers
• Journal entries for everything else
 What Cycluna shows you 
• Where you are in your cycle today, and which phase you are in
• Your next period and fertile window, as estimates
• A month calendar of your logged and predicted days
• The moon's phase for every day, from real lunar maths — offline
• Hormone reference curves for a typical cycle, to learn from
• Mood patterns three ways: day by day, across your cycle phases, and through the lunar month
 Honest by design 
Cycluna names a pattern only when there is enough data to support one. Log too little and it says so, rather than inventing an insight. When a period is overdue it says that plainly instead of quietly sliding the prediction forward. And it never suggests the moon affects your body — research has not established that link, so the moon view describes your own entries and nothing more.
 Private by design 
• No account, no email, no identifier of any kind
• No analytics, no trackers, no advertising, no crash reporting
• No internet permission — the app cannot make network requests
• Left out of Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer
• Optional fingerprint or face unlock
• Export everything as a readable file, whenever you like
• Delete everything permanently, from inside the app
Reminders for your period, your fertile window, and a gentle daily check-in are scheduled entirely on your device. No push server is involved.
Cycluna is a wellness and education tool. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose or treat anything, and the fertile window is an estimate that must not be used as contraception. Every date it shows is calculated from the dates you enter — the app measures nothing about your body. Please talk to a healthcare professional about anything that matters to your health.
Made by QuietFlare.

fdroid:org.booncode.bluepass4.name: BluePass
fdroid:org.booncode.bluepass4.summary: BluePass extracts 2FA tokens from SMS and forwards them via Bluetooth
fdroid:org.booncode.bluepass4.description:
Description 
BluePass extracts two factor authentication codes (2FA) from SMS and sends them to a paired device via Bluetooth RFCOMM. A Qt based companion app bluepass-server will receive the 2FA codes and provide them via the system clipboard.
 Use Case 
The company I work for is relying on third party services that require to authenticate using 2FA. The second factor is an SMS to your mobile phone. This app was built for convenience, to avoid having to unlock your phone, find the message and then type the received code on the PC.
It is not about the time saved, it's about getting rid of robot tasks.
 Setup 
You have to configure parameters to match the sender of the SMS and parse the code from the messages sent to you. Currently, regular expressions are used for this task. However, a very basic setup will be provided below.
 Regular expression for sender has to be set to a regular expression that matches all the senders of SMS (as they appear in your chat application). Multiple numbers and names can be provided:
 To match CompanyA , you might simply put CompanyA into the box
 To match CompanyA and 12345678 , write (CompanyA|12345678) 
 Regular expression to filter the content has to be set to a regular expression that matches the messages you want to catch. Additionally, it has to define one group to extract the actual code that has to be sent to the PC.
 To match any number, you can use [^\d]*(\d+).* 
 To match a code only with 6 digits, use: .*(\d{6}).* 
... as the process of defining a proper regular expression is not that easy, there is another text box Test message . You can paste here the content of the SMS thatyou want to match and adjust the regular expression until it gets parsed correctly.
The last step of the configuration is to pair with the bluetooth adapter of your PC and configure the adapter to be used.
 Operation 
 Whenever your mobile phone receives an SMS (and the settings above are configured), this app will try to match the sender and content. If one of the two doesn't match, the message will not be processed any further.
 If the 2FA code could be extracted, a foreground service will be started (status bar) and the app tries to connect to the configured Bluetooth adapter and sends the code. It retries for some amount of time and reports the status in the status bar. Note : The notification in the status bar doesn't automatically disappear. However, this doesn't consume any resources and can be removed using the Stop button.
 If the code is required on the mobile phone, it can be copied using the Copy last button.
 Protocol 
The communication is based on very simple primitives using an RFCOMM channel. The UUID for the service is e4d56fb3-b86d-4572-9b0d-44d483eb1eee . Extracted codes are sent as text (over a secure Bluetooth connection) terminated with a new line character. Therefore, codes may not contain any new line characters.
 Future 
 The protocol will be changed to something more sophisticated and extensible
 Configuration of the sender should be done through contact providers and not use regular expressions
 Allow to use this app to share text / files with the PC

fdroid:seamain.org.typhoonEye.description:
TyphoonEye is a lightweight, open-source real-time typhoon tracking and weather alert app for Android.
Features:
• Live typhoon tracking with interactive MapLibre maps
• Historical tracks, forecast paths, and 7/10/12-level wind radii by quadrant
• Optional distance-based emergency alerts (needs location permission)
• Material Design 3, dynamic color, light/dark theme, multiple languages
• Clearly labeled sample data you can open when live data can't be loaded
Network note:
Typhoon data comes from third-party weather APIs (QWeather / Juhe) and is fetched through TyphoonEye's own relay server on Cloudflare. The API keys live only on the relay; the app contains none. The relay uses your IP address for rate limiting and does not store it. Your location is never sent to the relay: warnings near you are matched on your device and currently cover coastal areas only. Basemap tiles come from OpenFreeMap (OpenStreetMap data). Optional mainland China basemap tiles may use Amap. No ads or analytics.
This is not an official meteorological app. In an emergency, always follow your local meteorological authority.
F-Droid builds update through the F-Droid client (no GitHub APK sideload).

apple-macos:1533555913.name: Days to Christmas: Countdown
apple-macos:1533555913.description:
Days to Christmas is the cozy, calm way to count the sleeps, and to make every day of December a little sensory adventure.
A SNOW GLOBE YOU CAN SHAKE
The countdown lives inside a glass snow globe with a real village in it. Shake your phone and the snow swirls, drag to spin the scene, tap to nudge the flakes, turn the phone over and watch them fall the other way. Hold the glass for the full-screen globe, and keep an eye on the cabin: an elf comes out to wave. A Snow Globe widget puts the number in the glass on your Home Screen, and the Mac gets the same globe with a Shake button.
SENSORY ADVENT CALENDAR: FREE
Behind each of the 24 doors is a simple activity for one of the senses: crunch fake snow, jingle bells, smell a clove orange, taste a candy cane, blow bubbles by the tree lights. Made with autistic and sensory-seeking children in mind, but every family loves them. Nothing to buy: every door is free, and a gentle daily reminder tells you when tonight's door is ready.
SANTA TRACKER & LETTERS TO SANTA
See where Santa is on Christmas Eve and, before that, how far the North Pole is from your country and what time he'll reach you (around 10 p.m., so be asleep). The workshop sends a daily report as the sleeps run down, you can replay the whole flight around the world, and children can write a letter to Santa by speaking or typing it. A few hours later, Santa writes back by hand, and the app can read his letter aloud.
SANTA'S GLOBE, IN YOUR ROOM
Put the world on your table and watch the sleigh fly the route, stop by stop, in augmented reality on iPhone and iPad, or as a globe you can spin with your hands on Apple Vision Pro.
SELFIE WITH SANTA
Pop a Santa hat, beard, glasses or reindeer antlers on everyone in the picture, stand Santa beside you, and share the photo. Faces are found on your device, and nothing is uploaded: the picture only exists if you save or share it.
CLIPS
Short Christmas clips with the live count on every one. Swipe, heart and share them, or make your own with a line and a carol. Type a child's name and the elf says it out loud with the sleeps left (the preview is free; a video for a name is one small purchase).
CHRISTMAS HITS FROM APPLE MUSIC
Twenty-four Christmas hits, from Mariah and Wham! to Slade and Bublé, playing the moment the app opens. With an Apple Music subscription they play in full, even when the phone is locked; without one you hear 30-second previews. Reorder the list, add any song from Apple Music, and share it as a link.
THE COUNTDOWN, EVERYWHERE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that update at midnight
• A Live Activity in the Dynamic Island on Christmas Eve
• Apple Watch, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro
• Count in sleeps, days, hours, minutes, or heartbeats
• Six scenes as a snow globe, painted or photographic: Classic, Midnight, Frost, Forest, Gingerbread and High Contrast, or a photo of your own tree behind the countdown (Premium)
• Share a picture of the countdown with friends
ACCESSIBLE BY DESIGN
• Full VoiceOver support and a spoken countdown
• Calm mode turns off snow, sparkle, parallax and haptics
• Follows Reduce Motion and Dynamic Type
• High Contrast theme, free for everyone
GIFT LIST
Keep a simple list of who you're buying for and tick things off as you go. Each Advent door suggests a matching sensory gift you can find on Amazon.
PREMIUM
The countdown and every Advent door are free, forever. Premium adds the pretty: all six scenes, painted or photographic, your own photo behind the countdown, extra snow and sparkle in the app and widgets, and unlimited people on the gift list. Choose Lifetime (pay once, every Christmas, on every device signed in to your Apple ID) or This Christmas Only (a season pass that runs until 1 January). No auto-renewing subscriptions.
As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
Privacy: no accounts and no tracking. Your gift list stays on your device.

Use HIIT IT as your interval timer from home, the gym, or anywhere outdoors. It is customizable to fit your workout needs with features:
 - A simple design to easily adjust your exercise and rest intervals or the number of sets in your workout.

apple-macos:568428364.name: TaskFire: To-Do List & Planner
apple-macos:568428364.description:
Just say it. TaskFire is the to-do list that works with the new Siri. Say a task with its date and list in one sentence, and it's there.
Then open the app and everything is sorted: overdue, today, and the next seven days, shared with the people you share a life with, on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
SEE WHAT MATTERS
Overdue, today, tomorrow, and the next seven days, in the order it matters. Smart lists pull tasks together by due date, star, tag, or person, so the right things are always in front of you.
ADD A TASK IN A TAP
Type it, pick a date and a list, star it, tag it, done. Add notes, checklists, and attachments when a task needs more.
NOW WITH SIRI
TaskFire works with the new Siri. Say "Hey Siri, in TaskFire add call the dentist tomorrow at 3pm" and it's on your list with the date and time. Say several tasks in one sentence. Looking at an email, message, or note? "Hey Siri, add this to TaskFire." Ask Siri what's on a list and it reads it back. Ask Siri to remind you when you get somewhere, like "remind me to get toilet paper when I get to Costco."
SHARE A LIST
Invite family, roommates, or coworkers to a list. Assign tasks so everyone sees who's on what.
TASKS AND CALENDAR TOGETHER
See your tasks and your week on one screen. Connect Google Calendar for two-way sync.
EVERY DETAIL A PLANNER COULD WANT
- Repeating tasks, based on the due date or the day you finish
- Multiple reminders per task
- Location reminders that alert you when you arrive
- Start and due dates and times
- Notes, comments, and checklists
- Email tasks straight into your TaskFire inbox
- Dark mode
ALWAYS IN SYNC
One account on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web. Your tasks are backed up to our secure cloud and follow you everywhere.
TaskFire is free to use. Try Premium free for 14 days, then keep the basic app free or subscribe monthly or yearly.
Siri features require an iPhone with Apple Intelligence running iOS 27 with the new Siri turned on, and iPhone and Siri set to English.

flathub:eu.ngdevelopment.tsukitag.name: Tsuki-tag
flathub:eu.ngdevelopment.tsukitag.summary: Anime imageboard browser, aggregator, downloader, tagger, converter, collection manager
flathub:eu.ngdevelopment.tsukitag.description:
Tsuki-tag is an aggregated anime imageboard browser and collection manager, which lets you browse multiple image sources in a combined view, search images using tags, download images into configured workspaces (folders) with customization and filename templating support, and manage or curate multiple collections of your chosen images.
 Tsuki-tag can inject EXIF metadata information (tag, image attributes, copyright notice, etc.) into the images during downloading or saving, with an additional option to convert non-JPG images to JPG images which support EXIF metadata. This could provide artists with a great way of creating and organizing a collection of images for reference, or to manage and appropriately annotate their own images with author and copyright information.
 Features include:
 Browse an aggregated collection of images retrieved from a number of pre-configured image providers in a paginated view. 
 Fine-tune which providers are queried, along with what type of images should be shown ('safe', 'questionable', 'explicit'). 
 Search for images using tags and tag combinations with wildcard support, exclude images from being displayed using another set of tags with wildcard and regular expression support. 
 Hover over images for a quick look at their attributes and information, or select them to keep them available for batch operations. 
 Open images in separate tabs and continue browsing. 
 Multi-selection system with support for batch operations (batch add to / remove from workspaces and online lists, batch update or annotate). 
 Create online lists, which are a local collection of image metadata which can be browsed just as the online providers. 
 Create workspaces, which on top of the features of online lists, lets you download images to configured folders with customizable behavior. 
 Import local files or folders to workspaces, or convert one of your image folders to a workspace. 
 Create metadata groups, which are a collection of information such as author, copyright notice, description and notes, which can be directly injected into the EXIF metadata of the JPG images files during workspace operations. 
 Convert non-JPG images to JPG for EXIF support. 
 Add, edit, or remove image tags before workspace or online list operations. 
 Create tag rules for your online lists or workspaces with wildcard and regular expression support, to automatically process an image across multiple lists. 
 Automatically add or remove tags when an image is added to, or removed from a workspace or online list, with templating support. 
 Specify the file names of files to be downloaded to a workspace, with templating support. 
 Global tag blacklisting with wildcard and regular expression support. 
 Several other features such as opening images in your default image editor, opening or copying the image website URL, re-downloading the image from the original provider, and more.

flathub:io.github.seja_arctic_fox.vidcom.name: VidCom
flathub:io.github.seja_arctic_fox.vidcom.description:
VidCom (short for Video Compression) is a simple utility for archiving videos. It offers both
 GUI and CLI interfaces and utilises ffmpeg for the video encoding.
 VidCom features two modes; Archive mode and Compress mode :
 Archive mode compresses a video as much as possible without losing target image
 quality.
 Compress mode compresses a video to a specified target size.
 There are also other options for quick setup, such as reducing resolution and frame rate, choosing
 an output directory and a trimming function. More advanced users can set the codec used for encoding
 and tweak some parameters of chosen codec to trade time for better compression and vice versa.
 You can process as many videos as you want by adding them to a queue (GUI) or specifying their
 paths in the command (CLI).
 Whether you want your memories to take up less space or just share a funny video clip with your
 friends, this app makes it easy for you.
 Features
 Archiving videos
 Compressing videos to target sizes
 Simple and clean GTK4 + Adwaita user interface
 CLI for automation
 Uses ffmpeg for encoding
 Avaiable codecs are AV1, HEVC, VP9, AVC
 Written in C++

 Receive and send notifications via ntfy.sh or self-hosted servers

RetroDECK is a powerful, all-in-one Retro Gaming Platform for modern Linux systems, including handheld gaming PCs like the Steam Deck, full Linux desktops, HTPC setups and Linux-based PC consoles such as the Steam Machine.
 It provides a complete retro gaming environment out of the box with minimal manual configuration.
 By seamlessly integrating multiple components, the platform brings your entire retro game experince together in one polished and unified package.
 Why Choose RetroDECK?
 True All-in-One Solution: Emulators, frameworks, engines, ports, tools, clients and the frontend are fully integrated and preconfigured.
 No System Modifications: Enjoy a dedicated retro gaming environment without altering or replacing your existing operating system.
 Streamlined Installation: Install and update a single application instead of multiple, directly from your software center.
 What is Included?
 Accessible for All: A clean, well-organized file structure designed for both newcomers and advanced users.
 Custom Launch Wrappers: Run complex DOOM WADs and OpenBOR titles effortlessly with streamlined, dedicated formats.
 ES-DE Frontend: A controller-friendly interface for browsing, organizing and launching your game library.
 Multi-Emulator Platforms: Unified and built-in multi-emulation frameworks including RetroArch and MAME.
 Native Game Engines: Seamlessly play engine-based titles with full native support for Solarus, OpenBOR, IkemenGO and UZDoom.
 PortMaster Integration: Easily install and manage community-supported Linux game ports.
 RetroDECK Configurator: A powerful built-in multi-tool for managing component settings, presets, storage, BIOS files and more.
 RetroDECK Framework: A unique component-based backend that isolates and layers software to ensure maximum stability and flexibility.
 RetroENGINE: A headless game launcher tailored for power users and developers.
 Steam Input Support: Preconfigured controller templates with radial menus and component-specific hotkeys via Steam.
 Steam Library Sync: Automatically add and synchronize your favorite games with Steam using the built-in Steam ROM Manager integration.
 Wide System Coverage: Enjoy broad compatibility with leading emulators such as Dolphin, PCSX2, PPSSPP, Vita3K, xemu, XRoar and many more.
 Join the RetroDECK Community
 Website: https://retrodeck.net
 RetroDECK Blog: https://retrodeck.readthedocs.io/en/latest/blog/
 Wiki and Documentation: https://retrodeck.readthedocs.io/

Input polygons for clipping can use EvenOdd, NonZero, Positive and Negative filling modes. The clipping code is based on the Vatti clipping algorithm, and outperforms other clipping libraries.

It also contains simple to use functions for writing PNG format image files and reading/writing/appending ZIP format archives. Miniz's compression speed has been tuned to be comparable to zlib's, and it also has a specialized real-time compressor function designed to compare well against fastlz/minilzo.

fedora-packages:python-email-validator/p.description: This library validates that a string is of the form name@example.com and optionally checks that the domain name is set up to receive email. This is the sort of validation you would want when you are identifying users by their email address like on a registration/login form (but not necessarily for composing an email message). Key features: • Checks that an email address has the correct syntax – great for email-based registration/login forms or validating data. • Gives friendly English error messages when validation fails that you can display to end-users. • Checks deliverability (optional): Does the domain name resolve? (You can override the default DNS resolver to add query caching.) • Supports internationalized domain names and internationalized local parts. • Rejects addresses with unsafe Unicode characters, obsolete email address syntax that you’d find unexpected, special use domain names like @localhost, and domains without a dot by default. This is an opinionated library! • Normalizes email addresses (important for internationalized and quoted-string addresses!) • Python type annotations are used.

firefox-addons:2911948.name: Translate It
firefox-addons:2911948.summary: Translator for selected text, web pages, PDFs, subtitles, and images, with traditional and AI providers.
firefox-addons:2911948.description:
Translate It! – Translation Where You Need It 
Translate without leaving the page you're on.
 Translate It brings different translation tools together in one Firefox extension. Translate selected text, input fields, page elements, full pages, PDFs, subtitles, and text inside images.
Choose the translation service that works best for you, including traditional providers, AI services, and local or offline options.
 ✓ What You Can Do 
 Text Selection: Select text on any page and see the translation right next to it.
 Translate While Typing: Translate text directly inside input fields before sending it.
 Element Translation: Click a page element to translate it in place while keeping the layout intact.
 Whole Page Translation: Translate complete pages, including dynamically loaded content and infinite-scroll pages.
 Mouse Hover Translation: Hold a modifier key and hover over text to quickly translate a word, sentence, or content block.
 Screen Capture & OCR: Extract and translate text from images, videos, and other content where text can't normally be selected.
 PDF Translation: Open local or online PDFs, translate pages, use bilingual views, run OCR on scanned documents, and export translated content to TXT, Markdown, or HTML.
 Subtitle Translation: Translate SRT subtitle files while preserving timestamps and formatting.
 Smart Dictionary: View definitions, synonyms, examples, and pronunciation information.
 Text to Speech: Listen to translated text using supported voices.
 History & Export: Keep previous translations and export them when needed.
 ✓ Providers and Flexibility 
Translate It! supports more than 10 translation providers, including Google, Microsoft, DeepL, OpenAI-compatible services, DeepSeek, WebAI to API , and more.
You're not tied to a single provider. Choose the one that best fits your needs, whether you care most about quality, speed, cost, or privacy.
For supported AI providers, optimization controls let you choose between larger, more efficient requests and faster parallel processing.
 ✓ Built for Everyday Browsing 
Translate It! works with regular pages as well as long articles, dynamic websites, and content that loads as you scroll.
Features such as progressive translation, lazy loading, and configurable processing help keep translations responsive across different types of pages.
The interface is designed for both Firefox on Desktop and Firefox for Android .
 ✓ Supported Languages 
Language support depends on the provider you choose.
Major providers support a wide range of languages, including English, Persian, Japanese, French, German, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Turkish , and many more.
 Your Choice: Decide how your translations are processed, with local or offline options available for supported features.
 Flexible Providers: Choose the provider that best fits your priorities for privacy, quality, speed, or cost.
 Open Source: Translate It is fully open source. Anyone can inspect the code, report issues, or contribute to the project.
 View Translate It on GitHub 
✨ Translate the web, your way.

firefox-addons:2781087.name: WebChatGPT: ChatGPT with internet access
firefox-addons:2781087.summary: Augment your ChatGPT prompts with relevant web search results through web browsing.
firefox-addons:2781087.description:
This free extension adds relevant web results to your prompts to ChatGPT for more accurate and up-to-date conversations.
----
Key features:
➡️ Get web results for your queries
➡️ Extract webpage text from any url
➡️ Add and use prompt templates
----
Why you need WebChatGPT:
It is similar to the web browsing features rolled out to ChatGPT Plus users by OpenAI, allowing your ChatGPT to access the internet and provide accurate results and source links. But it is much faster, light-weight, and available to all ChatGPT users - both Free and Plus!
----
Support:
💬 Join our Discord server for support and discussions: https://discord.gg/hjvAtVNtHa 
----
ℹ️ FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions):
🤔 Why is the extension asking for access to all websites permission?
👉 The extension requires access to all websites because there is no backend server to process web requests, and everything happens locally in the browser. There are two modes: web searching, and extracting webpage text from URLs. Web searching requires access to the search engine, while URL text extraction requires access to any website. This is why the access to all websites permission is required.
🤔 The extension does not work, the toolbar does not show up. What can I do?
👉 Some other ChatGPT extensions are known to interfere with WebChatGPT. We're trying to increase compatibility with other extensions. Meanwhile, if you are experiencing issues with the toolbar not showing up, please try disabling any other ChatGPT extensions that you have installed and reloading the page. If you continue to experience issues, feel free to reach out to us on our Discord server for assistance – https://discord.gg/nmCjvyVpnB .
🤔 Do you collect any data?
👉 No, we do not collect any user data or analytics. This is an open-source project, the source code is publicly available for anyone to review at https://github.com/interstellard/chatgpt-advanced .
----
New features coming soon:
- Support all popular search engines like Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo! Search, and more
- Conversational web browsing that knows when and how to browse the internet to answer questions about recent topics and events
- Better prompts for ChatGPT Plus Plugins

firefox-addons:2724088.description:

The default site list at time of writing includes all stackexchange related sites (stackoverflow, etc.), zoom.us and ikea.com .

Also included is a per-website whitelist; if a site is whitelisted you will see its option dialogues as if cookie cutter GDPR auto-deny were not installed at all.

bluejetty:00152412:ios.description:
See those planks nailed tight?
Your first instinct—pull them out! Great, we’re on the same page.
That’s the core of the game: clear every plank. But don’t think you can just smash them off. The trick is moving screws from one hole to another, and letting physics do the rest. Sounds easy… but what if the holes are limited?
You’ll need to plan each move carefully. Move too fast, and the planks might slip and fall. Sure, tools like drills or hammers could help—but what if you don’t have them? What’s your strategy then?
Try to figure it out without relying on tools. Each level is a new challenge. Good luck!

bluejetty:00161389:ios.summary:
Introducing My Cloud OS 5
Welcome to our fresh new My Cloud NAS software ecosystem featuring our latest security updates for enhanced data privacy, improved stability and reliability, a modern mobile and web app experience, and improved pho
bluejetty:00161389:ios.description:
Introducing My Cloud OS 5
Welcome to our fresh new My Cloud NAS software ecosystem featuring our latest security updates for enhanced data privacy, improved stability and reliability, a modern mobile and web app experience, and improved photo/video viewing and sharing capabilities. 
My Cloud OS 5 helps you easily back up and organize high volumes of content from multiple computers, smartphones, and tablets on your My Cloud NAS, on your own private network, and without costly subscriptions. Use the mobile or web app to remotely access and share files, photos and videos you save on your My Cloud NAS from anywhere with an Internet connection.
COLLECT YOUR CONTENT IN ONE PLACE
Set up automatic backups to save content from your multiple devices on your private My Cloud NAS. And with your files, photos, and videos organized in one place on your own network, you can easily streamline access to manage your projects and optimize workflows.
ACCESS REMOTELY
The My Cloud OS 5 mobile app makes your content available to your smartphone or tablet with an Internet connection, whether you’re at home or away. Stop lugging around external drives when you travel and simply access your important files with your smartphone or tablet.
EASY SHARING AND COLLABORATION
Easily share content with friends, family, and colleagues, or invite them to access your My Cloud NAS for seamless collaboration. My Cloud OS 5 makes it easy to share high-res photos and videos, a single file, or an entire folder using your smartphone or tablet.
OPTIMIZED MULTI-MEDIA EXPERIENCE
My Cloud OS 5 delivers a beautiful photo and video viewing experience, so you get the most out of your multi-media library.
• Better Photo Viewing and Sharing: Preview RAW and HEIC photos before sending. Create albums to collect and organize photos for projects, special events, or just memories you want to share. Then, you can invite others to view or even add in their own photos. 
• Sharper Video Sharing: Share high-quality video with friends, family or clients without compromising on resolution. 
• Smooth Streaming: Download the Twonky Server or Plex Media Server to smoothly stream movies and music playlists stored on your My Cloud NAS to your TV, home entertainment system or mobile device.
Key App Features: 
- Easily back up and organize high volumes of content from multiple smartphones and tablets on your private My Cloud NAS
- Remotely access all the content saved on your private My Cloud NAS without costly subscriptions
- Share high-res photos and videos, a single file, or an entire folder using your smartphone or tablet
- Create an Album so you can easily share photos and videos with colleagues, clients, or family
- Smoothly stream movies and music playlists stored on your My Cloud NAS to your mobile device
For more information on Western Digital’s Vulnerability Disclosure Policy please visit: https://www.westerndigital.com/support/product-security/vulnerability-disclosure-policy

bluejetty:00045040:ios.developer: St Mark Coptic Orthodox Church Inc.
bluejetty:00045040:ios.summary:
Coptic Hymns In English has been completely redesigned and rebuilt.
A new, faster, and more beautiful app for praying and worshiping in English, bringing the hymns of the Coptic Orthodox Church together with the Agpeya, the Psalms, and a l
bluejetty:00045040:ios.description:
Coptic Hymns In English has been completely redesigned and rebuilt.
A new, faster, and more beautiful app for praying and worshiping in English, bringing the hymns of the Coptic Orthodox Church together with the Agpeya, the Psalms, and a library of prayers, all in one place.
Hymns for every season
Browse the full hymn catalog by album or by the Coptic liturgical year. A redesigned Home screen greets you with today's Coptic date, the current season, the daily Synaxarion readings, and the prayer hour happening right now. Discover what's trending this week and see which albums are coming up before each feast and fast arrives.
Listen, read, and follow along
A gorgeous full-screen player with artwork, playback speed, skip controls, sleep timer, and a loop tool. Read along with lyrics, view the Coptic Hazzat text, or open the musical notation.
Pray the Agpeya
The complete canonical hours of prayer, beautifully laid out and easy to read. Listen to each hour with word-by-word highlighting that glides along with the audio so you never lose your place. Set personal goals, add reminders for the hours you pray, and track your day at a glance with a Home Screen widget.
The Psalter & a library of prayers
Read and listen to the Psalms as one flowing document, plus a growing collection of prayers for repentance, communion, guidance, meals, and more: each with the same follow-along audio.
More to explore
• Podcasts and spiritual songs
• Curated collections and seasonal albums
• A real liturgical calendar with labeled seasons, fasts, and feasts
• Church Mode for projecting and praying together
Yours, online or off
Build playlists, save favorites, and download anything for offline listening — your music keeps playing even with no signal. Continue right where you left off, on every screen.
Whether you're learning the hymns, praying the hours, or simply worshiping at home, this new edition is faster, richer, and easier to use than ever.
Glory to God.

bluejetty:00079749:ios.description:
Embark on a magical journey of weight management. MyWeight² makes tracking your weight simpler and more enjoyable than ever with a unique set of widgets. Let positive feedback guide you effortlessly to your weight goals, without relying on willpower.
** Key Features **
- Exquisite Widgets
MyWeight² offers a set of carefully designed desktop and lock screen widgets, each with unique functionalities to help you achieve your goals.
- Positive Feedback Mechanism
Guides you to spontaneously control your weight through positive feedback, rather than relying on willpower. Through enjoyable observation and recording, you naturally achieve your weight management goals.
- Ultra-Convenient Weight Tracking
MyWeight² provides silky-smooth interactions and reliable weight tracking features. MyWeight² also supports Apple Health and iCloud data synchronization, making every experience trustworthy.
- Apple Health + Smart Scales
MyWeight² can automatically sync your daily weight data through Apple Health. Thus, you can use third-party scales that support Apple Health to automatically record your weight.
** Why Choose MyWeight²? **
- If you appreciate simplicity and elegance in design;
- If you don't want to spend precious willpower;
- If you're looking for a more natural and relaxed way to manage weight;
MyWeight² is your ideal choice. Download MyWeight² now and experience a new way of weight management.
** Free Version **
The basic features of MyWeight² are free. You can use the free version to track your daily weight and view the data through widgets or the Apple Watch face. The free version also supports iCloud sync and Apple Health.
By subscribing or purchasing feature packs, you will gain access to the full features and experience, including BMI functionality, reminders, advanced widgets, and advanced Apple Watch faces, among others. You can view all premium features in the app's Settings > Membership page.
** Premium Membership Subscription **
You can unlock all features and content by subscribing to MyWeight² Premium. Auto-renewable subscription can be found in the app's Settings page. After your confirmation, the app will charge your App Store account. To cancel the subscription, please turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://gongzhang.io/app/myweight/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://gongzhang.io/app/myweight/en/terms

bluejetty:00139979:ios.description:
Sudoku - Pretty puzzling. A free and offline Sudoku app.
Presenting you a modern and rethought Sudoku design. By removing excessive details from the screen, we managed to create a fresh and clean look for the puzzle that we all love - at the same time sustaining intuitive gameplay and customization.
The user interface is minimal and fast - starting a new Sudoku or continuing right where you left off is just one click away. There are no loading screens. What is more, you do not have to worry about not finishing a Sudoku. If you are in a hurry, just navigate back or leave the app in any other way and the app takes care of saving your progress seamlessly. This for all difficulty levels separately.
So there you go! Choose your favorite colors and begin your smoothest and most elegant journey through endless amount of Sudoku puzzles!
Oh, and hopefully you love gimmicks. Changing the colors of the UI is not only available during the solving of Sudoku - you can do it literally from anywhere within the app!
Highlighted features:
- Selecting themes during gameplay
- Clean look and feel
More features:
- Input modes: cell first and digit first - without toggling
- Pencil marks (with automatic removal)
- 5 difficulty levels
- Top times
- Works offline
- Digit highlighting
- Count of remaining digits
- Automatic saving
- Undo
- Board validation
- Optional aids
- Edge to edge board
- Satisfying animations
- Switch on and off themes
What to wait for:
- More themes
- Fix for vertically longer screens
Enjoy!
EULA: http://dustland.ee/sudoku/eula/
Privacy Policy: http://dustland.ee/sudoku/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00183147:ios.name: American Mahjong Practice
bluejetty:00183147:ios.summary: The secret to great Mahjong? Play more games. Play every hand to completion and watch how tile choices create winning hands. Ready for a challenge? Play the daily challenge hand against other players, or enable opponent bots and compete.
bluejetty:00183147:ios.description:
The secret to great Mahjong? Play more games. Play every hand to completion and watch how tile choices create winning hands. Ready for a challenge? Play the daily challenge hand against other players, or enable opponent bots and compete.
Try 2018 hands for free or purchase the monthly subscription or purchase 2026 hands one-time.  The monthly subscription includes the new hands every year.
The new Daily Challenge Hands and Leaderboard are included with the monthly subscription and 2026 hands one-time purchase. 
Mahjong Practice rethinks mahjong for mobile, with a design that takes full advantage of small screens. Play fun, quick games offline, anywhere, anytime. No internet connection needed. This is the best way to learn the 2026 card.
Suggested Hands:
All possible hand combinations are evaluated and sorted by the highest matching tile count. Play one of these hands or any hand you want. See the combinations of hands with the most overlapping tiles. Develop your strategies selecting hands.
Large Tiles and Large Tile Font Option:
Tiles are large. Enable the Large Tile Font option to make the tiles even easier to read.
Hand Validations and Corrections:
See the closest matching pattern when you declare an unknown pattern. Tips help beginning players.
Hand Stats:
Track hands completed and your progress on the NMJL card. 
Hand Filters:
Select the sections you like to play the most. Hide sections to focus on any given section. Play the whole card.
Play Against Bots or Solo:
When playing solo, the opponent bots play valid patterns and exchange jokers but do not declare Mahjong. Play until you declare Mahjong or the wall is empty in solo mode. Go to Settings to enable bots that win to practice defense.
Advanced Practice Features:
Try different strategies with Replay and Undo. Enable Open Play to disable NMJL rules and play by your own House Rules. 
This is the Original American Mahjong App, 10 Years in the making. 
Contact support@eightbam.com for help at any time.

bluejetty:00119426:ios.description:
We are pleased to offer you an effortless tool that makes it even easier to manage your account! Our free app provides you convenience at your fingertips. - With secure, Touch or Face ID access, you‘ll be able to view your real-time account balance, payment due date and balance details without entering your account number every time!
- Easily report an outage, see your estimated time of restoration and access outage lists and maps to stay informed.
- Submit a meter read at your convenience – there’s even a flashlight to help you read the meter!

- Enroll in eBill for online access and convenience and view up to 13 months of bills!
- Sign up for AutoPay so your payments can be made automatically, securely, and on time every month.

-Sign up for Outage Alerts and stay informed if your power goes out. You will also receive notifications with the latest information about your power outage so you can plan.
-Enroll in Meter Read Reminder Alerts and receive a convenient reminder to read your meter on months we’re scheduled to estimate your energy usage. 
- Update your account profile (email address, mailing address and phone number) and manage your personal preferences.

bluejetty:00153647:ios.description:
Second Phone Number - Virtual Number for Text and Call
Second Phone Number is the smart solution for anyone who needs an extra phone line without a second device. Get a virtual number from any country and use it to call or text from anywhere in the world. Ideal for business, travel, dating, and online privacy.
With Second Phone Number, you can choose from a wide range of virtual phone numbers, send and receive SMS, and make low-cost international calls — all from one easy-to-use app.
Key Features:
Get a Virtual Phone Number Instantly:
Choose a second phone number from a variety of countries including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and more. Use it for personal or professional use without needing a second SIM card or device
Call and Text from Anywhere :
Use your virtual number to make and receive calls or send text messages worldwide. Stay connected while keeping your primary number private. Perfect for work calls, classified ads, online transactions, and more.
Low-Cost International Calling and Messaging :
Enjoy affordable rates for international calls and messages. Save on roaming charges while traveling or running a global business with competitive pricing plans.
Receive SMS and Verification Codes:
 Get important SMS messages and verification codes from apps and services using your second number. Ideal for creating multiple accounts or protecting your primary number from spam.
Maintain Privacy and Protect Your Identity:
 Keep your personal number private by using a separate number for temporary or long-term use. Avoid spam, unwanted calls, and keep your identity safe online.
Multiple Country Options:
 Select numbers from multiple countries and regions to suit your needs. Whether you are expanding your business or need local presence, Second Phone Number gives you flexibility and global reach.
Easy Setup and Seamless Calling Experience:
 No hardware required. Just download the app, select your preferred number, and start calling and texting in minutes. The app is optimized for fast messaging and high-quality calls.
Second Phone Number is the perfect app for freelancers, entrepreneurs, frequent travelers, or anyone looking to manage multiple phone lines from a single device. 
Get full control over your communication with a secure, reliable, and affordable virtual number service.
Download Second Phone Number today and stay connected wherever you go.

bluejetty:00115973:ios.description:
Enter the world of "Tiles Survive!" and guide your team of survivors through a harsh wilderness. As the core of your survivor team, explore the wild, gather key resources, and use them wisely to strengthen your shelter.
Venture into different tiles and expand your territory. Improve how you manage resources, build and upgrade structures, and connect electricity to speed up production. Create a self-sufficient shelter where every decision shapes your survivors’ future.
Game Features:
● Operations & Management
Enhance your production structures for smoother workflows. Use electricity to run your shelter more efficiently. Unlock and upgrade more structures to meet your growing needs.
● Assign Survivors
Assign jobs to your survivors, like hunters, chefs, or lumberjacks. Pay attention to their health and morale to keep productivity high.
● Resource Collection
Explore further and discover unique resources in different biomes. Gather and use every resource to your advantage.
● Multi-map & Collectibles
Travel through multiple maps to find loot and special items. Bring them back to decorate and improve your shelter.
● Recruit Heroes
Find heroes with special skills and traits who boost your shelter’s capabilities.
● Form Alliances
Team up with friends to stand against common threats, such as severe weather and wild creatures.
In "Tiles Survive!", every choice matters. How you manage resources, plan your shelter, and explore the unknown will decide your fate. Are you ready to face the challenge and thrive in the wild? Download now and begin your epic adventure!

bluejetty:00073715:ios.name: Phone Tracker - GPS Location
bluejetty:00073715:ios.summary: Phone Tracker is your all-in-one GPS tracker and family locator, designed to keep your loved ones connected and safe in real time across your iOS devices on a live, shared, and private map. Seamlessly connect family members regardless of th
bluejetty:00073715:ios.description:
Phone Tracker is your all-in-one GPS tracker and family locator, designed to keep your loved ones connected and safe in real time across your iOS devices on a live, shared, and private map. Seamlessly connect family members regardless of their phones operating system!   
- ENHANCED PRIVATE CIRCLES
Create and manage multiple private circles for different groups, such as family or friends. Invite new members effortlessly using a unique 6-digit code, shareable link, or QR code. Easily switch between your groups and receive instant notifications whenever a member joins or leaves a circle.
- TRANSPARENT REAL-TIME LOCATION
Locate your circle members on the map in real time with complete clarity. View the exact timestamp of each location update and easily spot if a position is outdated.  
- SMART PLACES & CUSTOM PLACE ALERTS
Save important places like Home, School, or Work. Set up customized notifications to know the exact moment specific circle members arrive or depart. You can also choose who receives each alert for total control.   
- UPGRADED SOS EMERGENCY ALERTS
In an emergency, tap the SOS button to instantly send an urgent notification to all members of your circle. Opening the notification brings them directly to your live location, showing your name and exact time of activation so they can act fast.   
- AUTOMATIC FALL DETECTION
The app automatically detects potential falls and initiates a countdown, giving you time to cancel the alert if you are okay. If not cancelled, an emergency alert with your real-time location will be sent to your circle.   
- COMPREHENSIVE ACTIVITY HISTORY
Review detailed activity history with an easy-to-use date selector. Check past activity including:
• Location history
• Arrival and departure logs for Smart Places
• Triggered SOS emergency alerts
• Driving routes and trips  
- PRIVACY CONTROLS
You are always in control of your privacy. Pause location sharing whenever you need to. Your circle will receive a clear notification that location sharing is paused, ensuring transparency rather than showing an outdated location as if it were active. 
- SHARED CIRCLE SUBSCRIPTION
One subscription covers everyone! A single premium subscription unlocks full access to all features for every member of your circle—no separate payments required.  
 - PERSONAL ACCOUNTS & EASY RECOVERY
Create a personal account with secure sign-in to keep your identity, circles, and subscription benefits safe even when switching devices. 
- OTHER ESSENTIAL FEATURES
• Battery Level Monitoring: Check the device battery percentage of each member right from the circle list.
• Find My Device: Locate lost or misplaced phones using the GPS tracker.  
Stay informed, connected, and in control with Phone Tracker to ensure your family’s safety across their devices. Subscribe to unlock unlimited notifications, live tracking, extended history, and an ad-free experience.   
Terms of use: https://www.zedlatino.info/Service_Terms.html
Privacy policy: https://www.zedlatino.info/privacy-policy-apps.html

bluejetty:00093012:ios.description:
Your workout plan. No spreadsheets.
• Hardy is a gym workout tracker and planner that takes care of your weight calculations, progressions, and workout tracking, so you can focus on lifting.
• Choose from 1,800+ public workout routines and press Start. Or build your own program with advanced progression rules, percentage-based weights, RPE, and more.
• Unlike basic workout trackers that simply log what you've lifted, Hardy understands your routine and helps you know exactly what to lift next.
PICK FROM 1,800+ WORKOUT ROUTINES
• Discover popular strength training programs, including 5/3/1, nSuns, Push Pull Legs (PPL), Upper/Lower splits, 5×5, and many more.
• Choose a routine, enter your personal strength levels, and start training. Hardy guides you through each workout, exercise by exercise and set by set.
• Or create your own routine from scratch.
ALWAYS KNOW EXACTLY WHAT TO LIFT
• No more manually calculating percentages or checking spreadsheets between sets.
• Hardy automatically calculates your exercise weights based on your routine and personal strength levels.
Supports:
- 1 Rep Max (1RM) percentages
- Training Max (TM) percentages
- RPE and RIR-based training
- Working weights
- And more.
YOUR PROGRAM PROGRESSES WITH YOU
• Hardy doesn't just record your workouts. It helps manage your progression.
• As you get stronger, your weights can increase automatically according to your routine's rules and your performance.
Supports: 
- Linear progressions
- Double progressions
- RPE/RIR-based autoregulation
- Overloads
- Deloads
- And more.
BUILD YOUR OWN ADVANCED WORKOUT PROGRAMS
• Create custom workout routines with the same powerful features used by structured strength training programs.
• Set up percentage-based exercises, progression rules, training blocks, and personalized weight calculations.
• Whether you're following an established strength program or building something entirely your own, Hardy handles the calculations.
TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS AND SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Tracking is not just for passively logging your workout history. Tracking on Hardy helps the routines actively calculate your next weights and progressions based on your routine rules.
• You can track your workouts with an easy-to-use, set-by-set tracker.
• And you can also keep track of your training history, exercise performance, personal records, and progress over time.
• Supports: Apple Watch 
SHARE YOUR WORKOUT ROUTINES
• Share workout routines with friends, your clients as a private trainer, or the whole community using a simple link.
• Others can then use the same program with their personal weights calculated automatically based on their 1 Rep Maxes.
LESS CALCULATING. MORE LIFTING.
• From your first gym routine to advanced strength programming, Hardy brings workout planning, tracking, and progression together in one app.
• Your routines. Your progress. No spreadsheets.

bluejetty:00040749:ios.summary: RedApp browser is super fast, safe with the highest privacy capabilities, cool interface and many great useful features. Most importantly, RedApp provides the best customization capabilities for users in a way never seen before in any other
bluejetty:00040749:ios.description:
RedApp browser is super fast, safe with the highest privacy capabilities, cool interface and many great useful features. Most importantly, RedApp provides the best customization capabilities for users in a way never seen before in any other browser application.
Now, let's start exploring RedApp together!
Main features:
• Fast, smart, integrates many great add-ons, security and energy efficiency than other browsers.
• Search intelligently. Easily access shortcuts to search providers including Wikipedia, Twitter, YouTube, Amazon etc.
• Private browsing. Using Passcode/TouchID or FaceID protection helps you keep more privacy and security in your business.
• Tracking Protection. Let you identify advertisers and others who track your online behavior, and remove the cross‑site tracking data they leave behind.
• Privacy Protection. Be protected with leading privacy and security features such as HTTPS Everywhere (encrypted data traffic), script blocking, cookie blocking, and private tabs.
• Notes. Allows you to organize and manage notes when you need to note down any content you need while browsing.
• Music Charts. Allows you to explore iTunes Charts with Top Songs, Top Albums, Top Playlists, Top Videos...
• Player Manager. You can play video links from YouTube, Vimeo while browsing. Play audio in background and without any annoying ads.
• Download Manager, File Manager and Sharing Manager. Let you download, manage files or links and share them to nearby devices. Use Wi-Fi or WebDAV sharing to let you transfer files directly to other nearby devices (mobile or PC). In addition, it also allows you to instantly send messages and files to anyone around you (Nearby Chat).
• Widgets. Supports many useful widgets such as Calendar, Top Sites, Your Library, Music Charts, Notes, Video Meetings, Tracking Protection, Website Redirects, URL Shortcuts...
• Default Browser. From iOS 14, set RedApp as your default browser! Select Settings - scroll down to select RedApp - select RedApp as the Default Browser App.
Additional Features:
• Appearance. Use system Light/Dark mode or choose a predefined theme.
• Theme Color. Change any text color you want.
• Toolbar Color. Select a color-coded predefined toolbar.
• Customize the toolbar. Allows adding or removing menu buttons.
• Address Bar. Displayed at Top or Bottom.
• Wallpapers. Set background image for New Tab.
• Allows customization of font-size
• Reader Mode. Always on.
• Require Passcode/TouchID or FaceID when the screen is locked.
• Pop-up blocker.
• Saves battery and data.
• HTTPS everywhere (for security).
• Script blocking.
• Browsing history/Reading List/Bookmarks.
• Private and recent tabs.
• Night Mode. Easily read in low light.
• Blocks cookie consent notifications by default.
• Use voice search in the browser.
• Import/export bookmarks to another browser.
AND you can explore other useful features in Settings.
With the idea of creating an all-in-one app, it means that when you use the RedApp browser, you will have all you need. Therefore, RedApp always tries, always discovers useful features, always improves, always listens to suggestions from all users... to make RedApp better and better!
You will feel RedApp is yours and very safe to use.
Love the app? Rate us! Your feedback is music to our ears, and it helps us make RedApp even better. Got a question? Please drop us a line at: mqmedia29@gmail.com

bluejetty:00023800:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00023800:ios.description:
Challenge your skill with new mode & new boss!!!
Harmonia used to be a bright world of all races, where Human, Orc, Spirit, Dwarf, Beast man and Elf live in peace together. One day, when deep desires arose, the dark forces ascended from hell, invading the world, that tragedy struck every Harmonia citizen and made everything sink to the depths of despair.
Play the role of Noah - a Shadow Knight, you need to make your way through the hell gate, fight evil enemies, defeat the immortals of Darkness and bring back the light to Harmonia. You will find Ashley and Lucius - your companions on the journey saving Harmonia!
Download and Join the fight now!
GAME FEATURES:
▶ The True Feeling of an Action RPG Game
Experience the action RPG game feeling with hack and slash gameplay in the dark fantasy world setting. There are 10 maps from The Stream City, Shadow Forest to Capitals of The Mortals, and they are still updated. 
▶ Watch out the monsters and bosses!
With the absence of light, evil reveals its true form. 
Monsters in each place have different shapes, skills, and stories behind them. Sometimes you have to take them down even when you're the weaker. Beware of skeletons, elves that can control your body and your mind, be sure to use skills with the right combo, dodge their attack wisely. 
Bosses have their stories as well. They are giant Kings of the dark lands with sturdy physique, robust strength, and particular abilities. Facing them requires more than just powerful stats. 
▶ Fight with multiple choices
Fight the way you want as you can choose your own unique heroes, determine your favorite fighting style among slashing a big sword, shooting slugs, or piercing invisible spears. In each match, you can pick 2 characters to play and they can be readily switched. 
Keep in mind that Each hero can knock the enemy up, knockdown, toss back,...
Dodging smoothly, controlling enemies effectively, and using skills combo calmly is the key to win every battle
▶ Embark on a horrid but fascinating adventure!
Not only you, we also get bored with the limit of horizontal gameplay only mode. 
In Shadow Knight, you will go on a journey with different terrains by running, climbing, jumping, where you will confront more danger, further difficulty, and additionally have chances to get more rewards in return as we put some easter eggs and hidden rewards along the way. 
▶ Interact with others and show the world your skills
You will be immersed in endless dark fantasy shadow battles. Besides towns, forests, dungeons, as an online game, you can interact with others unlimitedly, engage in endless battles with tremendously competitive and merciless battlefields such as Survival, World Boss, PVP Arena,... These features will be available soon!
▶ Gear Up In Style
Collect the best weapon, equipment, rune from hundreds of items, then fully customize your Shadow Knight to stand out from other knights. Join the adventure and create the craziest combats 'cause Your Knight, Your Style! 
▶ Easy In Upgrading
While you're away, your knights are still being trained and collecting resources to upgrade. When you're back, they will be stronger, gain new levels, learn new skills. Grow and train a powerful team and ready for battles!
ACE THE SHADOW!
* Follow us on social media for more information and get support:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShadowKnight.Official
Email: support@fansipan.hk
* Notice:
Shadow Knight is an online game and requires a stable internet connection.

bluejetty:00186046:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186046:ios.description:
WordHolic is the free DIY style simple & useful flash card app for any purpose: learning languages, test preparation, etc.
● Easy to operate with easy-to-see design, so you can learn smoothly!
● Simple but sufficient functions, so you can use them conveniently!
● Create as many flash cards as you want for free and learn Chinese, French, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, etc. or prepare for your exams!
◇ Main learning functions ◇
● Learn effectively by utilizing bookmarks and memorize flags on cards (Front side, back side and tag comment)
● Practice listening with the voice reading function (30 languages)
 (You can also play voice readings simultaneously while listening to music.)
● Easy to learn with the auto rotate slideshow 
 (You can adjust speeds, reverse front and back sides, shuffle cards etc.)
● Enjoy the card list and the full screen multi mode which shows Front and Back sides at the same time
● Add photos or images on flashcards to memorize visually
● Review repeatedly based on forgetting curve
● Quizzes (Writing, Dictation, etc.)
◇ Main management functions ◇
● Organize cards in folders 
 (Multiple subfolders can be also provided.)
● Search folders and cards by keywords and so on.
● Export card backup files 
 (You can easily share your card data with your friends!)
● Import data files to create cards 
 (You can create data files in PC and import it!)
◇ Special functions for each language ◇
You can enjoy convenient functions for each language!
● Chinese: Character Converter (Simplified / Traditional), Pinyin Generator
● Japanese: Furigana Generator (Romaji / Hiragana / Katakana)
◇ Other useful functions ◇
● Set the default reading language. These are set as initial values when you create new cards, so you don’t have to set each time.
(This is available from the menu button on the upper right of the app screen > [Preferences] > [New Card Settings].)
● Set the horizontal alignments and text sizes on each side of cards!
(This is available from the menu button on the upper right of the app screen > [Preferences] > [Card Basic Display Settings].)
● Enjoy Night Mode to make backgrounds and texts dark when you feel your eyes are tired or at night.
(This is available from the menu button on the upper right of the app screen > [Preferences] > [Night Mode].)
◇ How to share cards with your friends ◇
(1) Select the menu button on the upper right of the app screen > [Export Backup] 
(2) Follow the instructions and export a card data file in the way you like (mail attachment, iCloud, etc.) and share the file with your friends
(3) Store the file in a place of a friend’s phone (or iCloud, Google Drive, etc.) where your friend can view it with the file app.
(4) Select the menu button on the upper right of the app screen > [Import Card Data] and let the file imported into a folder.
◇ Upgrades (In-App Purchases) ◇
Go to [Menu] > [Upgrades] in the app to purchase the upgrades!
● Premium Plans
By upgrading to the premium plan, you will be able to use many features such as data sync, background player, ad free, etc.
- 1 year plan (Auto Renewal Subscription）etc.
● Restore Your Purchases
You can restore your purchases from: 
[Menu] > [Upgrades] > [Restore]
* Before restoring, log in your device with your Apple ID that you purchased your plan with.
● Current Plan and Cancellation
The payments will be charged to your iTunes account. To check your current plans or turn off auto-renewal, go to:
Settings App in your device > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > Manage
● Auto-Renewal
Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
● Note
- To turn off auto-renewal, you have to do so in the iTunes Store and cannot cancel the month that your plan starts from.
- Before making a purchase, accept the following Terms of Use.
● Terms of Use
https://www.langholic.com/wordholic-terms-of-use-en
Enjoy WordHolic!
