bluejetty:00146575:ios.description:
TRANSFORM YOUR HEALTH THE MEDITERRANEAN DIET WAY
no.Diet is a smart nutrition and lifestyle app inspired by Mediterranean recipes – simple, satisfying, and sustainable. Get a fully personalized plan that helps you lose weight, feel energized, and improve your long-term health.
1. PLAN TAILORED TO YOUR BODY AND GOALS
Whether your aim is to slim down, improve digestion, or gain energy, no.Diet creates a plan that fits your needs and lifestyle. Enjoy delicious, healthy meals and balanced portions designed for steady results – not quick fixes.
2. BUILD HABITS THAT LAST
Track your meals, water, and daily movement. Learn how small choices – like mindful eating or better sleep – add up to lasting change. Our coach guidance helps you make healthy habits effortless.
3. MEDITERRANEAN-STYLE MEAL INSPIRATION
Explore thousands of fresh, easy-to-cook recipes based on Mediterranean diet – olive oil, fish, grains, and colorful veggies. Every dish is crafted to support heart, gut, and metabolic health while keeping flavor first.
4. MIND-BODY BALANCE
Well-being isn’t only about food. Discover simple movement sessions, breathing exercises, and mindful guided workouts to reduce stress, improve focus, and help you feel better.
5. SMART TRACKING FOR REAL PROGRESS
See how your lifestyle improves day by day. Monitor your steps, water intake, weight, fasting, and energy. Celebrate progress – not perfection – as you build a routine that truly works for you.
WHY PEOPLE LOVE NO.DIET
Natural, sustainable weight loss
Energy and focus without extreme restrictions
Improved digestion, sleep, and heart health
Delicious Mediterranean recipes updated weekly
Personalized coaching support
Practical challenges and daily habits that keep you motivated
Your data, your control
Your personal data is encrypted and protected. You can delete your account and all data at any time directly in the app.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
no.Diet offers flexible auto-renewing plans.
PAYMENT & RENEWAL
You can download and use the app for free. Continued access to all features requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your account settings. Prices apply to U.S. customers; international pricing may vary by currency. For support or questions, contact us at hello@no.diet. 
Privacy Policy: https://no.diet/privacy
Terms of Use: https://no.diet/terms

START YOUR MEDITERRANEAN JOURNEY TODAY
Download no.Diet and discover how balanced nutrition, small habits, and Mediterranean living can transform your energy, mood, and health – one meal at a time.

WBRE Channel 28 WYOU Channel 22 Eyewitness News serves all of Northeastern and Central Pennsylvania.

What’s New in the VNPAY App?
VNPAY is a multi-utility payment and shopping app that integrates transportation, entertainment, and shopping, catering to all aspects of daily life with various payment methods and funding sources.
Fast and Convenient Payments
The VNPAY app supports multiple secure and convenient payment methods:
VNPAY e-wallet
VNPAY-QR code scanning
ATM cards, international cards
Apple Pay
Postpaid services
Unlimited Utility Ecosystem
Enjoy a seamless shopping, transportation, and entertainment experience with maximum convenience and efficiency:
Easy shopping on VnShop – Authentic products at great prices with daily promotions.
Effortless transportation – Quickly book taxis, motorbikes, flights, trains, and buses in just a few minutes.
Convenient entertainment – Book movie tickets, amusement park tickets, and event passes with just a few taps.

Postpaid services – Buy now, pay later.
Consumer loans – Access flexible credit without income proof, approval within 2 minutes, with limits up to 50 million VND (*).

Customer Support

Email: hotro@vnpay.vn

Sharpen your memory and reflexes in this fast-paced matching game.
 How to Play
Tap targets as they appear — but only if two in a row are the same!
Miss the match or run out of time, and it's game over.
Each level brings new symbols, faster speeds, and tougher goals.

• Unique matching logic: remember and respond in sequence
• Colorful targets – emojis, numbers, letters, and more
• Timer-based gameplay to keep you on your toes
• Progress is saved automatically – come back anytime
• Works offline and supports short burst play
 Perfect For:
Memory training, reflex improvement, and quick brain games.
 Progress Tracking
Your highest unlocked level is saved locally – no sign-in required.
 Download DoubleMatch now and test how far your memory and reactions can go!

bluejetty:00089209:ios.name: H2S: Best Deals & Discounts
bluejetty:00089209:ios.summary: Hip2Save is the one stop shop for savvy shoppers to save money with the latest and greatest deals as well as frugal lifestyle tips. Our team of experts does all the work for you by scouring retailers, both in-store and online, for the best
bluejetty:00089209:ios.description:
Hip2Save is the one stop shop for savvy shoppers to save money with the latest and greatest deals as well as frugal lifestyle tips. Our team of experts does all the work for you by scouring retailers, both in-store and online, for the best deals, discounts, coupons, and promo codes on everything from clothing and electronics to groceries and household essentials.
We work hard to bring you the hottest deals in real time with new deals going live as often as every 5 minutes! You’ll find deals and promotions from some of the biggest names in online shopping, including Amazon, Walmart, and Target, along with drugstore deals from retailers like Walgreens, Rite Aid, and CVS.
We’re passionate about sharing grocery store deals too and help readers to save at checkout by sharing weekly deals from Kroger, ALDI, Costco, and Sam’s Club. And for anyone looking to get their retail therapy on, we’ve got can’t-miss deals from Kohl’s, Old Navy, and Macy’s. Homebodies love the daily deals and discounts we share from The Home Depot, Lowe’s and Bath & Body Works.
When the holiday shopping season is upon us, our team works day and night to share all of the door-busting Black Friday deals and Cyber Monday sales including their full Black Friday ad scans!
Our user-friendly app is easy to navigate with filtering options to shop deals by store, product category, or even peruse our frugal living tips posts. That’s right! Our team of cost-conscious content creators even shares ways for readers to save money in their day-to-day lives, from budgeting advice and money-saving hacks to DIY tips and tricks for reducing household expenses. We even sprinkle in budget-friendly recipes and team-tested product reviews so you can make an educated decision on what is (and isn’t) worth your hard earned dollar.
Find a deal, product review, or helpful post you love? Save it to your My List feed to view again at your convenience. Or if it’s a recipe that caught your eye, keep them organized in your My Recipes feed.
The most notable part of Hip2Save is the Hip community. Engage with other readers in the comments section on posts and feel connected to other deal hunters just like yourself. You may even spot some insightful feedback in the comments to learn a new hack or help in making purchasing decisions.
The Hip2Save app is the ultimate tool for anyone looking to live a more fun and frugal lifestyle, no matter where, or how, they shop.
At Hip2Save, we are passionate about helping you live an extraordinary life on an ordinary budget so download our FREE app and start saving now!

Tired of playing alone, so collect the coolest c
bluejetty:00185855:ios.description:
Block Tech : Epic Sandbox Car Craft Simulator
Online component of the game:
Now the game has become even better, by the numerous requests of the players, we have added a network to the game.
Tired of playing alone, so collect the coolest car and go online, show everyone how cool you are. The main feature of the network game is that there are no restrictions; we have transferred all the features of a regular game to the online world.
Build an unbreakable car. In the game, you can show your skills in building incredible vehicles, for this you have access to more blocks, such as wheels of different types and purposes, turrets, machine guns, rocket launchers, rocket engines, and armor. Fight with opponents on block tech and win, victory will not be easy. The game has two types of events, the first is the derby and in this battle, every man for himself, the opponents will increase their weapon power and speed, so do not lag behind. In the second event, you will find a huge number of tests, here you need to be smart to craft a suitable vehicle for passing.
Tips:
- Do not forget to pick up rewards every day.
- Do not forget to look at the panel of the characteristics of your vehicle.
- Weight affects the speed of movement, do not forget about lightweight blocks, for super fast wheelbarrows.
- The overall strength depends on the strength of each unit, but do not forget to protect the cabin well.
- Power depends on the type of wheels installed, more power is needed. Put more wheels.
- Firepower displays the amount of damage done per second, do not forget that larger guns require more energy.
- Energy, everything is simple, the more, the longer you can shoot, the higher you go, the faster you go, but do not forget that the battery weighs a lot.
- In order not to disassemble your favorite car, save it in the garage in one of the slots, and load it when you need it.
- Rocket boosters can be used both for acceleration and for flight.
- Manage installed cannons, during the battle, you can turn off the voracious cannons to save energy.
- Beat the enemy wheels and he will be defenseless.
- In test mode, you can dig up money for the purchase of new units.
- Use the grenade launcher on slow opponents.
- For a beaten record, you will also receive a reward.
Have a nice game.
Share the game with friends.
Offer your ideas in the comments or email.

Bottle Rover is your go-to alcohol delivery app, making it easier than ever before to search for on-demand liquor, beer, or wine based on your location.

With this liquor, wine, and beer delivery app, you can find a store near you, reserve a bottle, schedule pickup or delivery, get back to the party, and earn rewards for ordering through the app. Make your favorite drinks for your favorite friends, anytime, anywhere.

Bottle Rover Features
          ·    Powerful search and filters: We make it easy for you to find the perfect wine, beer, or liquor selection based on your requirements. Play around with our features until you’re satisfied with the results.
          ·    Detailed descriptions: You don’t have to wonder about the wine you are ordering. You can read all about it right through our on-demand alcohol app.
          ·    Largest selection: Sift through thousands of beers, wines, and liquors by checking out multiple participating stores at once. Reserve a bottle in just seconds.
          ·    Price comparison: We make it easy for you to compare prices relevant to your ordering location.
          ·    Alcohol delivery: Do you need your purchase now? No problem! We offer pickup and delivery options.
          ·    Easy payment: Simply pay with your credit card each time you place an order directly through the app.
          ·    Rewards: Earn rewards each time you reserve a bottle through Bottle Rover.

A Liquor Store in Your Pocket
At Bottle Rover, we are constantly adding new participating stores to our app, so you can find one that is most closely located to you. Order now to find the closest liquor store so you don’t have to worry about picking it up yourself.

How Does Bottle Rover Work?
Step 1: FIND a store near you.
Step 2: ORDER the selection.
Step 3: SCHEDULE pickup or delivery directly from your mobile device.
Step 4: READ about cocktail recipes, wine recommendations, and flash deal offers.

Liquor Recipes
Bottle Rover also provides weekly cocktail recipes that make it easy for you to whip up the drink of your dreams. Learn more about wine recommendations and use our tools to locate hard-to-find products and games.

Best of all: we include liquor deals and flash sales. That’s right – affordable wine is just around the corner.

This liquor delivery tool is perfect for:
          ·    Stocking your bar before or after a gathering
          ·    Sending gifts
          ·    Hosting dinner parties
          ·    Hosting office events
          ·    Hosting tailgates
          ·    Planning pre-games
          ·    Planning after-parties
          ·    Crafting post-work drinks for yourself

Bottle Rover is your liquor delivery one-stop shop. Why wait?! THE PARTY STARTS HERE.

bluejetty:00125633:ios.description:
Transform your iPhone and iPad into a stylish, functional retro flip clock.
Whether you need a sleek desk clock for your workspace, a soothing nightstand clock, or a personalized focus timer, Flip Clock brings classic minimalism and personal flair to your everyday workflow. Perfect for StandBy mode, Lock Screen widgets, and full-screen focus sessions.
◆ Aesthetic Clock and StandBy Mode
- Full-Screen Flip Clock: Vintage flip animation with customizable themes.
- OLED Burn-In Protection: Built-in pixel shifting technology protects your screen during long always-on sessions.
- Show Seconds Everywhere: Real-time seconds display on Home Screen, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and StandBy mode.
- Smart Auto-Launch: Automatically turns into a screensaver when charging.
- 12/24 Hour Formats: Toggle easily with flexible date and calendar displays.
◆ Custom Signatures and Aesthetic Widgets
- Personal Signatures Anywhere: Add custom text, mottoes, or signatures directly in the app and on your Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets.
- Aesthetic Widgets: Beautiful, customizable widgets featuring clock, calendar, and your personal text.
- Multiple Clock Themes: Personalize colors, fonts, and styles for any desk setup.
◆ Focus, Timers and Productivity Tools
- Count-up and Countdown Timers: Flexible stopwatch count-up timers and precise countdown timers for workouts, study sessions, and daily tasks.
- Pomodoro Technique: Stay in the flow zone with integrated study and work interval timers.
- Floating Stopwatch: Keep a live floating timer widget over other apps.
- Event Countdown: Track big upcoming moments like New Year's, exams, birthdays, and holidays.
- White Noise Player: Soothing background sounds to boost concentration or help you sleep.
◆ Smart Alarms and Online Music Ringtones
- Rich Online Music Library: Choose from a wide selection of online music tracks, ambient sounds, and ringtones to wake up your way.
- Smart Volume Control: Alarms that gently wake you up by automatically adjusting volume gradually.
- Hourly Chime: Friendly voice/sound timekeeping on the hour.
Upgrade your desk setup and daily routine today with Flip Clock!

bluejetty:00027386:ios.name: Cardstock: Sports Card Scanner
bluejetty:00027386:ios.summary: With a built-in scanner, value lookup, automatic information detection, checklist tracking, card sorting, flippable cards, beautiful image sharing, infinitely nestable folders, powerful search, iCloud sync support, CSV export, and plentiful
bluejetty:00027386:ios.description:
With a built-in scanner, value lookup, automatic information detection, checklist tracking, card sorting, flippable cards, beautiful image sharing, infinitely nestable folders, powerful search, iCloud sync support, CSV export, and plentiful customization options, Cardstock is the best way to digitally catalog your sports cards. 
Features:
⋅ Scanner
 - The scanner uses the camera to convert your image into a high quality scan.
⋅ Value lookup
 - By using the value lookup, you will be able to see what similar cards have sold for on eBay.
⋅ Automatic information detection
 - Every time a card is scanned, Cardstock searches it and records any useful information found.
⋅ Checklist Tracking
 - Checklists allow you to utilize your collection to track your progress on completing sets.
 - Each time you open a checklist, Cardstock searches for any matching cards and uses them to automatically fill out or create items.
 - Checklist templates uploaded by our team or other users make it easy to add checklists.
⋅ Card Sorting
 - A powerful sort options menu allows you to sort your cards by any number of attributes.
 - Cardstock's ability to sort cards into attribute based groups provides you with new ways to view your collection.
⋅ Flippable cards
 - Cards in your collection can be tapped and flipped to allow viewing of either side.
⋅ Beautiful image sharing
 - Sharing a card creates a stunning image by combining both sides on top of a background chosen from colors generated to match.
⋅ Nestable folders
 - Folders allow cards to be organized in whatever way is best for you.
⋅ Powerful search
 - The search tab allows you to search by any attribute found on a card, checklist, or template.
⋅ iCloud Sync Support
 - Your collection is automatically kept in sync across devices via iCloud.
⋅ CSV export
 - Cards can be exported to a CSV file to give you full control of your data.
⋅ Customization
 - The vast number of settings provided enables you to find what works best for you.
I am an independent app developer and I made this app because I couldn’t find a good app on the App Store to catalog my baseball collection. I have worked really hard to provide an app that is both powerful and aesthetically pleasing. The scanner and automatic information detection make Cardstock the easiest way to digitize your collection, the value lookup is the quickest and most accurate way to estimate the true value of your cards, and the ability to share beautiful images of your cards is unrivaled. If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, don’t hesitate to email me at kyle.fowler@openbraceapps.com.
---

Payment will be applied to your iTunes account on confirmation. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. For more information, see http://www.openbraceapps.com/CardstockPrivacyPolicy/index.html.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026081:ios.description:
Lila’s World: Pretend Play Games for Kids
Play, Explore, Create & Share!
Step into Lila’s World, a fun, safe, and creative pretend play game for kids where imagination comes to life. Join Lila on her summer vacation as she explores her Grandma’s magical house filled with surprises, mystery, and endless play opportunities. Designed for children ages 4 to 10, this open-ended sandbox game lets kids create their own stories, build custom worlds, and play without rules.
EXPLORE A MYSTERIOUS DOLLHOUSE-STYLE HOME
Play as Lila and explore a giant house with secrets hidden in every room.
• Cook meals in the kitchen using real ingredients—combine bread and cheese to make a grilled sandwich, or experiment with complex recipes.
• Read magical books in the library, have tea parties in the living room, or discover what’s hiding in the attic.
• Tap, drag, and interact with almost every object—turn lights on and off, open doors, and move items freely.
• Explore each room like a dollhouse. Every space tells a new story!
Encourages imaginative play, problem-solving, and curiosity.
CREATE YOUR OWN CHARACTERS, SCENES & OBJECTS
Lila’s World is not just about play—it’s also about creativity.
• Use real paper and crayons to draw anything: a character, your favorite toy, a robot, food, or even yourself!
• Take a photo of your drawing and watch it appear inside the game.
• Want a custom world to play in? Draw it and bring it to life instantly.
• Add new furniture, clothes, pets, or even fantasy creatures into the game.
It’s like your own DIY style world, where kids become the creators of their own adventure.
AR MAGIC – BRING DRAWINGS TO LIFE IN THE REAL WORLD
Turn on Augmented Reality (AR) mode and watch your custom characters appear in your real-life environment.
• Bring your paper drawings to life using the power of AR
• Walk around with your drawn creations and interact with them like magic
• A unique way to merge digital play with real-world creativity
Perfect for children who love to draw, imagine, and bring stories to life.
NEW SCENES, STORIES & EVENTS EVERY MONTH
Our game keeps growing with new content added regularly:
• Celebrate holidays from around the world
• Explore new cities and cultures
• Take fun trips to the park, the beach, or even on a pirate ship
• Help Lila plan a birthday party, or go camping with her friends
New updates keep your child engaged while promoting cultural awareness and creativity.
SAFE, OFFLINE & KID-FRIENDLY
• No ads
• No social media
• No data collection
• All user-generated content is reviewed and moderated
• Fully playable offline—great for road trips or flights
• COPPA-compliant and designed with kids’ safety in mind
Parents can feel confident while children enjoy hours of screen time that’s both fun and educational.
PERFECT FOR FANS OF:
• Avatar creation games
• Dress-up games
• Sandbox and dollhouse games
• Drawing, coloring, and DIY creation apps
• Storytelling, roleplay, and virtual world games
Download Lila’s World now and start your pretend play adventure today! Create your own world, tell your own stories, and play without limits—just like in other pretend play games!
Terms of Use: https://photontadpole.com/terms-and-conditions-lila-s-world
Privacy Policy: https://photontadpole.com/privacy-policy-lila-s-world
If you have any questions, you can email us at support@photontadpole.com

bluejetty:00017941:ios.summary: The First State Bank & Trust Company App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute vi
bluejetty:00017941:ios.description:
The First State Bank & Trust Company App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact First State Bank & Trust Company customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the First State Bank & Trust Company App, you must be enrolled as a First State Bank & Trust Company Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00063378:ios.description:
Make animations you're proud to share with FlipaClip, the powerful animation app with a super simple interface.
DISCOVER YOUR UNIQUE ANIMATION STYLE
Whether it's your first sketch or you have been animating for years, FlipaClip gives aspiring and emerging artists the tools to go further than ever before. The latest version was built with our community, and it's the beginning of a bigger evolution.
WHAT’S NEW IN THE LATEST VERSION
• Two Layouts, Your Call: Keep the familiar Classic layout for drawing, or open Studio to see every layer and audio track at once. Switch any time, and your project stays exactly the same.
• New Timeline: See your drawings, frames, images, videos, and sound together in one view, and adjust timing and order in one place.
• Frame Controls: Drag a frame to hold a drawing for as long as you need, without copying it again and again.
• A First Look at Groups: Group frames, then stretch the group to repeat or loop it. Hold a pose or a background for any length in one move.
• Draw Outside the Canvas: Keep sketches, references, and spare parts just outside the frame, right where you need them.
• Undo Everything: Undo now reaches your whole project, even a deleted frame or layer, so you can try the risky idea.
• Faster & Lighter: Everything's quicker, and your projects take up less room on your device.
EASY TUTORIALS
• Learn with guided how-to content and get inspired: Access tutorials and join our community for inspiration and guidance.
POWERFUL AND INTUITIVE ANIMATION TOOLS
• Art Tools: Use a variety of brushes, lasso, fill, eraser, ruler, mirror tool, and text. Draw on custom canvas sizes with Apple Pencil support.
• Animation Layers: Animate like a pro with 3 free layers, or unlimited layers with FlipaClip Plus. Try blending modes, clipping masks, alpha lock, glow effect and Pixel Effect for free.
• Add Audio: Add sound effects, voiceovers, and music tracks. Edit your sound right on the timeline in the Studio layout. Record your own voice for dialogue and import personal audio files. Explore our curated sound effects packages, or type your dialogue and pick a character voice with Voice Maker.
• Blur & Smudge Tools: Soften and blend your drawings.
• Magic Cut AI Tool: Cut out any image with AI.
FRAME-BY-FRAME ANIMATION MADE SIMPLE
• Onion Skin: See the frames before and after the one you're drawing.
• Scrubber: Move through your animation to check the timing as you go.
• Overlay Grid: Align and frame your drawings accurately.
PERSONALIZED EXPERIENCE
• Dark and Light Mode: Customize your app's appearance.
• Organize Projects: Stack projects and manage them efficiently.
• Move Your Tools: Move the draw tools bar around the stage to free up drawing space.
• Drag & Rearrange Tools: Customize your layout by dragging and rearranging tool icons for the perfect setup.
CREATORS MAKING ALL KINDS OF ANIMATION STYLES
Creators use FlipaClip for cartoons, memes, anime, stick figures, stop motion, Gacha, fan art, music videos, animals, and gaming characters.
COMMUNITY AND SHARING
• Join a Thriving Community: Share your animations with a global audience.
• Participate in Challenges: Win exciting prizes in various contests.
• Social Media Integration: Post directly to TikTok and YouTube, or share anywhere else from your device.
INSERT PHOTOS & VIDEOS
• Animate on top of images or videos: Trace over video footage, sync your animation to its sound, and drop images onto your canvas.
SAVE AND SHARE
• Multiple Export Options: Save your work as MP4 or GIF, or as a PNG sequence with FlipaClip Plus.
WATCH ANIMATED SHORTS
• Streaming Feature: Enjoy a selection of curated animated short movies created by our community.
Join millions of FlipaClip creators and share your unique animated stories.
SUPPORT AND COMMUNITY
• Website: www.flipaclip.com
• Support: support.flipaclip.com
• Discord: discord.com/invite/flipaclip

bluejetty:00147556:ios.description:
Na Robotton, nós cuidamos. E o nosso ""cuidar"" passa por trazer melhorias ao dia a dia dos nossos clientes que envolvem finanças, tecnologias e boas práticas de convivência.
Quem vive em condomínios administrados pela Robotton conta com uma plataforma online (boletos, prestação de contas, solicitações, comunicação, etc). Quando automatizamos o dia a dia do condomínio, o corpo diretivo passa a ter mais tempo para atuar em conjunto com a assessoria condominial em questões significantes como redução de custos, melhor aproveitamento dos espaços, melhoria dos procedimentos, aumento da segurança, manutenção predial, etc. 
Tanto pelo site da Robotton quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Robotton, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente.
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Os recursos variam conforme plano habilitado e viabilidade técnica. Consulte condições. 
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para aplicativo@robotton.com.br

bluejetty:00131861:ios.description:
Welcome to Bambino, the future of babysitting that’s got you covered from start to finish! Bambino is the one-stop, intuitive app you’ve been eagerly anticipating - the perfect solution to all your babysitting needs.
We’ve reimagined the way you discover trusted babysitters right within your neighborhood! Join the Bambino community and easily find, book, and pay local sitters recommended by friends and neighbors, all with the tap of an app.
When you’re in need of a babysitter for some me-time, we-time, or free-time, all you have to do is create a request, enter the time and date, select sitters, and send!
Your sitters will accept based on their availability, and you confirm the sitter that is the best fit for your family and voilà! You are booked!
If you’re a babysitter looking for flexible work, we’ve got something for you too. Earn some money, pick your work hours, and enjoy babysitting for local, verified families. Bambino also plays as your personal cheerleader by promoting you to families in your area.
Feature highlights:
- Quick and easy bookings
- Access to a wealth of local sitters
- View recommendations from friends and neighbors through robust sitter profiles
- Transparent, standardized rates
- Convenient in-app payments using Stripe as our payment processor
Bambino is a free-to-download app available from coast to coast in the US. While the basic functionalities come at no cost, you can opt for our in-app Premium memberships for an enhanced experience. Join the Bambino family and experience the hassle-free babysitting solution!
Learn more about Bambino, our safety standards, and our levels of membership through the FAQs on our website, what we are doing to keep our community safe, and how our levels of membership work www.bambinositters.com
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://www.bambinositters.com/privacypolicy/

bluejetty:00063047:ios.description:
BOUNTY IS THE EASIEST AND SAFEST WAY TO EARN MONEY!
With Bounty, you can answer simple surveys and earn money while walking outside or sitting on your couch at home.
Traveling, taking photos, shopping, talking to people... These are activities you do every day. Why not make money while doing these? 
You can pay for your grocery shopping, shoes, clothes, or a dinner out with the earnings that you can get with Bounty.
HOW CAN I MAKE MONEY?
How does the process work on Bounty?
• Download Bounty to your phone and become a member,
• Look at the surveys that are suitable for you and choose what you want to do,
• Read the survey details and complete it,
• Let the survey be approved and then your money will be added to your balance,
• Send a withdrawal request, your money will be credited to your account the next Friday!
WHAT KIND OF SURVEYS ARE ON BOUNTY?
There are many different surveys waiting for you on Bounty! Some require you to go somewhere, and some you can do from where you sit. So, what kind of things can you do with the surveys?
• Filling out a simple questionnaire
• Commenting on the products you use in your daily life
• Walking into a store and taking a photo
• Taking a photo of a product shelf in the market
• Going to a restaurant or cafe and evaluating the service offered
• Going to a store as a customer and inspecting the service quality
SECURITY
All the personal information you share with Bounty is not shared with any other company. Location information is only used to deliver the surveys around you and check the accuracy of the location.
You can be one of the millions of people who downloaded the Bounty app and earn cash every week. All you have to do is become a member and start earning by answering simple surveys!
For more information, you can visit the page http://www.getbounty.co/en
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00151591:ios.name: Pito - پیتۆ
bluejetty:00151591:ios.summary:
28 games. 1 Kurdish app. 700,000+ players.
Pito is the home of Kurdish gaming — from word puzzles and board games to wild party nights with friends. Play, chat and call each other, all in one app, in Sorani, Badini or English.
THE GAMES ―
bluejetty:00151591:ios.description:
28 games. 1 Kurdish app. 700,000+ players.
Pito is the home of Kurdish gaming — from word puzzles and board games to wild party nights with friends. Play, chat and call each other, all in one app, in Sorani, Badini or English.
THE GAMES ――――――――――――
PITOPOLY (پیتۆپۆلی) — NEW
The property board game, set in Kurdistan. Buy famous places, build and trade. Ranked online, rooms for up to 6 friends, or play the bots.
FINGER BALL (تۆپی پەنجە)
Football with a flick of your finger. Ranked online, friend rooms, voice and chat, and a dressing room for your team.
وێنەکەم (DRAW AND GUESS)
One player draws, everyone else races to guess the word. Online or in a private room with friends.
BILIARD
The Kurdish pool hall: tea-house rules, 9-ball and 8-ball. Ranked 1v1 and 2v2, friend rooms with house rules, pass and play, and a practice bot.
PITO WORD
Guess the hidden Kurdish word in 6 tries. 887 words across 28+ categories.
TAWLA
The classic Kurdish board game, with real 3D dice. Online with full ranking, versus the AI, or a friend on one screen.
OKEY
The classic tile game, online. Friends or random opponents, full ranking, Concan mode, vs-computer play and 22 tile looks.
DOMINO · AZNIF
Classic domino 1v1 or 2v2, and Aznif, the 4-seat partnership game. Online with full ranking, or vs the computer.
CHESS · DAMA · BARRICADE
Ranked chess across four time controls, Kurdish draughts with flying kings, and the wall-building race. Friend challenges and bots.
SNAKE & LADDER
The classic race, with the rules Kurdish families play by. 2–4 players, online or on one phone.
FAMILY AND PARTY GAMES
Two Truths & a Lie, Who's Most Likely?, Stop the Clock!, Karti Pêkenîn, Guess the Impostor, Mafia, No Talking and Bomber — one phone, passed around the room.
SOLITAIRE · SUDOKU · 2048 · MÊWEKAN · TELAR · XRO · HELO
Card and puzzle favourites, each with a global leaderboard.
CLIMB THE RANKS ――――――――――――
Levels and monthly seasons (from 1 December): a level in every ranked game that only goes up, and a fresh season board each month next to the all-time one. The top 10 of every game win a month of Pito Plus.
Tournaments (coming soon): a tournament every night, a big one on Fridays, the Champions' Cup and 3 Lives. Free to enter, with a trophy cabinet that keeps your cups.
The Pito Path: play ranked games and collect a new path of rewards every season — a free row for everyone, and a gold row you can unlock with coins.
FEATURES ――――――――――――
Sorani, Badini or English — change the app's language any time in Settings
Game menus that fit on one screen, and layouts made for tablets and foldable phones
Voice calls and group voice chats with the people you play with
Chat and group chats — photos, videos, voice notes, stickers, GIFs and disappearing messages
Stories with friends, in photos and videos; Spotlight for ages 13+
Friends — add by code, see who's online, invite to any online game
Kids mode — a parent chooses what's allowed, behind a code
Ranked ladders for 11 online games, and global leaderboards
Make it yours — avatar frames, name styles, profile backgrounds, board themes, app colours and icons
Pito Plus — your badge changes colour the longer you're a member
Help from the Pito team inside the app
Free sign-in required; many games work offline after that
Free to download, free to play. All 28 games are free — nothing behind a paywall. Optional Pito Plus and cosmetics let you personalize and support Pito, but you never need to spend a thing.
Pito is not gambling or real-money gaming. There are no paid-entry games, wagers, cash-out, cash prizes or redeemable prizes. Tournaments are free to enter. Optional Pito Coins are bought as in-app purchases and used only inside Pito — for cosmetics, gifts, a fixed-term Pito Plus membership and small in-game extras; they cannot be staked, sold, withdrawn or exchanged for money.

bluejetty:00137794:ios.description:
Ketchup is full featured *creature encyclopaedia* app that will help you become a true master of a specific series of games.
It’s fast and easy to browse or search for all the information you could ask for, whether you’re just brushing up or you’re in the heat of battle and need to know the right move, right now.
Catch ’em all
You can track what creatures you’ve captured, including whether or not you’ve caught their rare shiny variants. 
Type Calculator 
It includes a type calculator, helping you get the edge in battle.
Daily Quiz
Every day Ketchup shows a new quiz, to see if you can guess creatures based on their silhouettes. I think fans of the anime will enjoy this a lot.
Ketchup+
Ketchup is free to use but only shows information for the original 151 creatures unless you purchase Ketchup+
I hope you enjoy using Ketchup as much as I’ve enjoyed building it.
Ben

bluejetty:00135724:ios.summary:
Are you tired of the same old squares, cubes, blocks, and bubbles? 
Discover "Voro”, a completely original, unique, fresh, and engaging puzzle game that redefines the genre. 
What sets Voro apart?
* Innovative Gameplay: Dive into a novel
bluejetty:00135724:ios.description:
Are you tired of the same old squares, cubes, blocks, and bubbles? 
Discover "Voro”, a completely original, unique, fresh, and engaging puzzle game that redefines the genre. 
What sets Voro apart?
* Innovative Gameplay: Dive into a novel concept with gameplay unlike anything you've experienced before.
* Elegant Simplicity: Explore an abstract, geometric world, free from unnecessary distractions.
* Intuitive Controls: Effortlessly drag tiles with a single finger.
* Easy to Learn: Grasp the simple gameplay in just a few seconds – it's intuitive and accessible.
* Endless Replayability: With each session, you'll find new challenges and reasons to come back for more. 
Experience a New Twist:
Say goodbye to conventional puzzles! Voro challenges you with free-form shapes and non-traditional geometry, offering a unique twist that keeps your mind engaged. 
Enjoy the freedom of moving tiles across the board in a fluid, organic way, as you delve into a world where colors blend and strategies evolve. Voro brings countless hours of fresh and engaging fun, stimulating both sides of your brain. 
Ready to Challenge Yourself?
Embark on this captivating journey with Voro and enjoy a puzzle experience like no other. Let your brain revel in the joy of discovery and strategy!

bluejetty:00153893:ios.name: Car Driving Multiplayer
bluejetty:00153893:ios.summary:
Drive, race, customize and tune cars in the most realistic and massive open world driving simulator.
Car Driving Multiplayer is the ultimate open world driving experience, built for car lovers and racing enthusiasts!
Get ready to drive man
bluejetty:00153893:ios.description:
Drive, race, customize and tune cars in the most realistic and massive open world driving simulator.
Car Driving Multiplayer is the ultimate open world driving experience, built for car lovers and racing enthusiasts!
Get ready to drive many different cars! Choose from a wide range of highly detailed cars, from sleek sports cars to powerful SUVs. 
Explore a massive open world in Car Driving Multiplayer, filled with detailed environments, from smooth asphalt highways to rugged dirt trails. 
You can customise your car, upgrade the engines, tune the suspension, and create the ultimate machine for every kind of race - from open-world drag sprints to high-speed chases. 
Each vehicle offers a unique driving feel, letting you master your driving skills!
Car Driving Multiplayer lets you drive freely, join real-time multiplayer meetups and test your driving skills in intense races against players from around the world.
Realistic physics, roaring engines, and lifelike asphalt dynamics make every drive feel authentic. Feel the thrill of every race, whether you're cruising at top speed or battling it out in head-to-head car racing duels. 
Car Driving Multiplayer offers endless roads to explore and stories to create.
Open World Multiplayer
- Join thousands of players around the globe in real time.
- Enjoy Realistic physics, detailed environments, and immersive sound design.
- Host meetups, make new friends and show off your rides.
- Drive together or just explore the massive open world solo.
- Race with friends and peers in real time.
- Pump gas into your cars in real gas stations.
- Discover hidden spots across a richly crafted map.
- Complete daily and weekly challenges to earn big rewards.
- Interiors and environments are crafted with care to deliver a realistic car driving simulator experience.
Fully Customizable Cars and Drivers
- Choose and tune different cars exactly how you want it.
- Adjustable suspension, wheel angle and more.
- Modify engines, exhausts, gearbox, turbo and more for the perfect car performance.
- Transform your ride with different car parts and full body kits.
- Customize the driver with different outfits and skins.
- Choose from dozens of animations and reactions for your driver to stand out in every meet-up.
Download Car Driving Multiplayer to customize your car, master the art of driving, and conquer every race horizon that lies ahead!
Start your engines - adventure is just around the corner!
Important Information:
• Includes optional in-app purchases, including random items
• Reward probabilities are shown in-game before purchase
• Containers/Loot Boxes can be earned or bought using in-game currency
• Duplicate rewards may be converted into in-game currency
• Virtual items have no real-world monetary value and cannot be exchanged for real money

With the Pull&Bear app, you’ll have full access to the store, where you can shop for clothes online and discover the latest seasonal trends and new arrivals for women and men, plus accessories to complete any look.
Discover new collections
bluejetty:00071074:ios.description:
With the Pull&Bear app, you’ll have full access to the store, where you can shop for clothes online and discover the latest seasonal trends and new arrivals for women and men, plus accessories to complete any look.
Discover new collections, get inspired by the latest trends and create outfits with personality straight from the app. Enjoy quick, direct access to all Pull&Bear collections at any time and choose your favourite pieces from the comfort of your home.
Everything you can do in the app:
- PBShuffle – An innovative video shopping experience for discovering and buying looks directly from inspiration.
- Wishlist – Create a wishlist and save the products you like most. Don’t let your favourites get away!
- Geolocation – Find the nearest PULL&BEAR store and other collection points. You can also see their location on the map.
- Personalisation – Product recommendations tailored to your tastes.
- Fashion trends – Get inspired by the latest arrivals every week and by our editorials.
For her, discover pieces that define every season: baggy jeans, knitwear, striped T-shirts, loafers, boots, faux-leather jackets and elevated basics for creating looks with personality.
For him, explore urban-inspired pieces made for everyday life: denim, trousers, overshirts, jumpers, sneakers and comfy clothes that work for any plan.
Alongside the coolest fashion, the Pull&Bear app invites you to explore a wide range of accessories for women and men. Find bags, scarves, caps, jewellery, phone cases and much more. With quick, direct access, you can browse all Pull&Bear collections at any time and choose your favourite pieces in just a few clicks, all from the comfort of home.
Download the Pull&Bear app and discover a new way to shop for fashion online!

bluejetty:00179164:ios.description:
Survival RPG: Open World is a free 2D pixel RPG game (Role Playing Games) set in a fantasy retro style open world. Rediscover your favorite medieval places (castles, dungeons, temples), warriors and monsters (dinosaurs, sharks, wizards) from the retro 2D pixel Survival RPG series in a new exploration survival game! It can also be played offline.
This time you create your own story: you decide where you go and what you do. Your quest is to become a warrior to survive, explore, fight monsters in this medieval open world. Build shelters, find food and water, explore dungeons and castles, craft armors and swords and mine precious metals. In this game, you can also build your own houses, farm and harvest food and craft a ship to conquer the ocean and fight sea monsters like sharks. Watch out for danger, fight monsters and search for treasure chests along the way.
To explore and survive your epic quest :
- Plant forests, craft houses and decorate them
- Discover hidden objects in caves, dungeons, medieval castles, temples
- Go on a treasure hunt with treasure maps
- Build shelters and campfire, farm and harvest food
- Craft bridges and tools to explore dungeons, islands, deserts, jungles, oceans 
- Build ship to conquer the ocean and fight sea monsters like sharks
- Fight dragons, dinosaurs, wizards and other monsters 
- Lots of warriors’ armors, weapons, swords, and other gear to craft
- Craft recipes that will unlock during your quest and exploration
- Mine precious metals like gold and silver
- Several quests offered by RPG characters
- 2D pixel RPG game (Role Playing games) 
- Free offline retro game 
Enjoy Survival RPG: Open World, an epic free 2D pixel RPG game (Role Playing Games) of exploration, survival and quest! Hours of play in this retro 2D pixel RPG game of warriors against monsters. 
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/survivaladventurethegame/

bluejetty:00133624:ios.name: Construction Calc Lite
bluejetty:00133624:ios.summary:
Designed by tradespeople, for tradespeople. Construction Calc Lite handles the heavy lifting of jobsite math—fractions, dimensional conversions, framing, and layout—so you can focus on the build.
Whether you're a carpenter, concrete finish
bluejetty:00133624:ios.description:
Designed by tradespeople, for tradespeople. Construction Calc Lite handles the heavy lifting of jobsite math—fractions, dimensional conversions, framing, and layout—so you can focus on the build.
Whether you're a carpenter, concrete finisher, framer, superintendent, or DIYer, Construction Calc Lite delivers fast, accurate jobsite calculations with zero guesswork.
WHY TRADES CHOOSE CONSTRUCTION CALC
• True Feet-Inch-Fraction Math: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide in full dimensional fractions down to 1/16th (or user-set precision) with automatic reduction.
• Seamless Unit Switching: Effortlessly mix Imperial and Metric. Convert feet-inch-fractions to meters, centimeters, or millimeters in a single tap.
• Split-Screen Display: View decimal values, feet/inch fractions, memory registers, and scale factors simultaneously in large, high-visibility text.
• Visual Cut & Layout Solvers: Dedicated modules for right triangles, miters, arcs, and baluster spacing complete with clear visual diagrams.
• 50 Memory Registers & Full History: Never lose a cut list or measurement. Easily recall previous calculations on the fly.
DEDICATED MODULES FOR EVERY TRADE
• Framing & Layout: Calculate stud, fence post, and baluster spacing (horizontal, angled, or circular).
• Miters & Trim: Visual miter and bevel angle calculator for crown molding and finish carpentry.
• Geometry & Stairs: Instant solutions for right triangles, diagonals, rafter lengths, arcs, and chords.
• Concrete, Volume & Area: Quickly calculate slab volume, footings, room square footage, and block/tank capacities.
• Materials & Coverage: Estimate drywall sheets, tile, paint, and material costs with built-in waste allowances.
• Smart Blueprint Scaling: Instantly scale plan drawings up or down to true field dimensions.
BUILT FOR THE JOBSITE
• High-Contrast Display: Large, legible fonts engineered for bright outdoor sunlight or dark crawl spaces.
• Works 100% Offline: No cell service required on remote sites.

bluejetty:00153686:ios.summary: This is a unique casual puzzle game! Here, you will play the role of a skilled craftsman and challenge various complex 3D screw-tightening levels. Choose beautiful furniture and decorate your house! Create your dream home! As the game progr
bluejetty:00153686:ios.description:
This is a unique casual puzzle game! Here, you will play the role of a skilled craftsman and challenge various complex 3D screw-tightening levels. Choose beautiful furniture and decorate your house! Create your dream home! As the game progresses, you will not only experience more and more exquisite 3D models, but also unlock a variety of practical props to help you easily cope with every difficulty.
Gameplay:
Use your ingenuity to unlock screws and match them to the tool box of the same color. Unlock all the screws of various complex models and finally pass the level!
Game highlights:
- Extreme 3D visual experience: Every screw and every detail has been carefully designed to bring you an immersive operating experience.
- Rich and diverse level design: From basic entry to professional challenges, gradually improve your skill level to meet the needs of players at different levels.
- New 3D models are constantly added: As the level goes deeper, more 3D models with unique shapes and complex structures are waiting for your exploration.
- A variety of auxiliary props for you to choose: electric drills, wrenches and other tools can be used at will to solve difficult problems.
- Relaxed and pleasant game atmosphere: soothing background music and interesting gameplay, let you find your own relaxation time after intense work and study.
Whether you are a screw lover or a player who simply pursues novelty, this will bring you endless fun and challenges. Let us start this wonderful craftsman journey together!

bluejetty:00062820:ios.summary:
Unwinding Anxiety® is an evidence-based app designed to help you reduce anxiety, stress, and worry, so you can feel calmer, sleep better, and live with more confidence. 
Clinically proven to reduce anxiety by 67% after 2 months* of use, Un
bluejetty:00062820:ios.description:
Unwinding Anxiety® is an evidence-based app designed to help you reduce anxiety, stress, and worry, so you can feel calmer, sleep better, and live with more confidence. 
Clinically proven to reduce anxiety by 67% after 2 months* of use, Unwinding Anxiety combines the latest neuroscience with the power of mindfulness to help you break the cycle of fear, stress, and anxious thoughts. Whether you’re struggling with panic, social anxiety, or everyday stress, the Unwinding Anxiety app gives you practical tools to find relief. 
Join Unwinding Anxiety to… 
• Identify habits that keep you stuck in the anxiety loop. 
• Learn how to ride the waves of anxiety by deepening your mind-body awareness. 
• Practice short moments, many times to build helpful habits. 
• Connect with a community of like-minded people through live calls and the online forum. 
• Sleep better, feel more confident, and increase your capacity to find joy in every moment. 
With Unwinding Anxiety, you will receive: 
• Daily guided lessons 
• In-app stress and worry tools 
• Mindfulness exercises, theme weeks, and bonus content 
• Access to live weekly calls with habit change experts 
• Online community forum and journal 
• Customizable goals and reminders 
For individuals, Unwinding Anxiety offers a 7-day free trial and subscription plans. On the 7th day of your free trial, your subscription will officially begin. 
Subscription plans: 
1-month: $29.99 USD 
6-month: $139.99 USD 
1-year: $209.99 USD 
Unwinding Anxiety can also be accessed through employer, health plan, or public sector programs. Contact us at Sharecare to learn how you can provide Unwinding Anxiety to your population. 
*PRICING & TERMS 
All prices are for U.S. customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and may be converted to your local currency. 
Your Unwinding Anxiety subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes Account Settings, but refunds will not be provided for the unused portion of the term. 
Need help with the app? Please email support@unwindinganxiety.com 
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://www.sharecare.com/terms/privacypolicy 
*For scientific references: https://www.jmir.org/2021/12/e26987

bluejetty:00200128:ios.name: Flipcorder: Retro Camcorder
bluejetty:00200128:ios.summary: Flipcorder helps you capture everyday life like an old home video, bringing a delightful retro twist to your memories. It's built for those who love the nostalgic charm of a retro camcorder and want to document their moments without fuss.
bluejetty:00200128:ios.description:
Flipcorder helps you capture everyday life like an old home video, bringing a delightful retro twist to your memories. It's built for those who love the nostalgic charm of a retro camcorder and want to document their moments without fuss.
Record Daily Flips
• Experience the unique daily tape, where everything you film lands on today’s dated 30-minute cassette, ordered chronologically for a true retro camcorder feel.
• Easily record 20-second “flips” with a simple tap, each stopping and saving automatically with a calm countdown.
• You always have control to record longer flips, but the day's tape is always limited to 30 minutes.
One Unedited Home Movie
• Relive your day as a single, unedited home movie, playing back exactly as you filmed it - authentic video the way it used to be.
• Apply classic VHS looks with bleeding color, tracking wobble, and a date stamp, or choose the crisp, clean aesthetic of MiniDV to your footage.
• Change a tape’s look at any time thanks to the untouched original footage, giving you complete control over your aesthetic.
Save and Share Memories
• Save your whole tape to Photos as one movie with a title card, either with the chosen camcorder look rendered in or as clean 1080p video, making sharing effortless.
• Enjoy gentle reminders you can turn on, with an afternoon nudge if today’s tape is blank and an evening note when it’s ready, helping you never miss a moment without guilt.
• Take control of your home screen with widgets that show today’s tape as a cassette, allowing one tap to open the camcorder or play your day’s movie.
Built for iPhone Duo
• Unlock exclusive features for iPhone Duo, where the fold acts as the power switch, a camera lens is on the cover, and the subject sees a live retro preview with a REC light on the outer screen.
• Close your iPhone Duo to instantly save a flip, simplifying your recording process and keeping you focused on the moment.
Flipcorder is a one time purchase, with no subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, or accounts. Your videos stay solely on your phone.
Open Flipcorder tomorrow morning and make your first home movie memory.

iCSee Home Introduction: iCSee Home (original name：JLink) is an intelligent IoT app centered around video V+IOT technology.
iCSee Home allows users to control all hardware devices and connect to third-party smart speakers, providing a comprehensive solution for intelligent living. The app supports a variety of smart devices, including pet feeders and smart door locks. Users can remotely control pet feeders, schedule feeding times, and monitor their pets’ eating habits to ensure their well-being. The smart door lock feature enables users to manage door access remotely, offering keyless entry and enhanced home security. iCSee Home allows you to control devices anytime, anywhere, and monitor the status of home devices in real time, while sharing smart devices with family and friends to create personalized smart living scenarios.
Note： iCSee Home is the new name for the former JLink , with all features and experiences remaining the same.

bluejetty:00073371:ios.name: Outsmarted - Companion App
bluejetty:00073371:ios.summary:
The companion app for the hit Outsmarted board game – the live quiz show for families and friends. The app hosts the show and asks all the questions – get ready for the next level in immersive, exciting family entertainment.
KEY FEATURES
bluejetty:00073371:ios.description:
The companion app for the hit Outsmarted board game – the live quiz show for families and friends. The app hosts the show and asks all the questions – get ready for the next level in immersive, exciting family entertainment.
KEY FEATURES
 • Fair for all ages – Difficulty auto-adjusts by age, so kids, teens and adults can all win.
 • 10,000+ questions – A huge bank featuring images, song clips and video for real quiz-show drama.
 • Always up to date – Fresh content added regularly, including a Breaking News category.
 • Play together, anywhere – Invite friends and family to join your game remotely from their own devices.
 • Endless variety – 10 core categories plus 100+ optional add-on categories for a vast library of content.
 • Pick up & play – The app hosts the show – learn to play in just a couple of minutes.
HOW IT WORKS
Roll, move and get ready for your question! It’s a race around the board to collect the 6 Rings of Knowledge before tackling the tense Final Round. Play as individuals or in teams as your Apple device becomes a quiz controller.
GOOD TO KNOW
 • Requires the Outsmarted board game (sold separately).
 • Internet connection required.
 • Supports up to six connected devices (locally or remotely).
 • Optional in-app purchases for add-on categories.

Join your friends on Facebook and millions of other coins masters around the world in this online multiplayer game Age of Coins: Master of Spins! Organise attacks, spin the wheel and raid, and develop your epoch!
Welcome to Age Of Coins: Master Of Spins - a puzzle, dice and adventure game that will guide you through the most powerful kingdoms and epochs in history. Can you cross the annals of time and the lands of magical countries, the lands of dreams, to become the best pirate, hippie, king, warrior or coin master that we have ever known?
Play this game solo and spin the wheel to win coins or join your friends on a quest to your kingdom greatness in one of the most addictive coin games of your dreams! The more spins you make, the more coins you will win!
Spin the wheel
Spin the wheel to collect your loot and discover what fate has in store for you in this game, be it attack, raid, shield or coins. Earn the coins by falling on coins or bags of gold, and you can build great epochs and become the coin master. Collect shields to protect your epoch from other players who want to attack you. Become the coin master and create the strongest kingdom of dreams where the biggest loot hides!
Go on attacks and raid your friends
Collecting coins through the spins is not the only way to collect loot, you can also steal it from other kingdoms! Attack or raid your friends and enemies to accumulate enough coins to develop your epoch. While they’re having dreams, take revenge on those who attacked your epoch and claim what is rightfully yours! Who knows what treasures you'll find in another player's epochs!
Collect puzzles
Loot is not everything! Collect puzzle pieces from different epochs to get bonuses and extra coins. Find puzzle pieces in magic chests, ask your friends for them or complete special tasks. For each completed puzzle, you can get a valuable bonus.
Roll the dice
Dreams come true with the coins you earn by rolling the dice. Build amazing kingdoms and earn amazing bonuses in the dice game.

Doughnuts 123 is part of Kido+, a subs
bluejetty:00141507:ios.description:
Doughnuts 123: Fun & Educational Learning Game for Kids!
*** Our games are very safe—No Ads, No purchases. At Kido, our goal is to create the perfect experience for your kids (and ours) to enjoy! ***
Doughnuts 123 is part of Kido+, a subscription service that gives your family access to endless hours of playtime and educational activities.
Spark your child’s imagination with a creative game where they can learn to count from 1 to 10 while baking delicious doughnuts!
Welcome to Doughnuts 123, the ultimate game where kids get to combine their love for doughnuts with learning numbers! Designed specifically for young learners, this engaging and interactive app allows children to create sweet doughnuts in the shape of different numbers while practicing how to write them.
Key Features:
Educational & Fun: Doughnuts 123 merges education with entertainment! Kids will love making doughnut shaped numbers, turning learning into a tasty adventure. As they craft their number-shaped doughnuts, they'll get hands-on practice with writing and recognizing each number.
Ad-Free Experience: We believe in a distraction-free learning environment. Doughnuts 123 is 100% ad-free, so your child can focus solely on their fun and educational experience without interruptions.
Interactive Gameplay: The game features intuitive controls and colorful graphics that are sure to capture your child's attention. Each number is a new doughnut-making challenge, helping kids develop fine motor skills and number recognition through play.
Skill Development: As kids create their doughnut numbers, they’ll improve their writing skills, learn number formation, and enhance their cognitive abilities. The interactive nature of the game makes learning feel like a fun and rewarding activity!
Safe & Kid-Friendly: We’ve designed Doughnuts 123 with your child’s safety in mind. The game’s user interface is easy to navigate, ensuring that kids can enjoy their learning adventure without any frustration.
Doughnuts 123 is the perfect educational tool for preschoolers and young children. By blending creativity with learning, we ensure that kids are not only having fun but also building essential early literacy skills. Download Doughnuts 123 today and watch your child’s love for learning grow with every number-shaped doughnut they create! 
We at Kido Games aspire to bring your kids hours of continuous fun with the safety of your kids as our first priority.
The Kido experience is and will always be Ad free and does not require in-app purchases to progress in the game. We are proud to be COPPA compliant which ensures you we meet the highest industry standards when it comes to your children’s online presence.
The Kido Experience opens the door to endless hours of fun for your kids, games that are focused on their creativity, allowing them to express themselves and experiment with different skills and activities.
Please visit our website: https://www.kidoverse.net/
Terms of service: https://www.kidoverse.net/terms-of-service
Privacy notice: https://www.kidoverse.net/privacy-notice

bluejetty:00021023:ios.description:
Get ready for a relaxing voyage with letters and words with Word Voyage. From the creators of Word Pearls and Brain Test games. This is an offline word game. Enjoy the thrill of becoming a word explorer, navigating through word puzzles and saying wow! at every discovery.
Take a tour around the world as you visit cities and landmarks. Solve fun word search puzzles and complete crosswords. Train your brain in order to find hidden words and meanings. Find words you have never heard before and expand your vocabulary. This word puzzle game has thousands of words for you to learn. New games with offline game features. Play word games for free, perfect for adults looking to challenge their vocabulary with engaging word puzzles.
Develop new skills and increase your memory power with delightful word search problems. With thousands of addicting word search puzzle levels, you will not realize how fast time passes. • Complete words using straight and diagonal lines

• Scaling difficulty and enlarging board size systems
• Plenty of booster options to make things easier
• Explore new cities and visit landmarks
• Great exercise for brain and memory skills
• Bonus points for hidden words
• Thousands of levels and frequent new level updates
• Completely free to play
• Can be played offline
It is time to delve into the meditative world of word puzzles and search for thousands of words!

NetFic is like a Kindle or a virtual bookstore, enabling you to carry your favorite stories in your pocket to the fullest extent and enjoy reading online novels.

This is an application tailor-made for online novel enthusiasts around the globe.
Install the NetFic app and embark on your reading journey. Whether you're stuck in traffic, winding down after a busy workday, or seeking some bedtime entertainment, NetFic will bring the most popular reads right to your fingertips.
Boasting a broad spectrum of book genres, NetFic allows you the freedom to choose from hundreds of online novels, each with over a million reads.

bluejetty:00032617:ios.description:
Any MP3 Player - Redefining Your Music Experience
Envelop your senses in a musical escapade with Any Music Player, the next-gen music player exclusively designed for the discerning iOS user. 
Our app promises to deliver an acoustic adventure that's as intuitive as it is innovative. 
Serving up a seamless blend of high-fidelity playback and all-encompassing organizational features, 
Any Music Player isn't just a music player; it's the embodiment of your personal concert hall, right in your pocket.
With Any MP3 Player, you can:
1. Instantly import media from various sources.
2. Convert files to optimal formats for smooth playback.
3. Enjoy your personalized video and music collection on the go.
4. Experience high-fidelity audio and crisp video quality.
5. Streamline your media library with intuitive organization.
Any MP3 Player's interface invites you into a world where music takes the forefront. With a clean, responsive design, navigating your ample library of tunes is as simple as a tap, swipe, or voice command. 
We've fine-tuned every interaction to ensure that your journey through your playlists, albums, and tracks is a sonic joyride.
Import and Compatibility:Gone are the days of compatibility woes.
Any Music Player natively supports a wide variety of formats, allowing you to import your existing video and music collection effortlessly. Our built-in conversion tool works in the background, making every file ready for playback in moments, ensuring you have more time to enjoy your media.
Features:
Superior Sound Quality:Whether you're a casual listener or an audiophile, Any Music Player's advanced audio engine ensures each note in your song is rendered in the utmost clarity. Delve into a tailor-made acoustic setting with our custom equalizer and discover the subtle nuances in your favorite tracks.
Offline Playback:With Any Music Player, your music is always with you, online or offline. Download your preferred albums or playlists and enjoy uninterrupted listening anytime, anywhere.
Smart Organization:Your music collection is as unique as you are. Any Music Player offers dynamic organization options. Sort by artist, genre, mood, or create custom playlists. Utilize our intelligent tagging system to categorize your music your way.
Lyrics and Artwork:Each song comes to life with synchronized lyrics and beautiful artwork. Get the full story behind every melody with rich bios and lyrics for the complete audiovisual experience.
Social Sharing:Share the soundtrack of your life with friends or find out what's trending. Any Music Player integrates with social platforms to let you easily post what you're listening to or discover new hits from your social circle.
Seamless Integration:Use Any Music Player across all your Apple devices. With iCloud support, your music collection and preferences sync flawlessly, providing a consistent experience whether you’re on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV.
Privacy and Security:Your privacy matters. Any Music Player is built with industry-leading security protocols to ensure that your listening habits and collection remain confidential. With us, you're not just a user; you're a member of the Any Music Player community, entitled to privacy and respect.
------------------------

- Simplistic, well optimized, tiny in size but overfilled wit
bluejetty:00128563:ios.description:
Every game in this Tower Defense strategy game (TD) is endless - stand against infinite number of enemy waves for as long as you can!
Complete the story line for great rewards.
- Simplistic, well optimized, tiny in size but overfilled with features: 16 different types of towers, 11 types of enemies, bosses, miners, teleports, barriers, modifiers, resources...
- Over 60 different levels with leader boards and plenty of quests - no endless grind!
- Towers gain experience, abilities, different aiming strategies and can be heavily upgraded
- Miners can be used to dig out Resources for new global upgrades
- Map editor can be used to build any map with resources won for each game.
- Music tracks are stored in maps and played with synthesizer! Players can create a great map with any music and share it with others. 
- Huge permanent upgrades tree (over 500 different Researches).
- Many trophies (3D!) for completion of hardcore quests
- Detailed statistics for each game
- Synchronization of saved games with PC or any other available device.
- Game can be passed to unlock a Developer mode with infinite possibilities!
- No ads, everything can be unlocked for free!

bluejetty:00185988:ios.description:
viagogo is the world’s largest secondary marketplace for tickets to live events.
viagogo is a global online platform for live sport, music and entertainment tickets. viagogo aims to provide ticket buyers with the widest possible choice of tickets to events across the world, and helps ticket sellers ranging from individuals with a spare ticket to large multinational event organizers reach a global audience.
viagogo has partnered with many of the world’s leading brands in sport and entertainment, and has helped customers from almost every country in the world access tickets to their favorite events in the language, currency and on the device of their choice.
FIND THE PERFECT TICKET
Search millions of tickets to popular concert, sport, theater and festival events around the globe.
GET IT DELIVERED
We deliver to any country around the world, including yours.
ENJOY THE SHOW
Join millions of happy customers that have attended their favorite events, thanks to viagogo.
GUARANTEED
Buyers are guaranteed to receive valid tickets in time for the event. If a problem arises, viagogo will step in to provide comparable replacement tickets or a refund. Sellers are guaranteed to get paid for the tickets they sell and fulfill on time.
APP FEATURES
Buying a ticket?
Search for events by name, venue, genre or location Discover events happening near you Explore interactive seat maps and see the view from your seats Check out in just a few taps Track your order, view your mobile tickets and get ready for your next event!
Selling a ticket?
List your tickets in just a few taps Manage your listings and fulfill your orders on the go
BUY AND SELL TICKETS FOR
Elton John, Rugby World Cup, Tomorrowland, UEFA Euro, Cricket World Cup, André Rieu, Coldplay, Andrea Bocelli, BTS, Celine Dion, Metallica, FC Barcelona, Rammstein, FC Bayern München and more!!
GET IN TOUCH

Twitter: www.twitter.com/viagogo

bluejetty:00157323:ios.name: Skewer Time
bluejetty:00157323:ios.summary: Welcome to “Skewer Time,” where you can experience a unique match-3 challenge and become a true skewer master! Here, you will take on the role of a skewer shop owner, personally selecting various ingredients. Through careful combination and
bluejetty:00157323:ios.description:
Welcome to “Skewer Time,” where you can experience a unique match-3 challenge and become a true skewer master! Here, you will take on the role of a skewer shop owner, personally selecting various ingredients. Through careful combination and grilling, you will delight food lovers with an unforgettable feast. Whether it’s the fragrant grilled meats, succulent seafood, or uniquely flavored vegetable skewers, your skillful hands will unleash their delicious magic!
Gameplay
Move and arrange three identical skewers together to eliminate them.
Plan your space flexibly and use various tools and special items to complete level challenges!
Game Features
A wide variety of skewer types: From classic chicken skewers to creative seafood skewers, each ingredient is meticulously designed, bringing colorful and flavorful delights to your grill!
Diverse levels and challenge objectives: Each level has its own unique mission, from move limits to special elimination mechanisms, ensuring every challenge is full of surprises and variables!
Clever use of items for easy wins: Take advantage of in-game support items, such as flipping the grill or boosting firepower, to tackle tough challenges and make the game more thrilling and fun!
A test of both strategy and reaction: It’s not just about match-3, but also about quick decision-making and skillful arrangement, making every move a key to victory!
Here, you’re not just grilling skewers; you’re grilling passion for life. Come and set up your stall: It’s okay if they’re a bit burnt—just sprinkle more cumin!

bluejetty:00127213:ios.description:
HEAR IT LIVE. READ IT IN REAL-TIME. Transform your iPhone into a professional-grade emergency radio. Police Scanner 911 is the first and only scanner app featuring live AI Transcription, allowing you to read dispatch audio as it happens. Whether you are a breaking news junkie, a true crime enthusiast, or a neighbor concerned about local safety, this is the ultimate tool for situational awareness.
Join thousands of listeners and tap into the world’s largest network of live audio feeds, powered by Broadcastify.
WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT: Legacy scanner apps are filled with static and confusion. We use advanced audio processing and Artificial Intelligence to give you clarity.
KEY FEATURES:
AI LIVE TRANSCRIPTION (Premium) Don't just listen—read. Our cutting-edge speech-to-text engine captions police and fire dispatch audio in real-time. Never miss a license plate number, suspect description, or address again.
INTERACTIVE LIVE MAP Find the action instantly. Browse our global map to see exactly where emergencies are happening.
 Red Pins: Fire & EMS
 Blue Pins: Police & Law Enforcement
 Near Me: Instantly locate feeds in your zip code with one tap.
7,000+ LIVE FEEDS Access the largest database of scanner radio channels:
 Police & Public Safety
 Fire & EMS Dispatch
 Aviation & Air Traffic Control
 Railroad & Marine
 Severe Weather & Disaster Alerts
12-HOUR ARCHIVES Missed something? Go back in time. Replay the last 12 hours of audio in 30-minute segments. Catch the call you missed this morning.
CRYSTAL CLEAR AUDIO Say goodbye to static. Our proprietary Audio Engine features:
 Noise Gate: Eliminates the annoying static "hiss" between transmissions.
 Smart Leveling: Boosts quiet whispers and tames loud sirens for a consistent volume.
BREAKING NEWS ALERTS Be the first to know. Receive push notifications for major events, riots, wildfires, and hurricanes happening locally or globally.
ADDITIONAL TOOLS:
 Background Play: Listen while using other apps or with your screen locked.
 Favorites List: Organize your "Home" and "Work" feeds for quick access.
 Dark Mode: A sleek, battery-saving interface designed for night use.
---

* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
* You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.
