bluejetty:00064981:ios.description:
Hilltop Bank's Mobile Banking App is a fast, secure, and free* service from Hilltop Bank. It is optimized for iOS devices and available 24/7 using your existing Hilltop Bank Mobile Banking App Username and Password.
Your security is our priority — Mobile data transmissions are safeguarded by 128-bit SSL (Secure Socket Layer) to prevent unauthorized access. We will never transmit your account number, and no personal, financial data is stored on your phone. 
ACCOUNT ACTIVITY
• View your account balances and activity 
• Available balance and pending deposits — learn more about how your available balance is calculated and what’s still pending. Note, some transaction activities may not be immediately recorded to your account and may not yet be reflected in the available balance 
•·Find the transaction you're looking for in just a few swipes
• Detailed transactions list — View the date, location, amount, and more for transactions on one page, just like you see in Online Banking
TRANSFERS
• Make transfers between accounts
BILL PAY
• Schedule payments and pay bills right from your mobile device
• If you're already a Bill Pay customer, your payees are automatically available for use in Mobile Bill Pay
SEND AND RECEIVE MONEY
• Zelle® - Send money, using a mobile number or email address, to friends, family or any other person
MOBILE DEPOSIT 
• Deposit checks with your mobile device
Hilltop Bank is Member FDIC, Equal Housing Lender, NMLS ID 527730.
Getting started is easy.  Simply download the app and sign on with your Hilltop Online user credentials.  [No additional fees apply.*].  For more information about Hilltop Bank’s mobile services, please visit https://www.hilltop.bank/ or call us at 307-265-2740.  *Carrier’s data rates may apply.

The Montana 511 mobile application provides real-time access to traffic and traveler information supplied by the Montana Department of Transportation (Montana DOT). Maps depict current traffic conditions, as well as incident and construction events that can impact traffic on all Interstate, U.S., and State Routes. bluejetty:00119012:ios.description:
Scan docs with camera and send faxes worldwide. Fast & easy!
Fax for iPhone lets you turn your device into a fax machine! You can scan / import and fax contracts, receipts, paper notes, schedules, timetables, any kind of documents – anything you might need in your day to day life using this fax app.
No fax machine or dedicated phone line needed.
SEND FAXES
- Fax from iPhone to 100+ countries
- Advanced document scanner & image processing
- Image enhancements
- Combine multiple document documents into a single fax
- Preview before sending to recipient
- Track all sent documents
- Encryption & HIPAA compliance
RECEIVE FAXES
- Dedicated number
- Receive faxes from anywhere in the world
----------------------------------------------------------------------
TURN ANY DOCUMENT INTO A FAX
- Scan documents, receipts, contracts etc… with camera
- Create faxes from your camera, Files or anywhere else
- Fax documents in hundreds of countries
- Forget about land line and phone lines
- Enhance your documents with image correction tools
- Fax from iphone directly to your address book
- Easy Fax app to send fax
Fax from iPhone lets you take pictures of any kind of document, whether it’s for business expenses or on-the-go legal contracts. Scan them directly in-app or use your Camera Roll. You can even turn cloud-based documents into faxes via Dropbox, Google Drive and more.
GET THE BEST HD QUALITY PICTURE
Fax from iPhone comes bundled with powerful image-enhancement features that let you resize, enhance and improve the quality of your faxes. It includes noise removal, shadow-reduction, and even automatic angle correction. You can make sure the recipients will be able to read them as clearly as possible.
MANAGE FAXES AND REDUCE FAXING ERRORS
No more worries about sending poorly scanned or messy documents. Fax from iPhone lets you combine multiple documents into one, and you get to preview everything before you send it! 
SEND AND RECEIVE FAXES IN A COUPLE OF TAPS
You can scan and send a fax in seconds! Simply type in the number of the recipient, or use your address book contacts for an even faster process. No more struggling to find a free landline or to manually type in the right number anymore. It’s an easy fax app to send fax.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR FAXES
With Fax from iPhone, you will be notified when your documents are sent and you get a clear update when they are delivered. No more lost documents.
SEND FAXES WORLDWIDE
You can send faxes to a record number of countries around the world - perfect for international business! Easy Fax app to send fax.
SCANNER APP INTEGRATION
If you already use our ScannerApp, you can integrate both apps to send your faxes easily and conveniently in seconds.
So if you need to send faxes regularly, forget about the trouble of locating fax machines and painstakingly scanning your documents. Easy fax - Do it in on the go and in a couple of taps right from your phone or tablet with Fax from iPhone.
Subscription

1 week - $6.99 USD
1 month - $19.99 USD
12 months - $95.99 USD
Please note the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
By using Fax app Pro, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Private Policy http://getsfaxapp.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use http://getfaxapp.com/terms.html
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00168005:ios.name: Food Journal Daily
bluejetty:00168005:ios.summary: Food Journal Daily is a free meal macro tracker app that makes the creation of your meal journal easier and stress-free. It allows you to keep track of your daily meals as well as snacks for the current and all future weeks in a simple way.
bluejetty:00168005:ios.description:
Food Journal Daily is a free meal macro tracker app that makes the creation of your meal journal easier and stress-free. It allows you to keep track of your daily meals as well as snacks for the current and all future weeks in a simple way. You can also consult your food diary calendar from the past weeks.
For a monthly fee it is possible to link your partner and share your food planning instantly.
This diet tracker is a handy tool for both small and large families to manage their weekly menu calendar and food diary, if you're on a diet (e.g. keto, whole30, forkes over knives, mediterranean diet ...) or not.
The Food Diary
- Swipe to go to next or previous week
- Click on a meal to enter the details. Everything is optional
- Long press on a meal to move it to a different day or swap it with another meal
- Define categories for meals. These can be used in the meal rules
- Pick an ingredient from a preloaded list or freely enter one with calories and GI (glycemic index)
- If you don't want to see the breakfasts, lunches or dinners, you can hide one or more of them in the settings
- All meals are kept in memory so you don't always have to enter the full name but simply pick it from a list
- Share your diet diary with friends or family
- keep track of snacks
Other
- Print a nice looking overview the menu overview
- Dark mode
- Share the app with your friends or family
- Live sharing with partner
Privacy Policy: https://www.jojo-apps.com/food-diary-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00184348:ios.description:
THE ALL-IN-ONE MONEY APP
Budget, save, spend, and invest. All in one incredibly powerful app. Get 24/7 identity monitoring, earn on your savings, and ask Genius anything. Subscription required. Try 30 days before you’re charged.
ONLINE BANKING
Get paid up to 2 days early with direct deposit. Earn cash back at select stores. Albert is not a bank. See more below.
BUDGETING AND PERSONAL FINANCE MANAGEMENT
Get a monthly budget, track expenses, and customize your spending plan. See all your accounts in one place and track recurring bills. Find subscriptions you don’t use and negotiate to lower your bills.
AUTOMATIC SAVING AND INVESTING
Smart money automatically transfers money to help you save and invest. Open a high yield savings account to earn competitive Annual Percentage Yield (APY) on your deposits, over 9x the national average. Invest in stocks, ETFs, and managed portfolios. See more below.
PROTECT YOUR MONEY
24/7 monitoring on your accounts, credit, and identity. Get real-time alerts when we detect potential fraud. Plus, track your credit score.
DISCLOSURES
Albert is not a bank. Banking services provided by Stride Bank, N.A., Member FDIC. Albert Savings accounts are held for your benefit at FDIC-insured banks, including Wells Fargo, N.A. The Albert Mastercard® debit card is issued by Stride Bank, N.A., pursuant to a license by Mastercard. Mastercard and the circles design are registered trademarks of Mastercard International Incorporated. Funds in Albert Cash are held in a pooled account at Stride Bank, N.A. Cash and Savings account funds are eligible for up to $250,000 in FDIC insurance on a pass-through basis. Your FDIC insurance is subject to specific conditions being satisfied.
Albert plans range from $19.99-$39.99. Auto-renews until canceled or your Albert account is closed. Cancel in the app. See Terms for more.
Albert Genius is an AI financial assistant and can make mistakes. Information or recommendations by Genius are provided “as is” and may be inaccurate.
Instant Advances are available to you at Albert’s discretion. Limits range from $25-$1,000, subject to eligibility. Not all customers will qualify and few qualify for $1,000. No subscription required.
Instant line of credit issued by FinWise Bank, Member FDIC. Limits range from $25-$1,000, subject to eligibility. Draw fees apply. No subscription required. Terms apply.
Instant Loans are issued by FinWise Bank, Member FDIC, or Albert, under licenses in Utah and Florida. Loans start at $1,000, and are subject to eligibility and credit review. No subscription required. Terms apply.
Early access to direct deposit funds may vary depending on payer’s deposit timing.
Cash back subject to terms. 
High Yield Savings account interest rates are variable and subject to change at any time. Rates current as of 2/24/26. There is no minimum balance requirement. Genius is required to access High Yield Savings. Fees to use Albert may reduce the earnings on your account.
Brokerage services provided by Albert Securities, member FINRA/SIPC. Investment advisory services provided by Albert Investments. Investing accounts are not FDIC insured or bank guaranteed. Investing involves the risk of loss. Investing content provided by Albert Genius are research tools, not recommendations. More info at albrt.co/disclosures.
Credit score calculated on the VantageScore 3.0 model. Your VantageScore 3.0 from Experian® indicates your credit risk level and is not used by all lenders, so don't be surprised if your lender uses a score that's different from your VantageScore 3.0.
Address: 440 N Barranca Ave #3801, Covina, CA 91723
No customer support available at this address. Visit www.albert.com for help.

bluejetty:00099123:ios.description:
Discover words hidden in letter grids with stunning visual celebrations! Inspired by the ancient Sator Square — the 2,000-year-old Latin palindrome puzzle
also known as Satordle — this addictive daily word puzzle game lets you connect adjacent letters to form words, featuring professional-grade animations and
the most intelligent hint system available.
WHY SQUAREDLE STANDS OUT:
• Spectacular word celebration animations that reward every discovery
• Two game modes: Classic 4x4 and Express 3x3 grids
• Advanced hint system that shows partial word paths until you're ready to play
• Daily puzzles with 55+ unique challenges refreshed every day
• Beautiful visual feedback with every word you find
• Built-in solver to tackle any custom grid configuration
• Immersive word path animations with professional polish
• Smart word categorization across all difficulty levels
• Bonus word discoveries with premium visual rewards
KEY FEATURES:
• FREE daily word puzzles with fresh challenges every day
• Express Mode for lightning-fast 3x3 puzzle sessions
• Revolutionary hint display system - hints stay visible until you start playing
• Interactive word path visualization with smooth animations
• Intelligent tip system (3 free hints every 3 hours, or 15 with Premium)
• Complete customization with 15 beautiful themes and custom colors
• Multiple language support (14+ languages with full localization)
• Offline gameplay - no internet connection required
• Rich sound effects and satisfying haptic feedback
• Intuitive interface designed for seamless gameplay across all ages
• Auto-save progress with cloud synchronization
PERFECT FOR:
• Word game enthusiasts seeking daily brain training with visual rewards
• Puzzle lovers who appreciate polished animations and smooth gameplay
• Players who want flexible hint systems that adapt to their pace
• Anyone looking for both quick sessions and deeper puzzle challenges
• Gamers who value premium presentation and professional user experience
PREMIUM EXPERIENCE:
• Ad-free gameplay for uninterrupted word discovery
• 5x more hints (15 instead of 3) refreshing every hour
• Full theme customization with unlimited color combinations
• Priority access to new features and game modes
• Support indie developers creating quality puzzle games
ADVANCED TOOLS:
• Professional Squaredle Solver - analyze any grid configuration
• Comprehensive progress tracking and detailed statistics
• Cross-device synchronization keeps your progress everywhere
• Debug tools and testing features for power users
Join thousands of word puzzle fans who experience the most visually rewarding daily word game! Whether you're seeking quick Express challenges or deep 4x4
explorations, discover why Squaredle sets the standard for premium word puzzle experiences.
Download now and transform your daily word discovery journey with stunning celebrations for every word you find!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177749:ios.name: Sports City Tycoon: Idle Game
bluejetty:00177749:ios.summary: The goal of this cool tycoon game is to construct an entire sports city. Sport is your business and you need to manage stadiums to attract fans to watch the most epic matches! You will host games for sports fans from all over the world. You
bluejetty:00177749:ios.description:
The goal of this cool tycoon game is to construct an entire sports city. Sport is your business and you need to manage stadiums to attract fans to watch the most epic matches! You will host games for sports fans from all over the world. You will face great challenges while raising your rich business empire! Build now your own sports town, earn money, invest your earnings, and purchase new stadiums to bring all kinds of sports to your town!
Start with a small stadium, get visitors into the town, and sell tickets to earn money to build even more stadiums! Manage and optimize resources like a sports management simulator and improve the games bringing more players to the field! You will manage a tennis court, a swimming pool, a car racing track, a soccer field, a football pitch, a basketball court, a golf course, and build stadiums for all other cool national sports of the world!
Each city you build has its own strategy. You can build a beach sports city where people can surf, sail and play beach volleyball or even a winter sports city where you can play hockey or race in a bobsled! For the adrenaline loving fans you can build a radical sports city where people can skate, mountain climb or even skydive!
Features:
- Easy to play and hard to master.
- Earn cash even when you're offline.
- Upgrade your stadiums to increase its seat capacity.
- Manage resources to maximize money income and build new attractions!
- Host competitions for Tennis, Golf, Soccer, American Football, Basketball, Athletics, Car Racing, Baseball, Swimming, Skating, Skydiving, Surfing, Sailing, Horseback Riding, Beach Volleyball, and much more!
- Host epic matches among the best countries!
- Watch the best matches in real-time amazing 3D graphics!
Have a problem? Want to suggest a cool new feature? Send your feedback to Pixodust Games. We love to hear from our players! support@pixodust.com
Be sure to check for updates. We're always working on improving gameplay and adding new features!
Privacy Policy:
https://pixodust.com/games_privacy_policy/
Terms and Conditions:
https://pixodust.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00071611:ios.name: ArcadeBall: Ramp Challenge
bluejetty:00071611:ios.summary: Step up to the ramp and rediscover the arcade classic you grew up loving — now reborn for your phone. ArcadeBall: The Ramp Challenge is the fun, nostalgic, endlessly addicting skee-ball experience that keeps players coming back roll after r
bluejetty:00071611:ios.description:
Step up to the ramp and rediscover the arcade classic you grew up loving — now reborn for your phone. ArcadeBall: The Ramp Challenge is the fun, nostalgic, endlessly addicting skee-ball experience that keeps players coming back roll after roll.
Remember the satisfying weight of the ball, the perfect angle, the rush of banking a clean shot up the ramp and into the rings? We captured that county-fair skee-ball magic and supercharged it with stunning 3D graphics, hyper-realistic physics, and real online competition. This isn't luck — it's pure skill, precision, and timing.
PVP MATCHES
Don't just chase a high score — chase an opponent. Challenge players around the world in live head-to-head matches. Trade perfect shots, feel the adrenaline, and prove you're the true ramp champion. Invite friends and settle the score!
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS & LEAGUES
Start in the amateur leagues and battle up the ranks to become a legend. Dominate weekly and all-time leaderboards, earn promotions to prestigious leagues, and unlock exclusive rewards that show off your elite status.
DESIGN YOUR DREAM ARCADE
Go beyond the ramp with a deep renovation mode. Start with an empty room and build the arcade paradise of your dreams. Unlock hundreds of items: classic cabinets, neon signs, air hockey tables, even your own bowling lane. Every detail is yours to customize.
UNLOCK EPIC SKINS & CHARACTERS
Roll with a cool banana, a fierce chicken, or a mysterious sorcerer! Customize your ball with spectacular skins, unique effects, and glowing trails. Build your collection and find the perfect look to match your winning style.
KEY FEATURES:
• Hyper-realistic physics — every roll, bounce, and score feels authentic
• Intuitive swipe controls — easy to learn, deeply rewarding to master
• Stunning 3D arcades, from sunny beachside ramps to neon arenas
• Deep customization — collect characters, balls, and decor
• Engaging progression — leagues to climb, arcades to build, rewards to earn
• Play online against rivals or offline to practice anytime
TIPS FOR THE RAMP:
Find your rhythm before you launch. A smooth, controlled swipe beats a hard fling every time. Aim for the high-value rings when your streak is hot, and bank consistent shots to stack promotions in the leagues.
Whether you're killing five minutes or chasing leaderboard glory, ArcadeBall is the perfect quick, relaxing, feel-good pick-up-and-play game — with the skill depth to keep competitive players hooked.
Join the ArcadeBall community today. The ramp is waiting. Your challenge begins now.
Privacy Policy: https://www.joygame.com/en/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.joygame.com/en/user-terms

Don't have a server yet? Try the free live demo or set up your own for free at traccar.org.

AI Creative Studio

• Design logos with one tap
• Create templates and graphics for any project
Built For Everyone
Fig is for anyone with an idea:
• Entrepreneurs launching a product or service
• Freelancers building a portfolio or pitching clients
• Students creating study aids and research reports
• Creators producing videos, podcasts, and graphics
• Small business owners managing sites and content
• Teams sharing agents and collaborating via chat
One Agent. Unlimited Capabilities.

bluejetty:00161837:ios.description:
iReel TV is a mobile app dedicated to short drama series, offering you a one-stop destination full of exclusive original content. Here, you can enjoy high-definition quality shorts crafted by top industry screenwriters and directors anytime, anywhere. Our platform not only values the originality and depth of stories but also promises a silky-smooth viewing experience for our users.
At iReel TV, we are committed to bringing short yet rich and emotionally charged cinematic works to a global audience and right at your fingertips! Whether it's under the first rays of the morning sun or during a relaxing moment after a busy day, iReel TV will be by your side, providing easy access to minute-long adventures across all styles and themes.
Here, you will discover a new world of entertainment and stories that are uniquely yours. You will encounter love, adventure, wonder, and all the emotional experiences that you crave. So what are you waiting for? Download and join iReel TV, and become a part of our community! With constantly updated content, there's always a new story waiting for you to explore.
Contact us: support@ireel.zohodesk.com
Privacy policy: https://www.ireeltv.com/privacy/ 
Terms of Service: https://www.ireeltv.com/terms/
Subscription:
If you subscribe through Apple, the payment will be deducted from your App Store account upon purchase confirmation.
Subscription privileges: While your subscription is active, you can watch all tv mini series for free.
Your subscription will take effect within 24 hours after purchase, depending on the status of your order in the Apple Store. The subscription is valid for 7 days.
Auto-Renewal: Your subscription will automatically renew. You will be charged within 24 hours before the start of each subscription period until you cancel your subscription.
Cancellation: On iOS devices, you can cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the next renewal date by going to Settings > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > Subscriptions > iReel TV. The subscription is billed weekly. The actual price may vary by region.

bluejetty:00018100:ios.name: MB WAY
bluejetty:00018100:ios.summary: The MB WAY app is SIBS' digital solution that simplifies payments in one place! Link your mobile number to your bank card to Send, Request, and Receive money, Split bills, Generate MB NET virtual cards, shop online and in-store with QR Code
bluejetty:00018100:ios.description:
The MB WAY app is SIBS' digital solution that simplifies payments in one place! Link your mobile number to your bank card to Send, Request, and Receive money, Split bills, Generate MB NET virtual cards, shop online and in-store with QR Code or NFC, and earn rewards. Track subscriptions and recurring payments, withdraw cash, and use MULTIBANCO with MB WAY. With MB WAY Pulse, pay even when your phone is off, without battery, or without internet.
All of this always with SIBS security guarantee. The MB WAY app is the No.1 payment app in Portugal and already a reference, with more than 6,5 million users who use its advantages daily, making it the favorite payment app of the Portuguese.
FUNCTIONALITIES 
How to pay with MB WAY? 
To pay in-store, when paying for your purchases in physical shops, simply select "Pagar com MB WAY" button and choose the "QR Code" or "NFC" option.
- QR Code: After the merchant enters the amount, scan the QR code. If the amount exceeds the PIN limit, confirm with your MB WAY PIN, touch ID, or face ID.
- NFC: Tap your phone on the terminal. If the amount exceeds the limit, confirm in the app and tap again.
To pay online, select MB WAY as the payment method, enter your mobile number, and confirm the payment via notification and your MB WAY PIN.
How to buy with MB NET? 
When paying for your online purchases, access the MB WAY app and generate an MB NET card in the "Cartões MB NET" option. Then, on the merchant's website, select pay with card and enter the details of the MB NET card you generated.
How to use MULTIBANCO? 
To use the "Utilizar MULTIBANCO” option with the MB WAY app, you must choose the amount you want to withdraw and enter your MB WAY PIN or touch ID. Then, with the generated code, go to a MULTIBANCO ATM, press the green key and choose the "Withdraw Money" option. You can also generate a code for someone else to go to MULTIBANCO to withdraw. You can also use this option “Utilizar MULTIBANCO” to carry out other operations available at MULTIBANCO.
How to send money?
Simply tap "Send Money," select a contact, enter the amount, and confirm the transaction. The money will be available immediately in the recipient's account.
For amounts over €2,000, you must join MB WAY Verified and authenticate the transactions with facial recognition.
How to request money? 
To request money, simply select the "Pedir Dinheiro" button in the app, select the contact you want to request money from, indicate the amount, and confirm the operation. You can also request the amount through your personal QR Code.
How to split an account? 
To split an account, simply select the "Dividir Conta" button. Then, select the contacts with whom you want to split the bill, indicate the amount of the bill, and confirm the operation.
How to join authorized payments? 
To manage your subscriptions or recurring payments through "Pagamentos Autorizados", simply select this payment method on the participating partner, enter your mobile phone number, confirm on your MB WAY, enter your PIN for confirmation and you're done!
How to activate MB WAY? 
1. Link your bank card at an ATM (MULTIBANCO) 
2. Download the app for free and activate it with your mobile number MB WAY is the only official digital payments app from SIBS, accepted by all major banks in Portugal.
How to activate MB WAY pulse? 
Use MB WAY pulse to make contactless payments through another device: bracelet, key ring or clip for your watch, but with the cards you have associated with MB WAY. You can now make purchases with MB WAY pulse without having to have your smartphone with you. 
How to activate MB WAY Verified?
Joining MB WAY Verified is part of the MB WAY activation process. You can also activate it in the "MAIS - DEFINIÇÕES" menu or during a money transfer. The process is simple: just submit an ID document (ID Card, Passport, or Residence Permit) and complete facial recognition.

bluejetty:00128454:ios.name: Rope And Balls
bluejetty:00128454:ios.summary:
► SIMPLICITY IS THE KEY TO A GREAT PUZZLE
A great puzzle needs only a few simple elements to toy with the rules of physics and create a truly challenging and absorbing test of your logic. That’s certainly true for this addictive and origin
bluejetty:00128454:ios.description:
► SIMPLICITY IS THE KEY TO A GREAT PUZZLE
A great puzzle needs only a few simple elements to toy with the rules of physics and create a truly challenging and absorbing test of your logic. That’s certainly true for this addictive and original puzzle game that will have you racking your brain and trying over and over again to complete each level with nothing more than a pile of balls and a few pieces of rope. Challenge your logic and your spatial awareness on every single level in this simply fascinating mobile game.
• Two stages for double the fun: Each level involves two stages, each an individual puzzle in its own right. First you need to draw a rope in the correct shape to draw all the large balls together without snagging the rope on any of the obstacles. The original balls then explode into a shower of smaller balls, and you have to use a set number of rope pieces to guide them all around further obstacles and into the cup waiting at the bottom of the board.
• My cup runneth over… There’s a set number of balls that have to reach the cup for you to pass each level in the game, so make sure you give careful consideration to the laws of physics and put the ropes in exactly the right place before the balls are released. Otherwise, it’s back to the (rope) drawing board for a little more serious thinking…
• Simple doesn’t mean easy: The concept may be straightforward, but intelligent game design in every level means that, soon enough as you progress through the game, each puzzle becomes a real challenge that will test your spatial awareness, your logical thinking and your understanding of physics to the max. 
• Try, try and try again: There’s no penalty for trying – if you mess up the level you’re on, just tap the reload button and have another go. The puzzles may be taxing, but you’ll never have to worry about running out of lives or waiting for the opportunity to test your latest genius theory. So don’t get stressed, just go ahead and try one more time. The solution’s bound to be just around the corner…
► SHOW OFF YOUR ROPING SKILLS
Get the balls to walk the tightrope and fill the cup up till it smiles. This addictive and original puzzle game may look simple at first glance, but the further you progress the more each level will require both serious thinking and real dexterity, giving your brain a great workout and ensuring you’ll be deeply satisfied, and thoroughly entertained for hour after hour. 
Download the game now and start learning the ropes in this unusual and immensely fun puzzle extravaganza.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00184958:ios.name: Pop Art Lite
bluejetty:00184958:ios.summary: 'Pop Art Lite' transforms live video from the built-in cameras, photo library or AI photos generated from text input into Pop Art posters utilizing four different available 'Pop Art Themes': Warhol, HOPE, Posterize or Negged Out!. All four
bluejetty:00184958:ios.description:
'Pop Art Lite' transforms live video from the built-in cameras, photo library or AI photos generated from text input into Pop Art posters utilizing four different available 'Pop Art Themes': Warhol, HOPE, Posterize or Negged Out!. All four filters utilize automatic background removal if enabled. The intelligent Warhol filter detects facial features, hair, skin and clothing for a colored bottom layer and overlays a screen layer on top via eight different 'blend modes.' Eight different 'Photo FX' modes can also be applied to the screen layer. The colors that are applied to the different regions are determined via one of 13 available 'Color Presets' corresponding to famous Pop Art artists and artwork. For each frame in the frame layout different sets of colors are used. So for the first frame the hair detected region will have a different color applied to it than the second frame for example. In live video the filter is applied directly as well as the frame layout from a single frame to 2X1, 1X2, 2X2, 3X2, 2X3 and up to 3X3 which can be dynamically changed on-the-fly and the change updates in real-time. When you are satisfied with your Pop Art creation simply tap the red button to capture it and delete, print or share it from the gallery detail view. You can create surprisingly authentic Warholesque artwork using this filter. The HOPE filter creates a Shepard Fairey-inspired HOPE poster with editable text and maps luminance values to the corresponding HOPE colors. Sliders enable you to alter the prevalence of darker tones and brighter tones. Solid colors or interpolated colors can be used and histogram equalization can be enabled to balance the colors more evenly. Like the HOPE filter the Posterize filter maps luminance values to poster colors using the currently selected Color Preset and also has interpolation and histogram equalization. The Posterize filter also uses the same frame layouts as the Warhol filter. The Negged Out! filter applies a negative filter and a poster filter with different levels that are set via a poster levels slider. It also applies a photo effect for intriguing images.
- Warhol and Posterize filters transform live video and AI generated and library photos into pop art posters with color presets and dynamic frame layouts of either single frame, 2X1, 1X2, 2X2, 2X3, 3X2 all the way up to 3X3.
- Use the 'AI Image Generator' to create crazy AI images from custom text input. Then crop the AI images and use in any of the four filters.
- HOPE filter creates Shepard Fairey-inspired poster with editable text.
- Posterize and HOPE filters include interpolate mode which interpolates from darker to brighter tones if enabled vs. solid colors otherwise.
- Posterize and HOPE filters also have histogram equalization feature which can be enabled to more evenly distribute the colors.
- For Warhol and Posterize filters choose from 13 different presets based on famous works and artists for five different colors per frame for each frame in the frame layout.
Join the facebook group https://www.facebook.com/groups/PopArtApp to check out other's work and share your creations (either from the app or otherwise) with others.

Terms of Service: https://pop-art-lite.flycricket.io/terms.html

• The difficulty increases gradually
• It helps you stay focused and practice actively

• 10+ memorization methods
• Learn by hiding words, lines, first letters, and more
• Actors: practice only your own lines
• Import PDF, TXT, RTF, and HTML files

• Long press to temporarily reveal hidden words
• Long press "Reveal" to reset the text

• Actors & comedians: lines and scripts
• Singers: lyrics
• Public speakers: speeches
• Students: lessons, presentations, and poems
• Anyone who wants to memorize texts faster

bluejetty:00089260:ios.description:
The official Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) app has arrived. It’s the easiest way to plan your trip and get accurate real time train departures with data straight from BART, along with official service alerts.
The BART app offers exclusive features for hassle free travel for daily commuters, infrequent users and tourists alike:
-Plan your entire end to end trip with BART’s exclusive Trip Planner giving you the fastest route from your starting point to your destination using BART and multiple modes of transportation, including connecting transit, biking, walking and driving.
-Step by step navigation with personalized preferences and saved favorite stations and trips.
-Real time departures and schedule timetable.
-Customized in-app notifications about BART service and announcements.
-Contactless in-app Daily Fee parking payment 
-Service disruption information linked to your trip itinerary.
-Report a Biohazard that needs addressing and access our BART Watch App for reporting crimes.
-Escalator and Elevator advisories.
-Fleet of the Future train tracker.
-Cancelled trip notices.
-Easily see the last train of the evening by station when you’re planning your night out or your trip home from the airport.
-Station information (including if it offers a parking lot and secured bike parking).
-Seamless connection to bart.gov and BARTable for deals, events, and fun.
-It’s ad free; who wants to be distracted when looking how far away your train is?
BART is working on future features of the app to enhance your BART experience... Tell us about the features you want.

Bankin' is an award-winning finance mobile app which helps you make better decisions to save money. Thanks to Bankin’, manage your expenses, your budget, your savings and your credits.

MANAGE YOUR MONEY WITH US

• Improve your understanding of how to manage your money more efficiently through graphs and tables

• Configure and adjust your budget by personalizing and changing your goals 
• Visualise your progress and results at the end of every month, your wallet will never be empty anymore
• Understand how and where you should focus your savings and efforts
SECURITY AS OUR TOP PRIORITY
• Is an agent of the company Perspecteev (Bridge), which is licensed by ACPR
• Secured just the way your bank is - through your PIN number, your fingerprint or your face recognition

bluejetty:00015613:ios.description:
Princess Coloring Pages is a game where you’ll find the best princesses to color on your phone or tablet.
It’s one of the most entertaining princess games available to download. In the game, you choose a picture and color it however you want. If you’re looking for free princess coloring pages or princess games online, look no further, because you’ve already found one of the most fun and educational games available. 
How do you play “Princess Coloring Pages”?
To play, just follow these steps:
1. Download and install the game
2. Choose the princesses that you want to color
3. Choose your colors and start coloring
4. When you’re finished, you can save the picture to show your friends, or even better, share it through your social networks, messaging apps, email, etc.
What can you do with this princess coloring games? Main features:
We have gathered some of the best pictures of princesses for coloring. 
- You’ll find endless colors to choose from so you can color your princess with all the colors you wish.
- If you make a mistake, you can use the eraser to remove it. 
- Once you’ve finished, you can share your creations with friends and family. This app allows you to share your pictures through social networks, messaging apps, SMS, or email. 
- You can also save your colored princess pictures and always have them available on your phone or tablet.
- We plan to constantly update the app and add new coloring pages so that you or your children will always have new pictures to color.
Premium features:
- An ad-free experience throughout the App
- Access to exclusive premium princess coloring designs
- The ability to undo actions and revert changes while coloring
- Access to an extended color palette and color wheel to freely choose any desired color
We hope that you and your child love our princess coloring games. If so, we would be very appreciative if you would give it a high rating and a positive review so we continue updating the game with the newest and best pictures. Your ratings and comments will encourage us to continue improving the game.
Legal Disclaimer:
All images found in this application are the property of Reticode. The commercial use of any image found in this program without the prior written consent of Reticode is prohibited.
Privacy Policy: https://reticode.com/privacy-policy/
Terms: https://reticode.com/terms/terms-of-service-princess-coloring.html

bluejetty:00168154:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Play your hand carefully in this quintessential card game to avoid taking any tricks that include hearts — or collect them all to shoot the moon!
Whether you’re a Hearts card shark or totally new to this classic game, MobilityWare's simple, streamlined version offers smart features to sharpen your strategy and play at the level of challenge that's perfect for you.
NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY
If you've never tried Hearts before, start with a quick tutorial and use smart hints to learn as you play and develop your strategy in real time. Instantly regretting your last move? The "undo" feature is here to help!
A SMARTER CLASSIC CARD GAME
Sharpen your competitive edge against AI-powered opponents who adapt to your playing style. Since you don't need to be online to play, you won't have to worry about iffy Wi-Fi or wait around to match with other players.
BEAT THE BOTS — OR TAKE IT EASY
Your choice: You can rise through the ranks in Competitive Mode or switch to Relaxed Mode for practice games that won't affect your standing. Achieve daily goals to earn rewards and advance to the top tiers even faster.
TIPS FOR HEARTS BEGINNERS
Your mission in each round is to end up with as few cards as possible that are worth points — unless you can collect all of them (a special feat called "shooting the moon"). Avoid playing the highest card of the starting suit on each trick to steer clear of hearts and the dangerous Queen of Spades.
- Created by MobilityWare.

NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY

If you've never tried Hearts before, start with a quick tutorial and use smart hints to learn as you play and develop your strategy in real time. Instantly regretting your last move? The "undo" feature is here to help!

A SMARTER CLASSIC CARD GAME

Sharpen your competitive edge against AI-powered opponents who adapt to your playing style. Since you don't need to be online to play, you won't have to worry about iffy Wi-Fi or wait around to match with other players.

BEAT THE BOTS — OR TAKE IT EASY

Your choice: You can rise through the ranks in Competitive Mode or switch to Relaxed Mode for practice games that won't affect your standing. Achieve daily goals to earn rewards and advance to the top tiers even faster.

TIPS FOR HEARTS BEGINNERS

Your mission in each round is to end up with as few cards as possible that are worth points — unless you can collect all of them (a special feat called "shooting the moon"). Avoid playing the highest card of the starting suit on each trick to steer clear of hearts and the dangerous Queen of Spades.

bluejetty:00133049:ios.description:
Your vacation to India started as planned until an unexpected thief lured you into the finding games world of the animal kingdom. Now you’ve been recruited to play seek and find games and help Nanda, the benevolent elephant queen, and her allies protect Princess Manu, the only human in the animal world, from the wrath of Jagan, the Tiger King, and his fearsome cohorts. You’ll have to solve tons of hidden object adventure games! Can you save Princess Manu and bring peace to the animal kingdom? You’ll need the curiosity of a cat and the cunning of a fox to find out!
· BRING PEACE TO THE JUNGLES!
Solve tons of hide and seek games and save Princess Many! Defeat the last remaining tyrant in the Bonus Game to restore peace to the Animal World!
· WONDERFUL COLLECTIBLES!
Collect animal figurines and plates, and complete your boudoir with your butterfly collection! Find the object in the hidden pictures games to learn more about the jungles!
· BONUS CONTENT AND MORE!
Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, music, videos, and concept art! You can also replay your favorite mini-games, puzzles and HOP scenes!
· NEVER GET LOST!
Stuck while playing? Never get lost with the strategy guide! It’s accessible and is always at hand!

30 Day Ab Workout Challenge gives you one clear plan for strong abs at home. Each day shows you the moves, the reps and th
bluejetty:00036904:ios.description:
Thirty days. A few minutes a day. A core that feels stronger every time you sit up, stand tall or pick something up.
30 Day Ab Workout Challenge gives you one clear plan for strong abs at home. Each day shows you the moves, the reps and the rest. You just follow along.
It starts easy. Then it gets harder a few reps at a time, so by week three you're doing things that felt impossible on day one.
HOW IT WORKS
Pick your level: beginner, intermediate or advanced. Each day mixes crunches, planks, leg raises, mountain climbers and twists that work your upper abs, lower abs, obliques and deep core. Rest days are built in.
AN HONEST NOTE ON BELLY FAT
No ab exercise burns fat from one spot. What works is a strong core plus a little less body fat overall. That's why the challenge comes with meal plans, so the work you put in actually shows.
WHAT'S INSIDE
Daily ab and core workouts for every level
A demo for every exercise so your form stays right
Workout calendar and daily reminders
Weight tracking and before and after photos
5 meal plans: vegetarian, vegan, Mediterranean, keto and Atkins
Water reminders and Apple Health sync
No equipment, just a bit of floor space
FOR WOMEN AND MEN
Whether you want a flat stomach or a visible six pack, the plan is the same: show up daily, keep good form, eat well. The app takes care of the first two.
BEFORE YOU START
Please check with your doctor before starting any new exercise program, especially if you are pregnant, injured or new to training.
SUBSCRIPTION

Weekly: [$X.XX] per week after a 3-day free trial

You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

bluejetty:00099483:ios.summary:
Discover films in a new way.
Dodo View Play turns your love of movies into a game. From unforgettable classics to modern hits, every quiz is designed to challenge, entertain, and help you uncover hidden gems in cinema history.
Multiple way
bluejetty:00099483:ios.description:
Discover films in a new way.
Dodo View Play turns your love of movies into a game. From unforgettable classics to modern hits, every quiz is designed to challenge, entertain, and help you uncover hidden gems in cinema history.
Multiple ways to test your knowledge.
Go beyond simple trivia questions. Identify films through their posters, match legendary quotes to their movies, and answer cast and director challenges. Each mode offers a fresh angle, so the game never feels repetitive.
Compete and track your progress.
Every correct answer adds to your score, streak, and rank. Rise through levels, unlock achievements, and see how you measure up against players worldwide on the leaderboard. Whether you play casually or aim to be the top movie expert, there’s always a new goal to pursue.
Curated collections for discovery.
Dodo View Play isn’t just about questions—it’s also about discovery. Explore themed collections such as “Essential Movies Everyone Should Watch” or “Top 250 Narrative Films.” Playing becomes a way to expand your watchlist and deepen your understanding of cinema.
Fresh challenges every day.
Daily events bring new themes and unique challenges, such as Oscar winners or cult classics. These special rounds keep the game dynamic and ensure there’s always something new to return to.
Dodo View Play blends trivia, competition, and discovery in one modern, sleek experience. It’s built for players who want more than just a quiz app—it’s for those who want to live their passion for movies.
Download Dodo View Play today and prove your cinema expertise while discovering films you’ll love.

bluejetty:00121441:ios.description:
With Yodha astrology and horoscope app you will get a personal astrologer. Here's what the world of astrology can offer you:
• Accurate predictions. Answers to your biggest questions will be based on your birth chart readings once your date and place of birth are set.
• Motivational insights. Astrology is key to your personality. Revealing new traits will boost your mindfulness and progress in love life, family, friendship, career, and wellness.
• Complimentary horoscopes. You will stay on track with horoscope updates. It’s necessary since celestial objects and their transits affect all aspects of life.
• Authentic experts. A team of over 300 Vedic astrologers is at your service. They are genuine professionals known to combine simple, honest living with high thinking.
• Thoughts of the day. A line or even a word can awaken and deepen your day with extra meaning and positivity. A daily dose of inspiration is guaranteed.
• 100% confidential. Your privacy is our priority. The app is secure and can be used anonymously.
Wondering what kind of questions you may ask?
Well, there are almost no limits! Love, marriage, relationship advice, work, money, and business opportunities are just some of the topics.
Here are some imaginary samples to inspire you with ideas:
- Will I meet the true love of my life in 2026?
- Is there anyone loving me secretly?
- Is it too late for me to change my career path?
- It’s trendy to be a vegetarian. Should I become one?
- What does the near future hold for me?
- Why did we break up last year? What was our compatibility score?
Want more examples? Check them out in the app!
If you don’t have a specific question at the moment feel free to ask for your monthly or yearly horoscope, or simply enjoy daily thoughts and even earn free credits.
Why are predictions accurate?
Vedic astrologers make readings based on a deep analysis of birth charts, zodiac signs, relevant surroundings, and personal factors. It lets them predict the future in the most accurate way. The daily guidance of a personal astrologer can be indispensable on the road to your happiness and prosperity.
A wish for insight is what gets you started. The Yodha app is what keeps you going.
Yodha Team
Get more options with the weekly / monthly “Astrologer Selection” and “Extended Message Length” subscriptions. The price and currency will vary by type and location. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of selected plan. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://yodha.app/privacy

SomNote is the best notepad app that over 2+ million users already picked! Along with a beautifully designed user interfaces, it offers high-speed access. Moreover, you can change fonts for free and it allows you to attach pictures or documents on the notes. Notes and attached files can be automatically synced so you can view it on all your devices, including PCs and iPads. Synced notes and files can be restored safely even after you've reformatted your devices. The future of notepad is in SomNote. Check it out now!
* Features
- Taking a note: Take notes and edit with SomNote. You can take pictures and attach it and also put a picture you draw yourself into a note. Wanna read pdf and text files? Just pull it from PC and read it on your mobile device.
- Making a folder: Folder feature is now included in SomNote. Make any folder in any color and name you like - categorize all your notes according to your taste.
- Protecting your secret: SomNote will protect your notes. You can lock your note, folder, and even SomNote itself. Keep your secret diary notes safe from others with ease!
- Finding your note: You can find every note with the Search menu. It will instantly highlight every note and folder simultaneously as you type what you want to find.
* Extra features
- Auto sync: every note and file written and attached in SomNote will be saved automatically after you log-in. SomNote will keep everything you write safely even if you initialize or lose your mobile.
- Theme: Meet special SomNote, picking up themes designed in various ways.
- Font: four beautiful fonts are waiting for you in the setting menu in addition to basic system fonts and more gorgeous fonts are coming. Stay tune with SomNote!
- Sort: you can sort your notes by a date and alphabetical order and we will add more sorting methods steadily.
- Restore: when you activate automatic backup, you can also restore a note at a point of time you want with "time machine" function and also restore even a deleted note from the trash. Try it on SomNote web.
- View mode: SomNote can show you all folders and notes in a thumbnail and list view. Try it by tapping the upper left button at home screen.
If you have any problem or question about SomNote, please contact us by email below. We will always answer your question and help you use SomNote better everyday!

- SomNote web: http://somcloud.com

bluejetty:00069836:ios.summary: Fast: Fasting Tracker & Timer helps you build consistent fasting habits with flexible fasting plans, body weight logging, water intake tracking, reminders, and detailed progress insights. Whether you're new to intermittent fasting or alread
bluejetty:00069836:ios.description:
Fast: Fasting Tracker & Timer helps you build consistent fasting habits with flexible fasting plans, body weight logging, water intake tracking, reminders, and detailed progress insights. Whether you're new to intermittent fasting or already following a routine, the app provides the tools to stay organized and work toward your personal health and wellness goals.
Choose a fasting plan, customize your schedule, and track every fast in one place with an easy-to-use fasting tracker.
FASTING PLANS
Find a fasting schedule that works for your lifestyle. Choose from 12:12, 13:11, 14:10, 15:9, 16:8, 17:7, 18:6, 19:5, 20:4, 21:3, 22:2, 23:1, MWF, TTS, or create your own custom fasting plan.
Whether you're starting intermittent fasting or maintaining an existing routine, you can choose a plan that suits your goals.
FASTING TRACKER & TIMER
Track active and completed fasts with an intuitive fasting tracker and timer. Review your fasting history and monitor your consistency over time.
BODY WEIGHT & WATER TRACKING
Log your body weight and monitor changes throughout your fasting routine. Track your daily water intake to stay hydrated and build healthier habits alongside your fasting schedule.
SMART REMINDERS
Stay on schedule with fasting reminders and water intake reminders. Customize notifications to help you start and end your fasting window on time while maintaining your daily hydration routine.
ANALYTICS & HISTORY
Review your fasting sessions, body weight, hydration logs, activity, and history with easy-to-understand analytics that help you monitor your progress and stay consistent.
INFORMATIVE BLOGS
Learn more about intermittent fasting through informative blogs covering healthy habits, wellness topics, and practical guidance to help you better understand your fasting routine.
FASTING BUDDIES
Stay motivated by fasting together. Invite friends, track each other's progress, and encourage one another throughout your fasting journey with the Buddy feature.
ACTIVITY SUPPORT
Sync your activity data to keep your fasting progress and daily activity organized in one place for a more complete overview of your routine.
Whether you're following a 16:8 fasting schedule, exploring different intermittent fasting plans, or creating a custom fasting routine, Fast: Fasting Tracker & Timer gives you the tools to stay organized and build lasting healthy habits.
DISCLAIMER
This app is intended for informational and lifestyle purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any fasting routine, especially if you have an existing medical condition, are pregnant, or have specific dietary requirements.
PRIVACY POLICY
https://maximaapps.com/fasting/privacy_policy.html 
TERMS OF USE
https://maximaapps.com/fasting/terms-of-use.html 
GET IN TOUCH
Have questions, feedback, or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you.
Contact us through the app or email us at feedback@maximaapps.com.

bluejetty:00158233:ios.summary:

Whether you’re in need of a Handyman, Heavy Lifter, Junk Removalist, House Cleaner, Carpenter, Snow Sho
bluejetty:00158233:ios.description:
Connect with local, experienced, and background checked contractors (Taskers) to help you get any task done efficiently on Sydetasker. 
Whether you’re in need of a Handyman, Heavy Lifter, Junk Removalist, House Cleaner, Carpenter, Snow Shoveler…. Post your task on Sydetasker. We provide qualified Taskers to help you complete any job that you cannot (or do not want to) do yourself! 
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create and post your task for free
2. Experienced Taskers put offers on your task, and are allowed to ask questions for more details on the task
3. Choose & accept your preferred Tasker
4. Discuss time/date with your Tasker, and get it done! 
PAYMENT
Payment is all simply handled through the Sydetasker Payment Platform. We hold the customer’s money securely while the task is being completed, to make sure it is done right, before any money is transferred. 
Payment is negotiated between the Tasker and the Poster (Customer). We believe that every task is different, as well as every Tasker; so we leave negotiation power in your hands. Sydetasker keeps the platform running by charging a service fee to Taskers. This fee will be included in the Tasker’s quotes. 
OUR MOST POPULAR TASKS
General Yardwork
Handyman
Assembly
Hourly Labor
Junk Removal
Heavy Lifting
Photography
House Cleaning
Gutter Cleaning
Anything you need done
WE ARE HERE TO HELP
Sydetasker helps improve our users’ lives in many different ways. Our goal is to help users accomplish tasks that might not have been possible before, leading to a win-win for both the Task Poster and Tasker. Sydetasker support is also readily available for dispute resolution.

bluejetty:00152392:ios.description:
You graduated from school and expected a big salary? You were wrong. You couldn't find a job and started working as a courier.
Beat traffic – Pass vehicles, race against the clock.
Deliver orders – Pick up from a restaurant, deliver to the customer.
Earn money – Manage your finances properly, don't waste your money.
Pay the bills - Your family expects a lot from you.
Upgrade your bike – Buy new ones, upgrade your speed and maneuverability.
Manage your energy – Balance between food, sleep, and life is important.
Life is real – Your bike can break down, you can get sick, make some money!
8 ENDINGS
There are 8 different endings. Who you approach changes the course of the story.
Selin – The customer you're in love with. He cares about you. He thinks about you.
Rıdvan – A penniless student. He constantly bets money and is looking to get rich.
Mafia Birol – A kebab shop owner mafia. He's offering you special offers. Be careful.
Family – Your mother, father, uncle and brother will drive you crazy.
Officer Selim – Watches your suspicious movements. Never break the law.
Hakan from Human Resources – Checks that orders are delivered correctly from the headquarters.
Explore the story for more.
FEATURES
- Pixel art atmosphere
- Story-based progression with 8 endings
- Different dialogues based on choices
- Simple controls, deep experience
- Different motorcycles and upgrades
- Chance events
- Endless mode
WARNING
This game may contain strong language, crude humor, and criminal themes. All content is purely fictional and is not intended to target any individual, community, institution, brand, or company. 
The Kubasta font used in this game was created by Kai Kubasta.
A game by Hüseyin Bayır.

bluejetty:00186011:ios.description:
Buy & sell real estate, cars, fashion, electronics & more. Fast delivery in Iraq!
Welcome to iBazzar – Iraq’s trusted marketplace for shopping and selling online. Whether you're looking to buy everyday essentials or sell your own car, house, or used items, iBazzar brings everything you need in one easy-to-use app. From electronics and clothing to kitchenware and self-care products, enjoy a seamless shopping experience designed for Iraq.
REAL ESTATE, CARS, ELECTRONICS, FASHION, HOME, KITCHEN, BEAUTY & MORE
Explore a wide variety of categories across the app. Shop for brand-new and used smartphones, TVs, laptops, and appliances. Browse the latest clothing for men, women, and kids. Upgrade your space with home furniture and kitchen essentials. Post your house, land, or car for sale and connect directly with interested buyers. Whether you're a casual shopper or a business owner, iBazzar supports your journey.
SELL YOUR PRODUCTS FAST
Selling on iBazzar is easy – just upload photos, add a description, and start receiving messages from buyers across Iraq. You can list personal items, store products, or large assets like homes and vehicles. Manage your listings, mark products as sold, and reach real users near you.
TRUSTED SHOPPING EXPERIENCE IN IRAQ
iBazzar is built for the Iraqi market, offering localized features that fit your lifestyle. Many items support delivery, giving buyers the option to receive products at home. Sellers can manage orders and communicate safely through in-app chat, while buyers can enjoy transparency, quality, and real-time support.
EXCLUSIVE DEALS & DISCOUNTS
Take advantage of limited-time offers, seasonal promotions, and featured deals from top sellers. From tech and fashion to beauty and home goods, find the right product at the right price.
MULTIPLE CATEGORIES & GROWING STORES
iBazzar isn’t just a buy-and-sell app – it’s a full marketplace. Discover local stores offering everything from electronics to kitchen tools. Support businesses near you or start your own digital store in minutes.
SECURE PAYMENTS & DELIVERY OPTIONS
Pay with cash on delivery for a safe and simple checkout experience. Enjoy fast and reliable delivery for select categories, available in major cities across Iraq.
MADE FOR IRAQ
iBazzar is proudly made for Iraq and growing every day. Whether you’re in Baghdad, Erbil, Basra, or beyond – the app connects people across the country with the products and opportunities they’re looking for.
Whether you call it Bazzar, Bazar, Baazar, Bazaar, Baazzaar, Bazzaar, Bazarr, Baazzaarr – all roads lead to one place: iBazzar.
Download iBazzar today and join thousands of users across Iraq buying, selling, and discovering new deals every day.

bluejetty:00071489:ios.description:
Never Forget Where You Parked Your Car!
Tired of forgetting where you left your car? Or getting a parking fine because your meter expired? Find My Car saves your parking spot automatically—and gets you back to your vehicle, stress-free.
Whether you're in a crowded city, a huge parking garage, or an unfamiliar neighborhood, Find My Car has you covered with the features everyday drivers actually need.
— KEY FEATURES —
► Auto-Park — Hands-Free Parking Detection
Let the app save your location automatically. Auto-Park detects when you step out of the car via Bluetooth or motion sensors and saves the spot without you lifting a finger.
► Save Parking Location Instantly
One tap saves your car's GPS location. Drag & drop the pin to fine-tune for perfect accuracy.
► GPS Accuracy Indicator
See exactly how precise your location is before saving—so you can always trust the pin.
► Offline Maps
Download OpenStreetMap tiles for your area and navigate to your car even with no mobile data.
► Apple Watch Support
Save and find your parking directly from your wrist—no need to take out your phone.
► Route Guidance to Your Car
Get walking directions and real-time distance updates via Apple Maps, Google Maps, or Navigon.
► Parking Timer & Alerts
Set a meter timer and receive push notifications before time runs out—even when the app is closed.
► Photo Reminder & Notes
Snap a photo of your surroundings and add notes like floor, zone, or section number—perfect for multi-story parking garages.
► Home Screen Widget
Check your parking distance at a glance without even opening the app.
► Share Your Location
Instantly share your car's location with passengers or family members.
Find My Car is the ultimate parking companion—trusted by drivers worldwide.
Download now and never lose your parking spot again!

bluejetty:00028808:ios.description:
Pass your ASWB exam with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
ASWB is a nonprofit organization composed of the social work regulatory boards and colleges of all 50 states. ASWB maintains the social work licensing examinations that are used to test a social worker’s competence to practice ethically and safely. Our app is organized to closely follow the actual objectives for ASWB test. These ASWB practice tests contain questions from four main knowledge domains:
- Human Development, Diversity, and Behavior in the Environment
- Assessment, Diagnosis, and Treatment Planning
- Psychotherapy, Clinical Interventions, and Case Management
- Professional Values and Ethics
Follow a specially designed personal study plan and train yourself to pass the first time!
Key features:
- Choose from different topics required to pass a certification
- Practice with 3000+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://mastrapi.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://mastrapi.com/policy

Via Newark is your go-to app for getting around Newark. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go.

-Enter your pickup and dropoff locations and we’ll tell you the best journey available at that time. 
-Book Via Newark rides directly in the app for you and any additional passengers

-There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! 
What we’re about:
- FOR THE COMMUNITY: Via Newark was made to empower the Newark community because transportation shouldn’t be an issue in your daily lives. With Via Newark, getting around the neighborhood and connecting to the rest of the city has just become a breeze. 
- SHARED: Our algorithm helps you see the best transit journey available at that time. Using Via Newark, you’ll be matched with others headed in the same direction. This combines convenience and comfort with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a shared ride. Transit at its best.
- FREE: Via Newark offers a fare-free system, offering free rides throughout the city.
- SAFE: Via Newark prioritizes your safety. Our drivers are thoroughly vetted, ensuring a safe and secure journey to your destination.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00161998:ios.description:
Welcome to the Flightnetwork app!
Our app puts the world in the palm of your hand. Fast, simple, safe and secure–instantly access your booking details and experience real-time updates and notifications so you never miss a flight again. Easily update your booking with baggage and other services from our pre-travel store. Get access to exclusive offers like early check-in for free (a €15 value), plus save up to 70% on flights, hotels rental cars and so much more!
What are you waiting for? Download now and let’s get travelling!  
FREE EARLY CHECK-IN
- Exclusively for our app users, passengers can now check-in for their flight, months in advance – for free! Let us do the hard work for you and we’ll send your boarding card directly to your mobile device. 
BOOKING INFO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
- Multiple bookings? No problem! All your bookings in one place–no need to head to the airline’s website or download their apps
- Easily access your booking info. From your reservation details, boarding passes the app has everything you need. Plus you’ll receive real-time notifications on gate or schedule changes in real-time, so you’ll never miss a flight again
BOOK FLIGHTS TO ANY DESTINATION, WORLDWIDE:
- Search and compare more than 650 airlines, big and small, to find the best deal there is.
- Flexible booking options – we get it, changes happen! Choose our Flexible Ticket option and change your flight when you need to.
AVAILABLE FOR A WIDE SELECTION OF BRANDS
- Get your booking info for many popular booking platforms including Gotogate, Supersaver, Supersavertravel, Flybillet, Travelstart, Travelfinder, Goleif, Travelpartner, Seat24, Flygvaruhuset, Avion, Budjet, Trip, Mytrip, Pamediakopes, Airtickets24, Flight Network and FlyFar.
ADD SERVICES ON THE FLY
- Already booked? Travel just the way you want by adding baggage, choosing your seat and more from our pre-travel store. 
PAY YOUR WAY
- Choose from a number of payment options available throughout the world.
FIND AND BOOK GREAT HOTELS
- The best places, the best prices – with more than 300,000 hotels to choose from, there’s something for everyone.
CHEAP CAR RENTAL ANYWHERE AND ANYTIME
- Search and find great deals on rental cars. Take the scenic route and explore your destination at your leisure.

bluejetty:00070843:ios.summary:

SHRM Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into con
bluejetty:00070843:ios.description:
SHRM Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the Society of Human Resource Management (SHRM) certification exam with a high score on your first attempt.
SHRM Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to SHRM certification exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Pass the exam on the first attempt ###
In SHRM Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official exam requirements. Depending on the exam requirements, you will need to acquire knowledge in 6 subjects, each containing 4-6 subdivided content areas. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Leadership
- Business
- Interpersonal
- People
- Organization
- Workplace
### Key Features ###
- Over 1500 questions to practice, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized exercises by content area with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the Advanced HR Certification Exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on SHRM Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the SHRM exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://shrm.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://shrm.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00069840:ios.description:
List ◎ is an easy to use app that will let you create and maintain lists & checklists all in one place.
——— PICK SUGGESTED ITEMS ———
Get up and running with very little effort by using our Pick Suggested Items feature.
We provide templates of popular lists so that you don't have to type them youself.
From our Packing Template you can pick items from these categories: Essentials, Accessories, Baby, Backpack / Carry On, Beach, Camping, Clothing, Electronics, Food, Healthcare, Makeup, Shoes, Toiletries and many more!
From our Shopping Template you can pick items from these categories: Baby Care, Beverages, Breakfast, Cleaning, Condiments, Eggs & Dairy, Frozen, Fruits, Meat, Poultry, Pet Items, Toiletries, Vegetables and many more!
Also: Baby shopping list and cleaning checklist. More to come!
That's it: your list will be ready without any typing involved.
——— SYNC YOUR LISTS ———
Created your list on your iPad but want to check it on your iPhone? Got a new iOS device and want to see your lists there?
With iCloud sync we've got you covered: your lists will be with you on all your iOS devices as long as you are using the same Apple ID in them.
——— REUSE YOUR EXISTING LISTS ———
You can uncheck all items, duplicate a complete list or start a new list by importing some items from your previous lists.
Do you have a weekly grocery list? Just uncheck all items after shopping and it will be ready for your next trip to the store.
Travel often? Going to your dream vacation? Build your own Master List and refine it by removing stuff that wasn't useful on your last trip and adding things that you need.
——— SET REMINDERS ———
Want to make sure that you are not forgetting anything? Just set up a reminder, get a notification at the right time and relax!
——— CREATE YOUR OWN CATEGORIES ———
Organize your items by grouping them into different categories.
You will be able to create as many categories as you need, and you can pick an emoji to better differentiate them.
——— MANAGE ITEM QUANTITIES ———
Set the quantities for your List items.
——— QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK? ———
We love hearing from you and we read every single email you send us!
Have suggestions? Please contact us at info@listmaker.app

bluejetty:00166637:ios.description:
Take control of your nutrition with Food Scouter, the app that makes calorie and macro tracking effortless. Whether you're aiming to lose weight, build muscle, or maintain a healthy lifestyle, Food Scouter is your perfect companion. Just snap a photo of your meal, and let Food Scouter do the rest!
Key Features:
Effortless Tracking: Simply take a picture of your food, drink, or entire meal, and Food Scouter instantly calculates the calories and macros for you—no manual entry needed!
Personalized Goals: Food Scouter tailors your calorie and macro goals based on your height, weight, gender, activity level, and personal objectives, ensuring you stay on track.
Real-Time Advice: Receive instant feedback and advice on your nutrition based on your current macros, activity level, and the time of day.
Seamless Integration: Sync with the Health app to automatically track your activity level and record your daily macro intake, making the process seamless and automatic.
Historical Tracking: Review your past meals, snacks, and drinks with detailed historical data, helping you stay accountable and monitor your progress over time.
Activity-Based Adjustments: Food Scouter adjusts your macro and calorie goals in real time, taking into account your physical activity to help you achieve balanced nutrition every day.
Intuitive Interface: Enjoy a clean, user-friendly interface that makes tracking your diet simple and stress-free.
Smart Notifications: Stay motivated with reminders and alerts that keep you focused on your nutrition goals throughout the day.
With Food Scouter, achieving your health and fitness goals has never been easier. Start your journey to better nutrition today!

bluejetty:00027242:ios.description:
The best way to view Idaho 511 traffic alerts, road conditions and travel information.
MAIN FEATURES INCLUDE:
 + Road Conditions, Closures & Planned Events 
 + ITD 511 Traffic Incidents
 + Customizable Push Notifications
 + CCTV Traffic Cameras
 + Home Screen Widgets
 + Winter Driving Weather
ITD TRAFFIC INCIDENTS INCLUDE:
Traffic collisions, advisories, hazards, weather / wind advisories, heavy traffic, road closures, planned construction
CCTV CAMERAS
Create customized groups of CCTV cameras for viewing traffic on your route. This feature gives users a quick way of assessing road and traffic conditions.
HOME SCREEN CAMERA WIDGETS
Add up to (4) home screen widgets displaying your favorite CCTV cams.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Track ITD incidents and receive Push Notifications when new updates are available. The app also sends notifications when an incident is no longer being tracked by ITD. This feature is critical for staying up-to-date on road closures due to accidents. 
WINTER DRIVING WEATHER:
 - NOAA Snowfall Reports
 - Current Radar
 - NWS Watches & Warnings
 - Winter Weather Severity Index
TERMS & CONDITIONS

bluejetty:00095962:ios.description:
Create, share, and e-sign documents in minutes using Jotform Sign. Automate workflows with documents that can be signed on any device. Simplify your document signing process with Jotform Sign!
Jotform Sign is your go-to app for managing electronic signatures quickly and efficiently. Whether you're finalizing agreements, signing contracts, or gathering approvals, this app ensures a seamless experience for you and your collaborators.
Jotform Sign: Your all-in-one electronic signature solution:
1 - Build documents easily by turning your existing PDFs into e-sign documents with a single tap.
2 - Collect signatures. Securely gather signatures anytime, anywhere — without the trouble of messy paperwork.
3 - Automate document processes. Eliminate manual tasks with Jotform Sign’s automation features.
Key Features:
In-person signatures: Different people, same device, one smooth signing experience.
Easy document creation: Upload, edit, and customize your documents with our intuitive builder.
Effortless signing process: Send documents to others, collect signatures, and track real-time progress.
Multi-party signing: Easily coordinate signatures from multiple participants with a streamlined workflow.
Secure and reliable: Your documents and signatures are stored with the highest level of security.
Comprehensive audit trails: Keep track of every step in the signing process for complete transparency.
Jotform Sign’s free e-signature app works seamlessly with various document types and formats:
Upload a document as a PDF, JPG, or PNG
Scan a document with your camera
You can gather digital signatures for all types of documents with Jotform Sign, including:
Nondisclosure agreements (NDAs)
Sales contracts and proposals
Health care documents
Financial agreements
Waivers
Permission slips
Lease agreements
Download Jotform Sign now and experience a faster, smarter way to get documents signed!
Privacy Policy:
https://www.jotform.com/privacy/
Agreements and Terms:
https://www.jotform.com/terms/
