bluejetty:00171674:ios.description:
The iExit Interstate Exit Guide is a must-have on your next road trip. It figures out where you are on the Interstate, and shows you what's ahead. 
Need gas? iExit knows all the gas prices in the United States, and can tell you which station is cheapest at each exit. It also makes it easy to compare prices by the exits ahead, letting you know exactly where to exit to save the most. It works for Unleaded, Mid Grade, Premium, and Diesel.
Need food? iExit has you covered, no matter if you're looking for the usual fast food or something local. It also integrates Yelp ratings and reviews to help you decide.
Need a place to stay for the night? iExit lists all hotels within 3 miles of an exit ramp. But if you're looking for a deal, we have thousands of same-day discounted rates that are cheaper than you'll find anywhere else.
Looking for a specific chain, like Cracker Barrel? Or maybe a specific amenity, like WiFi? Or maybe a rest area? Just search for it and we'll show you the exits ahead with a match.
Don't take another road trip without iExit!
** Important Notes **
● Your device must have GPS hardware or a connection to the internet for iExit to display results based on your location.
● iExit is compatible with iOS 15.0 and later.
● iExit only works in the United States on limited access highways, most of which are official Interstate highways.
If you have a question or complaint about iExit, please reach out to us first at info@iexitapp.com before leaving a bad review here. We work incredibly hard to build you the best In guide app in the App Store, and we value your feedback and will reply immediately. Thanks for using iExit!

bluejetty:00082450:ios.summary:
Welcome to Clovis, the medieval life Grand Strategy + RPG game! Become a world conqueror! King of France or Roman Emperor? The choice is yours, my lord! 
Clovis is the first entry in the Clovis Games series!
Clovis is like every other mobi
bluejetty:00082450:ios.description:
Welcome to Clovis, the medieval life Grand Strategy + RPG game! Become a world conqueror! King of France or Roman Emperor? The choice is yours, my lord! 
Clovis is the first entry in the Clovis Games series!
Clovis is like every other mobile free to play strategy game on the store. Except in every possible way! It's both strategy and narrative roleplaying game!
Exit the countless timers. Gone is the gatekeeping. Vanquished are the constant ads and the endless IAP bundles you have to buy to avoid the grind. The gods of gaming have seen enough of this, and said no more!
Enters Clovis, the ultimate grand strategy medieval war game on mobile, featuring unlimited medieval solo gameplay, no ads game, countless scenarios, and hours of offline fun. It's the perfect mix between offline war strategy and roleplaying narrative gameplay! The medieval game of your dreams!
In Clovis, you are the king of a medieval kingdom, in charge of the grand strategy of your territory. Your two main goals? Conquer new territories, and build a dynasty by raising a royal family! Yes, your grace, this empire simulation will bring to you total war and world conquest. From Paris to Constantinople, this country game will bring you the thrill of these terrible ages of conflict and European wars. Who said medieval life was easy?
Build castles, send expeditions, raise levies, pass new laws, research groundbreaking technologies, and more! Clovis is deeply strategic, but also narrative-focused, with tons of lore, and characters from real history that you can interact with! Play as a Roman emperor, an Ostrogothic Dux Bellorum, or as Clovis, the first king of France! Europe is yours in this strategy war game.
Clovis is also really customizable. Want to play as Arthur, King of Avalon, or a crusader king from the middle ages? You can, it's your own medieval life!
Build your legacy through marriage, conquest, and plots. You can start your dynasty by marrying the daughter of a new powerful ally, then use Dynasty Skills to pass perks to your newborn son, before punishing a traitor through a well-organized plot! Or play war games, using Europe and its kingdoms as your playground. Become a medieval world conqueror!
Live your own story through your actions and our countless procedurally generated events, creating unique possibilities every time you play! Will you face bandits, organize tournaments, greet your subjects at a banquet, or even meet the Dark Swordmaster in person? Who knows! Find out with our king simulation + medieval life sim
But besides the map-centered medieval grand strategy gameplay, Clovis also includes plenty of meta-game stuff, like cross-save artefacts, seasonal scenarios, legendary queens and crusader kings, leaderboards, and more! It's the ultimate game of kings!
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00021022:ios.name: Life Choices: Life Simulator
bluejetty:00021022:ios.summary: Are you bored with so-called life simulation games in which the choices you make have no point? Then give Life Choices a try! From the creators of Brain Test Tricky Puzzles, Brain Test 2 Tricky Stories and Who Is? Tricky Riddles! A little b
bluejetty:00021022:ios.description:
Are you bored with so-called life simulation games in which the choices you make have no point? Then give Life Choices a try! From the creators of Brain Test Tricky Puzzles, Brain Test 2 Tricky Stories and Who Is? Tricky Riddles! A little bit life, a little bit choices. This game is more about the decisions.
Our life growing game is a bit life simulator game. You navigate the twists and turns of your very own life story, making hard choices that shape your journey from birth to adulthood. With its richly interactive stories and chapters, life story game offers a unique blend of family life and life game in every episode. 
Unicoville needs your help as the town needs repairs and restoration. Bring new people to the town, play their lives, complete objectives and see the town reborn before your eyes. Life simulator game is a free offline game. My life is a game! Play adorable angels and devils. It is a little bit simulator but mostly a story of heaven and hell when you come first to life.
Become anyone and express yourself freely in this game of life simulation. Create dozens of characters, live their whole life from birth to death, and make difficult choices along the way. Live all the bits of my life. Hell heaven game is one of the best games in the world.
Life Choices is a fun, interactive and interesting life simulation game filled with surprises. There are more than 1000 choices for you to make as you shape your characters’ lives and decide their fates. Start from the beginning of life and grow into an old person. Life game and judgment day features.
Each decision in this life sim influences your personal narrative, inviting you to explore the depth of life games through engaging chapters and episodes in this family life simulator. 
BUILD YOUR SKILLS!
Work on your intelligence, strength and art as you fight the hardships of life. Each choice affects your skills and your skills affect the outcome of your choices. If you like simulator games and story games, this game is very adorable.
BUILD A TOWN!
Rebuild the houses of Unicoville and see the town flourish again. Pick from different house variations and establish your style. Enjoy the gorgeous 3D rendered town graphics. Choose your life and make your decision on your life. angel and devil games in an adorable life simulator.
BUILD A HOUSE!
Start with a small house and unlock bigger ones as you play. Customize dozens of rooms to your liking and pick furniture from a vast library of selections. All objects are beautifully rendered in 3D.
CHOOSE A JOB!
There are several jobs and career paths to choose from. Work as a doctor, police, scientist, president, mafioso or cook. You can even go into crazy careers and become a superhero or a monarch. If you don’t like working, you can live as unemployed and earn money through some side hustles.
BECOME GOOD or EVIL!
This game is not a stairway to heaven. You are not forced to be a good person. You can choose to become evil as well. Fight your way up into the top spots at Karma Leaderboards as someone who is good or evil.
PLAY STORY LIVES!
Life Choices allows you to create your own unique characters, but you can also play the story characters and help them achieve their life goals. Help Meredith to become an astronaut, or help Jeff to take his revenge. Live all the bits of life with interesting stories.
Features:
● Free to download, free to play, and free to enjoy. No hidden fees.
● More than 1000 choices to make.
● Dozens of different character sets.
● Family friendly gameplay with no explicit content.
● Customize the town to your liking. Design your own houses.
● Customize your house with lots of options.
● Play the story lives filled with exciting events.
● Humorous situations and surprising events.
● Fight for the Karma Leaderboards.
● Find your romance.
● Dozens of different endings.
● Addictive and relaxing gameplay.
● Play without the internet.
● Simple and highly addictive game play.
● Play offline.
Have fun!

bluejetty:00119202:ios.description:
Introducing HesabPay - Your Trusted Mobile Wallet
HesabPay is the ultimate payment solution to pay anyone, anywhere and anytime - empowering you to create your own secure digital wallet instantly and providing you with instant access to a world of financial possibilities.
Seamless Money Transfers:
Say goodbye to long waiting times and complicated processes. HesabPay enables you to transfer money effortlessly from over 20 channels, including banks, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Microsoft Pay, and even USDC. Experience the convenience of instant and hassle-free money transfers right at your fingertips.
Beyond Mobile Payments:
HesabPay goes beyond mobile payments. Paying bills has never been easier, as you can settle your utilities, internet, and other bills conveniently from within the app. Need to recharge your mobile? HesabPay has got you covered with seamless mobile top-up services. It's your one-stop solution for all your financial needs.
Worldwide Cash Withdrawals:
Need to withdraw cash? No problem! HesabPay offers the flexibility to withdraw money using any nearby HesabPay or MoneyGram agent. No matter where you are in the world, access cash easily and conveniently whenever you need.
Mobile App Convenience:
For smartphone users, our HesabPay mobile app provides a sleek and user-friendly interface that allows you to access all the features and services with just a few taps. Experience the full power of HesabPay's capabilities right on your smartphone, making financial transactions and managing your funds easier than ever before.
USSD Accessibility:
We haven't forgotten about feature phone users. With HesabPay's USSD support, even if you don't own a smartphone, you can still enjoy the benefits of a digital wallet. Simply dial the provided USSD code on your feature phone, and you'll have access to a wide range of financial services, including money transfers, bill payments, and cash withdrawals.
Trusted and Secure:
Rest assured knowing that your funds and personal information are safe with HesabPay. We utilize state-of-the-art security measures to protect your transactions and keep your data secure at all times.
Join thousands of satisfied users who have embraced the financial freedom offered by HesabPay. Say goodbye to the limitations of traditional banking and embrace the convenience of an online digital mobile wallet. Download HesabPay today and experience a new era of financial accessibility and convenience!

bluejetty:00149805:ios.description:
Atrium Connect is used by top colleges and universities, senior living and businesses for streamlined, secured campus account access.
Features:
• Add a scannable campus ID card to your Apple Wallet (select institutions)
• Upload your photo (select institutions)
• Purchase meals and manage meal plans (select institutions)
• Use your virtual credential 
• View account balances, recent transactions and set up alerts
* View, filter and map all locations that accept your ID card and place orders online
• Add money easily to accounts using Apple Pay and other payment methods 
• Search for and view participating locations
Atrium Connect Highlights:
Account Management: 
View balances and transactions for all meal, debit and event accounts. Add funds and store payment information. Automate deposits and receive low balance notifications.
Meals:
Manage your meal plans the way that you want to. 
Deposits:
Account holders can access account history and use budgeting tools, all within your own campus-specific domain. 
Off-Campus Purchases:
View, filter and map all locations that accept your ID card and place your order online.
Safety:
Atrium Connect provides contactless solutions and secure account access. You can easily report credentials lost/stolen.
Activation:
To download the app and activate your account, contact your campus ID card office for help. 
Privacy:
Terms of service: https://www.atriumconnnect.com/terms 
Privacy policy: https://www.atriumconnnect.com/privacy

bluejetty:00161080:ios.name: SeeClap IPTV Player
bluejetty:00161080:ios.summary:
At night you want to press Play. Not hunt through an IPTV playlist twelve thousand lines long.
SeeClap is the IPTV player that turns your subscription — Xtream Codes, M3U, M3U8 or 1Stream — into a real library: posters, plot summaries, cas
bluejetty:00161080:ios.description:
At night you want to press Play. Not hunt through an IPTV playlist twelve thousand lines long.
SeeClap is the IPTV player that turns your subscription — Xtream Codes, M3U, M3U8 or 1Stream — into a real library: posters, plot summaries, cast, seasons in order, and playback that resumes exactly where you stopped. On iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, everything stays in sync.
▸ YOUR IPTV PLAYLIST IN THIRTY SECONDS
Paste an Xtream Codes address, an M3U/M3U8 link, or import the file. You can also scan a QR code, or photograph the screen where your provider shows your credentials: SeeClap reads them on the device. No size limit.
▸ LIVE TV, EPG GUIDE AND REPLAY
Every channel, what's on now and next, instant zapping, a moving preview before you even enter. Pin a show and get a reminder before it starts. Replay and catch-up on Xtream and 1Stream playlists, whenever your provider offers them.
▸ MOVIES AND SERIES ENRICHED BY TMDb
High-resolution posters, synopses, ratings, trailers, actor pages. Series sorted by season, watched episodes marked. Same film in several versions? Each is tagged by language and quality — 1080p, 4K, original audio.
▸ A PLAYER THAT DOESN'T STALL
Three playback engines to pick from (KSPlayer, VLC, MPV) and an automatic switch when a format resists: MKV, HEVC, 4K, HLS, TS. Audio and subtitle tracks selectable, online subtitle search, pinch to reframe.
▸ YOUR OWN VIDEOS TOO
Import your files from the iPhone, or over Wi-Fi from a computer's browser. SeeClap finds the poster and summary, and creates or translates their subtitles right on the device (compatible devices).
▸ EVERYWHERE, TOGETHER
Favorites, history and playback positions synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Native Apple TV app, widgets on iPhone. Cast to Chromecast and smart TVs (DLNA), controlled from your iPhone: SeeClap checks the stream and offers a compatible version when one exists. Offline downloads and Picture in Picture on iPhone and iPad.
▸ ORGANIZED, AND UNDER CONTROL
Instant search, filters by genre and country, suggestions computed on your device, parental control with a PIN, light or dark theme. Plus a network diagnostic when your provider goes quiet.
FREE, THEN PREMIUM
Explore the whole app for free, with two minutes per playback. Premium removes the limit: unlimited playback, favorites, resume, reminders, downloads, your own videos, casting to the TV.
What is the best IPTV player for iPhone and Apple TV? The one that plays your formats without stalling, finds the artwork for your films, and follows you from screen to screen.
IMPORTANT
SeeClap provides NO video content and is not affiliated with any IPTV provider. You must import your own legally obtained subscription. Not affiliated with TMDb.
Privacy Policy: https://seeclap.com/en/privacy-policy/
Terms and Conditions: https://seeclap.com/en/terms-and-condition/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00066397:ios.description:
The Zalando app is your new go-to for quality fashion and lifestyle brands (over 6,000!), outfit and beauty inspiration at your fingertips, and a shopping experience that’s all smooth and no stress.
IT'S GIVING INSPIRATION
• Follow your favourite creators for outfit and styling inspo
• Follow brands you like to see more from them first, including new releases and exclusive collections
• Curate and follow boards of the outfits, videos, and products that inspire you, and start inspiring others
• Explore what’s trending across Europe with Trend Spotter and see what everyone’s wearing in Berlin, Paris, and Milan right now
• Tune into our Live videos to get tips from the experts, product how-tos, and inspo you can add directly to your bag
• Tap into Stories to get your style and culture guide with features like “What do I wear?” plus the latest on major brand collabs
• Save your faves to your wishlist and never miss a size update or price drop
IT'S GIVING CHOICE
• Browse over 11,000 items from a wide range of brands, including all-time fashion favourites
• Dive into our different assortments: clothing, shoes, accessories, sports, beauty and skincare, preloved gems, and kidswear
• Get updates on the things you care about - from news and trends to sales and discount codes
• Hear about new collections and product launches from the brands you love
• Never miss a price drop or restock by opting in to notifications on items in your wishlist
• Give preloved clothing a new life when you shop our extensive selection of pre-owned (but just like new!) clothing, accessories, and boots
Pick your preferred way to pay and enjoy delivery directly to your own doorstep
IT'S GIVING PERSONAL
• Benefit from spot-on recommendations that show you the items you’ll love, without you needing to go looking for them
• Rate how the fashion you’ve ordered fits and get personalised sizing advice as you shop
• Get measured with our measurements tool to find what fits, fast
• Try on outfits in our virtual fitting room to see how they’ll fit before ordering
• Get instant style and outfit advice from the Zalando Assistant, a tailor-made AI-powered fashion assistant to help you on your shopping journey
So, ready to explore the app?
Shop the brands you love, unlock exclusive deals, and get inspiration and recommendations that feel like they were made just for you.

bluejetty:00066349:ios.description:
Dive into the magical underwater world and learn about the secret life of cute and friendly mermaids… and a merboy! Explore the ocean and play fun games with adorable dolphins, exotic fish, crabs and other sea creatures! Dress up, style, make food and clean the ocean from nasty rubbish!
Mermaid Mei lives in The Asian Sea with her friends: a crab and a shark! Little crabby is sad because his home is dirty and full of rubbish from The Land. Let’s help the crab clean up his once beautiful underwater place. The shark is hungry and wants a burger! Prepare the yummiest meal: choose needed ingredients and put them in the right order! Oh no, Mei’s hair is such a mess! Help her make it pretty again and create the most beautiful ocean princess tiara!
Merboy Justin lives in The Cold Sea. It is a bit freezing here, but local creatures are really warm-hearted! Help penguin parents organize a birthday party for their adorable chubby baby! Make a cake and decorate the room with balloons and accessories! Baby penguin is so happy now! Look - a polar bear sells some colorful ice cream! Choose among tons of flavors, toppings and sprinkles! Yummy! Oh no! Justin’s pet seahorse disappeared! Can you help find it in the coral reefs?
Mermaid Kiara’s home is The African Sea. How colorful and magical this sea is! But it was also polluted by people from The Land! Let’s help the ocean friends clean up and make everything nice and shiny again! Remove trash and rescue a pink dolphin from chains, nets and plastic! Clean up and decorate Kiara’s house! The cutest baby octopus was drawing and its little tentacles got tangled and covered in paint! Let’s help the underwater cutie! Now, meet the most beautiful fish in The African Sea! She’s a very popular singer here and a real fashionista! Prepare the fish for her concert: create perfect makeup and fashion looks!

bluejetty:00066033:ios.name: Highrise: Dress Up Avatar Game
bluejetty:00066033:ios.summary: Find your people on Highrise. Dress up your avatar, play social games, and meet real players from all over the world with free voice chat. Over 50 million players have made friends here since 2014, with new fashion, events, and worlds every
bluejetty:00066033:ios.description:
Find your people on Highrise. Dress up your avatar, play social games, and meet real players from all over the world with free voice chat. Over 50 million players have made friends here since 2014, with new fashion, events, and worlds every single week.
The avatar social game where you create, hang out, and play with whoever you want, no paywall to communicate. Find your style across an ever-growing universe of fashion and social games. Whether you're here to dress up, role play, or compete in live events, this is where your creativity and your social life actually belong together.
CREATE & CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR
Start with your avatar and go wherever your imagination takes you. Pick from over 1 million fashion items: outfits, hairstyles, accessories, all of it, and build a look that's completely yours. Streetwear, fantasy, anime, luxury, dark academia — the style is up to you. New drops land every week, so there's always something fresh to add.
PLAY SOCIAL GAMES WITH FRIENDS
Highrise isn't just an avatar creator. It's a social game with a lot going on. Hop into rooms where players are hosting fashion shows, talent competitions, trivia nights, and casual hangouts. Jump into minigames, show up for weekly events, and grab exclusive rewards. Every room is its own multiplayer game: new faces, new energy, all in real time.
CHAT, CONNECT & SOCIALIZE
Text chat, voice chat, avatar emotes — however you like to communicate, Highrise has you covered. Hang out across thousands of social rooms or start your own corner of the world. Follow players you vibe with, grow your community, and share life on the social Feed. Finding your people here doesn't take long. This isn't just a chat game — it's where real friendships happen.
EXPLORE A VIRTUAL WORLD OF POSSIBILITIES
Millions of player-created rooms, with new ones going up every day. Cozy hangout spots, elaborate role play worlds, party rooms, chill vibes — there's always somewhere new to land. Highrise blends life simulation with social gaming in a way that's hard to put down. Design your own rooms, shape your virtual life, and make this metaverse yours.
A SAFER PLACE TO BE YOURSELF
Moderation runs around the clock to keep rooms welcoming. Block, mute, and report any time. Voice chat, DMs, and rooms have safety controls built in, with extra protections for younger players.
DRESS UP, TRADE & COLLECT
Hunt for the latest fashion drops, chase rare collectibles, and build a wardrobe that turns heads. The community marketplace lets you buy, sell, and trade avatar items directly with other players — inspect someone's outfit and make an offer right from the chat. With 1 million+ items and new collections every week, there's no ceiling on your style.
COLLECT & RAISE UNIQUE PETS
Highrise is home to thousands of unique virtual pets, and every single one can be yours. Collect them, raise them, and bring them into the virtual world with you. Show yours off in social rooms, trade with other players, and keep hunting for the ones you don't have yet.
DESIGN, CREATE & EARN
Got an idea? Put it in. Design avatar items and virtual rooms for the whole community to discover. Enter design contests and get your work in front of professional artists who can bring it to life. The best submissions become real items that players can collect and trade.
WHY PLAYERS LOVE HIGHRISE
- Free voice chat with real people from all over the world, built right into the app
- Millions of unique avatar items to collect, trade, and sell in a thriving community marketplace
- Digital fashion like nowhere else — chase the hottest drops, find something new every single day
- Thousands of social games and virtual world experiences with real people, not bots
- Thousands of crews to join, compete with, and earn digital collectibles alongside

We will continue working to deliver a great user experience within the app. This update contains bug fixes and performance improvements. We will highlight any new features/functionalities within the app as they become available. 
New Features: 
• Mobile Money Transfer
Securely send and receive money with Zelle® using a mobile number or email address.****
• My Profile 
With My Profile, customers will be able to do the following:
- Update their user ID and Password, phone, email and address
- Update accounts with nicknames
- Select if they want paperless statements
- Allows access to QuickBooks/Quicken.
Description: 
The Centennial Bank mobile app provides you the convenience to bank when you want and where you want through secure account access within your mobile device. 
With Centennial Bank mobile app you can: 
-Open a new account right from your app*
-Check balances
-Deposit checks**
-Transfer funds between eligible accounts
-Pay bills-** including other people
-View check images
-Locate a nearby branch or ATM
-View recent transactions
-Access MyMoney Financial Calculator***
Get started today by visiting www.my100bank.com for instructions on enrolling your device.

 What is Cropy AI?
Cropy AI is an AI-powered car photo studio that transforms any car photo into a professional, studio-quality image in seconds.
Whether taken in a parking lot, garage, or outdoor space, your vehicle photos are automatically:
• Cut out from their background
• Placed on a clean studio backdrop
• Branded with your dealership’s logo

 Key Features
• AI Background Replacement – Instantly replace any background with clean, well-lit studio showrooms
• Dealer Branding – Automatically apply your logo to license plates and backgrounds
• Smart Photo Assistant – Get real-time guidance for optimal camera angles
• Zoom & Positioning Tools – Frame your vehicle photos exactly the way you want
• Favorite Theme – Set your go-to backdrop as default for future orders
• 360° Vehicle Videos (Coming Soon) – Bring listings to life with showroom-style videos
 Real Business Impact
• +43% More Listing Clicks – Professional visuals attract more attention and help your used cars stand out in a crowded market
• 38% Faster Sales – High-quality presentation builds trust and accelerates decisions for buyers looking for a used car or cars for sale
• Save Time & Costs – No more manual editing or expensive photography
Who is Cropy AI for?
• Car dealers
• Car dealerships and dealership groups
• Used car marketplaces (e.g., mobile.de, AutoScout24, Coches.net, Cars.com, Sahibinden, Autotrader)
• Vehicle distributors and reseller networks
• Automotive photographers and inspection services
• Online car auction platforms
• Anyone listing a used car or vehicle for sale online
Cropy AI isn’t just a car photo editor — it’s a smarter, faster way to manage vehicle presentation and boost your sales.
Whether users search for “used car”, “useds car”, “car for sale”, “photo studio AI”, "Car studio AI”, "Auto studio AI”, "Auto studio ” or the name of major platforms like “Autoscout24”, Autotrader” or “Carscom”, they’ll find a solution in Cropy AI that simplifies car photography and increases performance.
Upgrade your listings. Strengthen your brand. Sell faster.

- Luận giải lá số tử vi cá nhân theo 12 cung, cung Thân và các vận quan trọng.

2. Tử vi năm 2027 (Tiểu Vận)
- Gợi ý những xu hướng nổi bật trong năm mới theo tử vi.
- Góc nhìn về công việc, tình cảm, tài chính trong năm.
- Gợi ý cách chuẩn bị tinh thần để đón năm mới nhẹ nhàng, tích cực.

- Gợi ý xu hướng từng tháng theo từng lĩnh vực trong cuộc sống.
- Những điều nên lưu tâm để bạn chuẩn bị tốt hơn.

- Gợi ý thế mạnh và những điều bạn có thể cải thiện.
- Gợi ý hướng phát triển phù hợp với tính cách của bạn.

- Nhận thưởng khi giới thiệu bạn bè sử dụng Thái Âm.
- Cả bạn và người được mời đều nhận quà hấp dẫn khi mua gói thành công.
- Theo dõi số lượt giới thiệu và phần thưởng ngay trong ứng dụng.
7. Trải nghiệm linh hoạt
- Hai cấp độ giải thích: cơ bản (dễ hiểu cho người mới) và chuyên sâu (phù hợp người nghiên cứu tử vi).

bluejetty:00017080:ios.name: Rook+
bluejetty:00017080:ios.summary:

You play South, partnered with North, against the West/East team. Rook+ uses a special deck with four colored suits numbere
bluejetty:00017080:ios.description:
Play the classic Rook trick-taking card game on your iPhone or iPad—with no ads, no tracking, and no subscriptions.
You play South, partnered with North, against the West/East team. Rook+ uses a special deck with four colored suits numbered 5 through 14, plus the powerful Rook card. In this app, the Rook is represented by a castle chess piece, and the cards are designed to be color-blind friendly.
Customize the game to match the Rook rules you know. Change the wallpaper, add optional 1 cards ranked above the 14s, choose whether players must play trump when unable to follow suit, award a bonus for winning every trick, adjust the winning score, and more.
HOW TO PLAY
Dealing: The deal rotates to the left each hand. Each player receives 9 cards, with 5 additional cards dealt to the widow in the center of the table.
Bidding: Players bid for the right to choose the trump suit. The player to the dealer’s left opens the bidding at 70 or passes. Bidding continues to the left, usually in 5-point increments. Once a player passes, that player is out of the bidding for the hand.
The Widow and Trump: The high bidder takes the 5 widow cards, which are revealed to all players, chooses the trump suit, and then discards 5 cards. The discarded cards remain hidden from the other players. Depending on your settings, point cards in the discard go either to the bidding team or to the winner of the last trick.
Playing Tricks: The dealer—or optionally the high bidder—leads the first trick. Play continues to the left, with each player playing one card. Players must follow the suit that was led when possible. If unable to follow suit, a player may play any card—or, with the appropriate option enabled, must play trump when possible. The highest card of the suit led wins unless a trump card is played, in which case the highest trump wins. The Rook is the highest trump card and can be played strategically to capture a valuable trick.
Standard card ranking from highest to lowest is:
Rook – 14 – 13 – 12 – 11 – 10 – 9 – 8 – 7 – 6 – 5
With the optional 1 cards enabled:
Rook – 1 – 14 – 13 – 12 – 11 – 10 – 9 – 8 – 7 – 6 – 5
The winner of each trick collects the four cards and leads the next trick.
Scoring: At the end of the hand, each team counts the point cards it captured:
• Rook: 20 points
• 14: 10 points
• 10: 10 points
• 5: 5 points
Other cards have no point value.
If the bidding team fails to score enough points to make its bid, the bid amount is deducted from its score. An optional bonus can also be awarded for winning every trick.
Winning: The first team to reach the selected winning score wins the game. You can adjust the target score in the game settings.
Rook+ is the paid version with no advertising. A free, ad-supported version of Rook is also available on the App Store.

bluejetty:00071049:ios.description:
Teleprompter Pro (formerly known as Teleprompter Premium) is industry recommended Teleprompter app. Used by television and movie studios including Netflix, ABC, CBS, BBC, Fox, ITV, Channel 4, UKTV and many more.
With 141K+ five-star ratings worldwide, Teleprompter Pro is widely considered the best Teleprompter app.
Teleprompter Pro is the most versatile and professional teleprompter app for your iPad and iPhone. The best Teleprompter app for iPhone, iPad and Mac!
Upgrade to Pro to access extra features:
• Import PDF, Word, Powerpoint, txt and rtf files instantly from any of your favourite apps
• Enable 'Mirroring' to reflect/reverse the text for use in professional teleprompter rigs
• Use your device camera to record your scripts as you read from the Teleprompter
• Control scrolling and speed of the Teleprompter remotely with a keyboard, handheld remote or gaming controller (with customisable button/key assignments)
• Compatible with PlayStation and Xbox Controllers
• Use other iOS devices monitor and control scrolling and speed of your scripts remotely
• Use IKAN Elite Remote to control scrolling and speed of the Teleprompter
• Mirror/reverse your script full screen on a connected display or AirPlay TV
• Export your scripts as Rich Text (.rtf) files to edit on any computer, tablet of smartphone
• Auto Captions: Automatically generate '.srt' captions and subtitles for your videos. (Pro subscription required)
Other features available without upgrading:
• Scripts scroll smoothly and clearly on the display
• Display your scripts full screen by hiding the controls while scrolling
• Control the Teleprompter from any web browser on the same WiFi network
• Control your script full screen on a connected display or AirPlay TV
• Compose and manage unlimited scripts
• Customise the text size and colour of your scripts
• Customise the background colour behind your script
• Adjustable side margins
• Select between "Continuous" or "Paging" scroll modes
• Add cue points to your scripts
• Re-arrange your scripts by title, date or arrange them in a custom order
• AirDrop your saved scripts to nearby devices
• Export and share your scripts with others quickly
• Use Timed Scrolling to have the Teleprompter scroll from start to end in a specified amount of time
• Easily export all of your script and settings to share with others, or as a backup file
• Use Apple Watch to control the scrolling of your script on your connected iPhone
... and much more!
Pro Upgrade:
The Teleprompter Pro upgrade is available as a one-time in-app purchase forever, or as a subscription for extra features. If you chose to subscribe (optional), you can cancel anytime within the app, or from your Apple ID account settings. Terms of service are available at: https://joeallenpro.com/legal/
Teleprompter Premium has been renamed to Teleprompter Pro from Late 2023 onwards.
• "The price vs performance is hard to beat. I own several software many times more expensive than this. This does the job well."
• "This app is the one thing that was missing from my professional home setup for recording videos. Friends of mine have bought actual Teleprompters and are now returning them after I told them about how great this app is! It’s easy to use, and inexpensive – 100% worth it!"
• "Over the decades I’ve used many prompters. This one is my favourite. Used it for a critical broadcast with an attentive audience, where I needed to maintain eye contact and yet be word-perfect. Worked a treat."
Teleprompter is designed for presentations, lectures, broadcasters, filmmakers, YouTubers, vlogging, speeches, music & singing, business professionals, or public speaking!

bluejetty:00043811:ios.description:
APLICATIVO PREÇO DO GÁS CONECTA O CLIENTE AO MELHOR PREÇO DO GÁS DE COZINHA
Neste aplicativo de gás da Preço do Gás você encontra todos os revendedores de botijão de gás de cozinha do seu bairro! Estamos em todo o Brasil.
Aqui você vai comparar o preço do gás da sua região e poder pedir gás de cozinha de forma rápida, prática e segura. E como vai poder comparar o Preço do Gás vai poder escolher o gás mais barato.
A entrega de gás é rápida porque já avisamos o entregador na hora, ele pode estar até na sua rua.. Ele recebe o pedido no aplicativo dele e já vai direto para sua casa. Normalmente a entrega do gás é feita em 20 minutos! 
Mas pode ser menos! Já tivemos um caso de um cliente solicitar um gás e o entregador estar no mesmo prédio! Foi incrível!
Você pode escolher o revendedor pela melhor avaliação dos outros clientes, nada melhor do que fazer uma compra tendo indicações anteriores, certo?
No App Preço do Gás você encontra vários distribuidores de gás de cozinha, de todas as marcas e regiões do Brasil! Nunca foi tão fácil pedir gás de cozinha!
Aqui em um único aplicativo você encontra todas as marcas de botijão de gás: Supergasbras, Ultragaz, Brasilgás, Liquigás, Consigaz, Copagaz, Nacional Gás e Fogás.
Você faz seu pedido de gás de cozinha, acompanha o status da entrega. Quando o entregador marcar que saiu para entrega você é notificado.
Você pede seu gás online e paga somente da entrega do gás. Pode pagar com dinheiro cartão de crédito e débito!
- SEM cobrança de taxa de Pedir o Gás Online
Por termos vários depósitos de gás espalhado em todo o Brasil e vários por bairro, a entrega de gás é muito rápida. Então chama gás da Preço do Gás e Compre o Gás mais barato!
Fique seguro com seu pedido de gás, todos os nossos revendedores são autorizados pela ANP(Agência Nacional de Petróleo) a comercializar botijão de gás!
VEJA COMO PEDIR GÁS DE COZINHA EM 3 PASSOS:
1 - Informe o endereço da entrega 
2 - Escolha o revendedor com o produto desejado
3 - Informe a hora que deseja receber, forma de pagamento (pode ser dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou débito) e finalize o pedido!
PRONTO, EM MENOS DE 1 MINUTO VOCÊ PODE PEDIR GÁS DE COZINHA
O suporte da Preço do Gás é incrível! Temos uma central de atendimento pessoal, se tiver dúvidas ou precisar de ajuda é só ligar! Encontre todos os nossos telefones no site:
https://www.precodogas.com.br/
Siga-nos nas redes sociais e acompanhe nossas campanhas promocionais:
https://www.facebook.com/Precodogas/
https://www.facebook.com/Precodogas/
https://twitter.com/Precodogas
Não precisa mais pedir gás pelo diskgas, disk gás ou telegás, peça pelo aplicativo de gás da Preço do Gás. 
Mesmo estando numa cidade pequena ou cidade grande como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Porto Alegre, Curitiba e outras.. Você sempre vai encontrar uma distribuidora de gás no app!
GANHE UM GÁS GRÁTIS SEM SORTEIO
Caso você nos indique um revendedor de gás e se ele for legalizado na ANP e aceitar se cadastrar no aplicativo do gás, você ganha uma carga de gás de 13kg grátis!!!
Basta você entregar o vazio.
Pode ganhar um gás grátis sem sorteio também, basta apenas indicar o Aplicativo Preço do Gás para os seus amigos. Quantos amigos tem nas redes sociais? Leia as regras no app.
Entrega do gás rápida em 20 minutos em média

Upgrade your fitness wardrobe with the Gymshark App, your go-to destination for gym clothes, sporting goods & workout apparel. WHY DOWNLOAD THE GYMSHARK APP?
▶ EARLY ACCESS TO EXCLUSIVE GYM CLOTHES
Stay ahead of the game & shop the newest Gymshark gym clothes & sporting goods before anyone else. With early access to fresh drops, restocks, & limited-edition releases, you'll never miss out on must-have workout gear & fitness apparel. With app-only collections, access exclusive workout clothes & high performance designs that won't be found anywhere else. 
▶ PERSONALIZED SHOPPING EXPERIENCE
Find your perfect fit with Your Edit, a customized selection of gym clothes & sporting goods tailored to your style & preferences. Whether you're searching for leggings, sports bras, workout shorts, gym hoodies, or compression wear, the app curates recommendations based on your browsing history. Shop smarter, not harder.
▶ SEAMLESS & SECURE CHECKOUT
Fast, easy, & hassle-free. With the Gymshark App, shopping for your favorite gym clothes & fitness apparel has never been simpler. Choose from multiple secure payment options, including Apple Pay, & enjoy a fast, smooth checkout experience. 
▶ INSTANT UPDATES & NOTIFICATIONS
Turn on push notifications to be the first to know about new product launches, exclusive sporting goods, workout clothes, & fitness apparel drops, flash sales, & early-access promotions. Get notified the moment your favorite gym outfits & training gear restock, so you never miss out.
▶ ORDER TRACKING & MANAGEMENT
Track your orders & stay updated on your shipment status. Whether you're waiting on a fresh pair of squat-proof leggings, high-performance gym shorts, or seamless workout tops, you’ll always know exactly when your new gym clothes will arrive.
▶ BUILD & MANAGE YOUR WISHLIST
Save your must-have gym clothes, workout gear, & sporting goods in one convenient place. Build your ideal workout wardrobe by adding sportswear essentials to your wishlist, so you can easily shop later.
▶ EXCLUSIVE CONTENT & VIP OFFERS
Unlock Gymshark-exclusive content, fitness tips, & special discounts through the app. You'll always have access to the latest workout clothes, sporting goods, & fitness fashion and trends.
▶ JOIN THE GYMSHARK COMMUNITY
More than just a clothing store, Gymshark is a movement. Be part of a global workout & fitness community that inspires, motivates, & supports your active lifestyle. Connect with fellow athletes, fitness enthusiasts, & professionals who share your passion for training, strength, & performance.
WHY SHOP WITH GYMSHARK?
We’re here to redefine gym clothes & workout apparel with high-performance designs that blend style, comfort, & function. Designed for every athlete, every workout, & every movement, our collections include:
Gym leggings & seamless leggings – Squat-proof, supportive, & ultra-flattering.
Sports bras & tops – Designed for support & breathable comfort.
Gym shorts & joggers – Flexibility, mobility, & comfort in every movement.
Hoodies & jackets – Stay warm, stay stylish, stay ready.
Compression wear & performance gear – Next-level endurance & support.
From HIIT workouts to strength training, running, yoga, & recovery days, we have the gym clothes you need to perform at your best.
DOWNLOAD THE GYMSHARK APP TODAY
Shop the best in gym clothes, fitness fashion, sporting goods, & workout gear at your fingertips. Download now & experience the ultimate Gymshark clothing store shopping experience—anytime, anywhere.

Work the way you measure. Type feet, inches and fractions of an inch tog
bluejetty:00129568:ios.description:
Fraction Calculator for feet, inches and fractions: a feet and inches calculator, a decimal to fraction converter and a unit converter in one app for iPhone and iPad.
Work the way you measure. Type feet, inches and fractions of an inch together, like 5' 3 3/8", and get the answer as a fraction to the resolution you choose, from 1/2" down to 1/64". The equation and the result stay on screen together, and you can step back into the equation to change any part of it.
FEET AND INCHES CALCULATOR
• Calculate with feet, inches and inch fractions without converting by hand
• Answers rounded to the fraction you work in: 1/2", 1/4", 1/8", 1/16", 1/32" or 1/64"
• Whole numbers and fractions together, the way a tape measure reads
DECIMAL TO FRACTION AND FRACTION TO DECIMAL
• Turn a decimal into the nearest fraction, or a fraction into a decimal
• Decimal inches to fractions, and decimal feet to feet and inches
UNIT CONVERTER
• Convert between feet-inch-fractions, inch fractions, miles, yards, decimal feet, decimal inches and metric: km, m, cm and mm
• Inches to mm, cm to inches, feet to inches, yards to feet, and mm to inches as a fraction
MADE FOR THE JOB
• A measurement calculator for construction, carpentry, woodworking and DIY
• Students can use it to check fraction homework
• Themes to choose from
• Layouts for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo

bluejetty:00061745:ios.description:
Encuentra y aplica a tu trabajo ideal en Tecoloco.com. La app de empleos de Tecoloco.com te permite crear tu CV, navegar y aplicar a diferentes oportunidades de empleo según empresas, ciudades, áreas profesionales y cargos o posiciones profesionales. Por medio de la app recibirás notificaciones que te informaran cuando existan nuevas oportunidades de empleo. Además de almacenar aquellas ofertas de trabajo de tu interés y recibir recomendaciones de empleos según tu perfil profesional.
Características principales de la App de empleos de Tecoloco.com:
• Registra tu CV y aplica a ofertas laborales
• Identifica oportunidades profesionales por país y ciudad
• Busca ofertas de las empresas más reconocidas de la región.
• Encuentra vacantes disponibles por rol y áreas profesionales
Tecoloco.com permite alcanzar tu meta laboral por medio de:
• Más de 4,000 ofertas laborales disponibles a nivel regional.
• Crear alertas de empleo personalizadas que recibirás directamente al correo electrónico.
• Recibir recomendaciones de ofertas laborales según el perfil profesional.
• Almacenar las ofertas de trabajo de tu interés.
Tecoloco.com es la bolsa de trabajo en línea líder a nivel Centroamericano que durante muchos años ha sido la plataforma de encuentro preferida entre empresas y candidatos. Tecoloco.com es parte de Saongroup exitoso grupo europeo en la industria de bolsas de trabajo con presencia en cuatro continentes.
Funciones adicionales de la App de empleos de Tecoloco.com
• Oportunidades laborales en los países de la región centroamericana:
El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica y República Dominicana.
• Vacantes disponibles en las ciudades más importantes de la región:
San Salvador, Santa Ana, San Miguel, Guatemala, Quetzaltenango, Peten, Tegucigalpa, San Pedro Sula, Atlántida, Managua, Matagalpa, Masaya, San Jose, Guanacaste, Heredia, Santo Domingo, Puerto Plata y Hermanas Mirabal.
• Encuentra empleos según áreas profesionales como:
Administración, Almacenamiento, Apoyo de Oficina, Banca y Servicios Financieros, Compras, Finanzas y Contabilidad, Informática e Internet, Mantenimiento, Mercadeo y Ventas, Operaciones y Logística, Producción e Ingeniería, Publicidad y Comunicaciones, Recursos Humanos, Telecomunicaciones, Puestos Profesionales, Call Center, Restaurantes y Salud.
• Navega y descubre las diferentes oportunidades de empleo según el cargo o posición a desempeñar.
• Por medio de la app de empleos de Tecoloco.com podrás aplicar a las ofertas de trabajo de las empresas más reconocidas y atractivas para trabajar en la región.
Acerca de Tecoloco.com
En Tecoloco.com somos la bolsa de trabajo con más reconocimiento y trayectoria a nivel regional. Por medio de nuestra herramienta serás capaz de crear tu CV y aplicar a las mejores oportunidades de empleo de las empresas más atractivas para trabajar. Tecoloco.com brinda una amplia variedad de opciones de búsqueda de ofertas laborales acorde a las necesidades de las personas que se encuentran buscando una nueva oportunidad profesional. La App de empleos de Tecoloco.com es la mejor opción para la búsqueda de ofertas de trabajo ya que te permitirá participar de los procesos de selección de una manera sencilla desde cualquier dispositivo móvil. Descarga la App de Empleos de Tecoloco.com y descubre las mejores oportunidades laborales en la región.

bluejetty:00038653:ios.description:
Descubre la nueva app de Primor, el destino favorito de los amantes de la belleza, los perfumes y el maquillaje. Compra tus marcas preferidas y entérate antes que nadie de las ofertas y últimos lanzamientos.
La app de Primor será tu nuevo imprescindible: más de 10.000 productos al alcance de tu mano con una experiencia de compra fácil, rápida y sin complicaciones. ¡Todo a un solo clic!
TU COMPRA BEAUTY, MÁS FÁCIL
• Explora un catálogo completo con maquillaje, skincare, perfumes, cosmética coreana, cuidado del cabello y tratamientos de las marcas más deseadas.
• Añade tus productos favoritos a tu lista de deseos y organiza tu compra.
• Consulta el estado de tus pedidos y sigue su progreso hasta la entrega.
• Accede a tu historial de compras y repite tus pedidos en un solo clic.
• Selecciona tu forma de pago preferida y recibe tu pedido cómodamente en casa.
VENTAJAS EXCLUSIVAS DE LA APP
• Disfruta de descuentos únicos solo disponibles para usuarios de la app.
• Recibe notificaciones personalizadas con ofertas, campañas y días especiales.
• Activa tu ubicación y descubre fácilmente tus tiendas Primor más cercanas.
MARCAS QUE AMAS, A UN CLIC DE DISTANCIA
• Descubre los productos las marcas más reconocidas: Dior, Armani, Carolina Herrera, Hugo Boss, Prada, Loewe, Calvin Klein, Kérastase, MAC, Urban Decay, Clarins, Yves Saint Laurent, Estée Lauder, Clinique, Kiehl's, Lancôme y muchas más.
• Explora las firmas que marcan tendencia y conquistan las redes: NYX, Cerave, The Ordinary, La Roche-Posay, Sol de Janeiro, Essence, L'Oréal París, Maybelline New York o Catrice y encuentra tus nuevos imprescindibles de belleza directamente desde la app.
TU MUNDO BEAUTY, SIEMPRE CONTIGO
Vive la belleza de una forma fácil, rápida y personalizada. Todo lo que te inspira, desde tus marcas favoritas hasta las mejores ofertas y las últimas tendencias, te espera en la app de Primor.

bluejetty:00034200:ios.name: Moonshades: Dark Fantasy RPG
bluejetty:00034200:ios.summary:
Moonshades is a dungeon crawler RPG to restore the immersive atmosphere and experience of the old-school role playing games.
Recall the fun of the genuine adventure games inspired by D&D - embedded in 3D surroundings with a deep, captivati
bluejetty:00034200:ios.description:
Moonshades is a dungeon crawler RPG to restore the immersive atmosphere and experience of the old-school role playing games.
Recall the fun of the genuine adventure games inspired by D&D - embedded in 3D surroundings with a deep, captivating story. Discover an enigmatic realm loaded with ancient magic and myths - grand legends are reborn as you venture into the epic journey!
The conquer's tale leads you beneath the ruined towns - toward grim, eerie dungeons and nesting monsters in the ghostly light. Some descendants of Harten still resist with all their might, enshrining the secrets of the ancestors' magic. Join the mission to bring the liberty and the radiant, lost wisdom back for these rich and mystic lands! The Crown's glory and treasures are buried, many kingdoms of darkness has invaded the realm, but the hope for changing the threads of the history has not been forlorn in the deepness of the dungeons. Finally, the reward for your efforts will be fabulous!
Essences of the Moonshades RPG:
- Mythic beasts and other fantasy creatures come to life in a massive, cryptic dungeon environment.
- Armour yourself for the battles, and find your best strategy to attack their enemies' weaknesses.
- The adventures provide you thousands of upgradable items (weapons, armors, accessories); use miraculous artifacts to make them stronger!
- Action and story-telling both play vital roles during achieving quests and puzzles.
- Fight in real-time combats for fabulous loots, magical items and otherworldly abilities!
- Learn plenty of devastating, protective or remedial spells & skills, and master the status effects for advance!
- Roam around the fantasy RPG realm, follow your insight, and keep an observing attitude - the help would arise sometimes by surprising sources to solve the riddles and puzzles - don't leave a path unexplored!
- Discover other wanderers traces; talk and trade with NPC's through your quests; search for meaningful hints to find out the puzzles. 
- Envision the fairy past by the haunting memories of the fallen heroes! Find the scrolls of Harten and Aesthirya to unearth legendary episodes from the greatest empires' history.
- Be aware of the crafty & deadly traps!
- Experiment the wonder of Magic Forge: make powerful potions, craft epic, legendary or even relic items, and enchant your gear!
- Dive into the challenge of Arcane Dungeon's grim labyrinth for marvelous treasures, when the hallowed Moons let you enter!
- Try your luck: dicey deals await you with the vendor of the bewitched chests.
Join the community: https://www.facebook.com/moonshadesgame/
Step into the teleport, and have a lots of fun in this nostalgic fantasy rpg!

bluejetty:00071056:ios.description:
We've all been home for a long time now. Your feet are itchy, you nervously google flights on skyscanner and accommodations on airbnb. You have it. The travel bug.
With travel restrictions in place it's not easy to travel for real, but you can still go on a virtual holiday! Enjoy Spain, Hawaii, Bali, Italy and many other exciting places and decorate beautiful homes along the way. As real estate agents and interior designers like to say: location, location, location. That's what successful home design is all about. Home design games don't have to be boring, With fun characters, interesting conversations and most of all luxurious home design your relaxation is only one click away!
Join the interior designers on a trip around the world, get a taste of local food, sights and create the perfect homes for your client's home away. This virtual holiday will let you design, relax and enjoy travel and home design like you never have before.
Play match 3 puzzle games to make money and use it to decorate dream homes and houses around the world. Can you satisfy your clients' taste and style and create extraordinary and unique home design?
Show off your home design skills now!

bluejetty:00042087:ios.name: Healthy Weight Loss - Welly
bluejetty:00042087:ios.summary:
Lose weight thanks to a conscious approach to your daily food intake and nutrition together with Welly!
The experienced crew of psychologists, nutritionists and personal coaches have developed a unique program for managing your eating habi
bluejetty:00042087:ios.description:
Lose weight thanks to a conscious approach to your daily food intake and nutrition together with Welly!
The experienced crew of psychologists, nutritionists and personal coaches have developed a unique program for managing your eating habits and nutrition and realized it in the Welly app.
APP TECHNOLOGY
 Trying to lose weight and stressed out? Can’t figure out why you can’t shed the pounds even after dieting?
Welly will help you understand yourself better with reflection and personal recommendations for relieving stress. The app will help you pinpoint your problem areas and come up with optimal solutions in order to combat extra weight. 
METHODOLOGY
In the app there are two principal methods connected to each other:
- Behavioral change. Welly helps you change your lifestyle and gives you step-by-step guidance to form healthy food habits.
- Portion method. It suggests consuming vegetables, carbohydrates, proteins and fats in particular portions. For instance, a fistful of veggies, a handful of carbohydrates, a palm of proteins and a thumb of fats.
FUNCTIONALITY
- 8-week personal plan of your daily diet for healthy weight loss.
- Your own menu made up from products in your fridge or food you can easily buy in any store in order to lose weight in a healthy way.
- Control the consumption of veggies, carbohydrates, proteins and fats in each portion to enrich your body with good microorganisms.
- Recommendations for a portion size and other components of a well-balanced diet.
- Water tracker that helps control the water balance in your body within a day.
- Step tracker that helps monitor your muscle toning exercises within a day.
- Academy – videos, articles and stories that help you learn more about healthy eating and get into balanced diet culture.
Welly uses Apple Health to automatically import your steps and give you accurate feedback and advice.
Welly knows everything about step-by-step weight loss and habit formation. You know everything about yourself. Together with Welly, you will achieve all desired results.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
If you choose a PREMIUM subscription in the app:
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription will be renewed automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase
Have any questions? 
Please contact us at support@getwelly.app
Terms of Use: https://getwelly.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getwelly.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00069953:ios.description:
Mobile Internet Provider For Traveling and Virtual Phone Numbers For SMS & Calls
eSIM Plus is the ultimate solution for your mobile internet needs, offering virtual phone numbers and a wide range of features. Powered by embedded SIM card (eSIM) technology, you can access the internet effortlessly, enjoy a secure and stable internet connection, and benefit from the widest global coverage. Say goodbye to the limitations of traditional physical SIM cards and embrace the next-generation solution: eSIM Plus!
Here’s why eSIM Plus is the best choice:
- Virtual Phone Number = second phone line
With eSIM Plus, you get a real online number for SMS, online calls, and service registration. No need for a second device or carrier – it’s built right into your account and works instantly, without changing SIM cards.
- Activate. Connect. Done.
Set up in seconds – just open the app, choose your destination or virtual number, and tap to activate. Pay as you go and subscribe to keep your plan active without a second thought – so your connection stays always stable.
Convenient payment options available for residents of any country – pay your way, wherever you are.
*Roaming charges? Not with us.
Need to call or text someone in another country? Just grab a virtual number from that region – eSIM Plus helps you avoid roaming fees with virtual calls and stay reachable, all from the same app.
Need internet on a trip? Land in a new country, open the app, and activate mobile data instantly without expensive roaming fees, SIM swaps, or stress.
- Switch Countries, Not eSIMs!
Choose a regional eSIM to cover multiple countries in one area, or go all-in with a global eSIM that includes an eSIM number and works across continents. You’ll get unlimited mobile data at local prices, plus an eSIM with phone number online – all without ever stepping into a store or dealing with confusing problems. 
- 24/7 Help & Support
We’re online, on call, and always connected – reach out anytime at support.esim@appvillis.com !

- Field Agent does not use information from submissions it denies
- Jobs are usually “first come, first serve”. The more often you check the app, the better your chances of making money!

bluejetty:00172085:ios.description:
Ulysses is your one-stop writing environment for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Its pleasant, focused writing experience, combined with effective document management, seamless sync, and flexible export, make Ulysses the first choice for writers of all kinds.
++ Apple Design Award Winner ++ 
“The app is amazing. An absolute delight to use. Well done.”
– David Hewson, Bestselling Author (The Killing)
### A Text Production Powerhouse
Ulysses’ markup-based, distraction-free editor lets you focus on your most important task: Write, edit, and write some more. Formatting is kept for later, so you can completely immerse yourself in the text. Ulysses’ uniquely streamlined toolset covers the entire writing process, and its clean and simple interface will boost your productivity. From first to final draft, from prologue to closing chapter – Ulysses keeps you in the flow, so you can get stuff done.
### All Your Texts, All the Time
Everything you’ll ever write is stored in Ulysses’ unified library. You can manage projects of all kinds and sizes, be it novels, diaries or study notes – they are always saved, and automatically in sync. And since Ulysses offers feature parity across macOS and iOS, it doesn’t matter where you are or when inspiration hits: All its tools, and all your texts, are always at your fingertips.
### Built-In Proofreader and Editing Assistant
Write with confidence, thanks to Ulysses’ integrated grammar and style check. Available for over 20 languages, it analyzes your text and offers informed suggestions for capitalization, punctuation, semantics, redundancy, style and more. 
### Create eBooks, DOCX, PDFs and HTML
Ulysses’ export is flexible enough to cover any writer’s needs: Transform your text into beautiful PDFs, Word documents or eBooks. Or export HTML code, ready to be used anywhere on the web. You can even choose between a variety of pre-made formatting styles for all kinds of purposes, or create your own and share it with other users.
### Publish to WordPress, Ghost, Substack & More
Do you blog? Ulysses’ offers best-in-class publishing to WordPress, Ghost, and Micro.blog. You can post to WordPress, Ghost and Micro.blog from right within the app – complete with images, tags, categories etc. All offer a built-in preview to proofread before submission. Ulysses also supports copy paste publishing to Substack and Basecamp.
### Pricing
Ulysses requires a subscription. We offer monthly and yearly subscription plans. They include a fully functional trial, so you can test Ulysses (including export and sync). There’s also a special discount for students.
All plans unlock the app on Mac, iPhone and iPad, and feature full synchronization.
### Questions
Please visit ulysses.app for more information. You can also reach us via help@ulysses.app or on Twitter @ulyssesapp – we’re happily awaiting your feedback!
Terms of Use: https://ulysses.app/app-terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://ulysses.app/app-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00091920:ios.summary:
Pool service software for the modern pool pro. Everything you need to run your pool service business, all in one app.™
Learn more: https://getskimmer.com
Watch demo video: https://getskimmer.com/Demo
Sign up: https://getskimmer.com/Account
bluejetty:00091920:ios.description:
Pool service software for the modern pool pro. Everything you need to run your pool service business, all in one app.™
Learn more: https://getskimmer.com
Watch demo video: https://getskimmer.com/Demo
Sign up: https://getskimmer.com/Account/Register
• Manage & Optimize Routes
• Manage Multiple Properties & Multiple Bodies of Water
• Create Work Orders (Both Repairs & Recurring Jobs)
• Work Online or Offline via Mobile App
• Easily Track & Enter Readings & Dosages
• Access Customer Service Histories
• Manage Customer Equipment
• Create General & Customized Checklists
• Manage Parts & Purchasing via Shopping List
• Provide Proof of Service Photos
• Deliver Beautiful Completed Service Emails
• Easily Generate Invoices and Bill Your Customers
• Produce Reports for Usage, Profit, Labor, Installed Items, and Dosages
• Send Bulk Emails to All or Some of the Customer Base
WORK ONLINE OR OFFLINE
Skimmer works the same whether you have an internet connection or not. You shouldn't have to think about it, and now you don't. Plus, it automatically syncs to the Cloud, so your data is always safe.
CUSTOMER INFO
With Skimmer, you always have the most up-to-date customer information with you. Track all your customers, each with the ability to have multiple locations and bodies of water. Always have up-to-date contact information, wherever you go.
ROUTE MANAGEMENT & OPTIMIZATION
Everything you need to customize and optimize routes, along with tracking all your service stop data. See your route on a map, along with distance and time to complete. Easily move stops to a different day or from one tech to another.
KNOW WHERE YOUR TECHS ARE
With just a glance you know where each and every tech is, when they started, and when they should finish for the day. With a simple tap, you can see their entire day’s route and service stop details, so you can manage and grow your business with more information than ever before.
SERVICE HISTORY
Easily see a pool’s entire service history. Color coding shows when a pool’s chemistry was out of range. Quickly find when parts were installed or the last time a checklist item was performed.
TRACK READINGS AND DOSAGES
Skimmer is the fastest way to enter all your readings and dosages. Review chemical history to identify issues before they happen. Track your chemical usage and costs by customer, location, or tech to ensure you’re charging enough. 
SHOPPING LIST
Ever forget to buy a part, or install it, or even bill for it? Skimmer tracks a part from the moment it's needed until the time it's billed for. So nothing ever gets forgotten. 
SERVICE EMAILS
Email your customers beautiful service reports automatically when you finish each route stop. Include proof of service photos along with chemical readings and dosages.
WORK ORDERS
Easily manage repairs, service calls, and even recurring items like filter cleans. Add customized checklists and tasks to different work order types. Then when you’re done, send an email report to your customers with photos and captions showing them what you did.
INVOICING
Say goodbye to spending hours processing invoices. No more wasting hours just to get paid. With Skimmer's invoice generation, you can do an entire month's billing in just five minutes!
REPORTING
Skimmer generates reports on all aspects of your service such as invoicing, profitability, labor, chemical dosages, and installed parts and products. Skimmer reports make it easy to forecast chemical needs and make rate adjustments for unprofitable customers.
BROADCAST EMAILS
Communicate to some or all of your customers with ease! Target customers by tag, service date, or route assignment to send messages, alerts, and promotions. Advise customers of incoming storms, service date changes, or service reminders for equipment in just a few clicks.
Get the Skimmer pool service app today!

bluejetty:00151842:ios.description:
Moot is an AI Decision Maker and AI assistant that helps you make clearer, faster, and more confident decisions.
Instead of receiving a single AI answer, Moot gives you something far more powerful: a full debate between five expert AI personas—each with their own perspective, strengths, and personalities.
You ask a question > The Council debates > You get clarity.
Whether you're facing a career dilemma, a relationship crossroads, or a personal challenge you can’t untangle alone, Moot helps you explore your options from every angle so you can make better life decisions.
Five AI advisors—The General, The Sage, The Skeptic, The Diplomat, and The Architect—examine your dilemma from completely different viewpoints. They disagree, challenge each other, synthesize ideas, and cast their final votes.
The result?
Deeper insight, stronger clarity, and decisions you can trust.
Perfect for:
- Career decisions
- Relationship decisions
- Starting a business
- Handling conflict
- Improving habits
- Ethical or moral dilemmas
- Any situation where you feel stuck or unsure
Moot turns confusion into confidence.- A New Way to Make Decisions
Why does Moot work?
Making decisions alone is overwhelming.
Getting advice from just one perspective is limiting.
But when you see multiple expert viewpoints collide, everything becomes clearer.
Moot helps you:
- Stop second-guessing yourself
- Understand hidden risks
- See opportunities you missed
- Balance logic with emotion
- Make better life decisions with confidence
- It’s like asking five mentors for help—instantly.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Moot Pro is required to start debates and access the full Council experience. Subscription options include monthly and yearly plans. Pricing may vary by region.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase
Privacy Policy: https://www.getmoot.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00179480:ios.summary:
Draft day is your moment. Sunday is too. Import your fantasy football league from Yahoo, ESPN, Sleeper, CBS, MyFantasyLeague, NFFC, and more, or enter your settings manually.
Every league is different. This app is Draft Dominator and Leagu
bluejetty:00179480:ios.description:
Draft day is your moment. Sunday is too. Import your fantasy football league from Yahoo, ESPN, Sleeper, CBS, MyFantasyLeague, NFFC, and more, or enter your settings manually.
Every league is different. This app is Draft Dominator and League Dominator together. Your scoring, roster, draft type, and keepers drive your Cheatsheet when you pick and your 5-Second Primer, Matchup, and Week Rankings when you set a lineup.
We're your guide. You make the calls. We help you make them with confidence.
HOW IT WORKS
Your league settings drive everything:
• Import or enter scoring, roster, draft order, and keepers • Get a Cheatsheet tailored to those settings • Use the same league for this week's 5-Second Primer, Matchup, and Week Rankings • Sync your live snake draft and track picks as they happen • Run mock drafts before the real thing • See pick suggestions that adjust as your roster fills in • Draft offline after your data syncs
Don't see your league host? Add your league manually and get the same customized advice.
LIVE DRAFT SYNC
Draft on your league site. Follow along in Draft Dominator.
• Connect your imported league and sync picks in real time • Your Cheatsheet and pick suggestions update after every pick • Stay on the best available players for your roster • Works on 13 hosts, including Sleeper, Yahoo, CBS Sports, MyFantasyLeague, Fantrax, Fleaflicker, NFFC, RT Sports, Underdog, Drafters, League Tycoon, Reality Sports Online, and DataForce
Live sync is for snake drafts. Salary cap (auction) drafts use manual pick entry, with league-tailored Cheatsheet rankings and auction values as players come off the board.
YOUR WEEK
• 5-Second Primer: every league on one screen, a recommended lineup, game status, and drag-to-reorder • Matchup: your lineup next to your opponent. Compare Footballguys Best vs your current lineup, with or without free agents, by position, stacks, kickoff time, and blocking FAs • Week Rankings: a weekly Cheatsheet with rank, matchup, points, floor, upside, form, expert columns, and filters. Team highlighting shows your roster and free agents • Tap a player for this week's projections, rankings, opponent, schedule, and expert comments
PRACTICE WITH MOCK DRAFTS
The best drafters don't wing it.
• Unlimited mocks built around your league settings, not a generic template • Customize how other teams draft for different personalities and strategies • Test snake and auction before draft day • See pick-by-pick grades as you go
Practice early-round builds, late-round value, zero RB, late QB, and stud-heavy auction budgets. When the real draft starts, you have already been there.
YOUR TOOLS
• Dynamic Cheatsheet and rankings that react to each pick • Pick suggestions with clear reasoning for your team • Watch List, Avoid List, player notes, and tiers • Depth Charts, ADP for your league, expert outlooks, and sleepers • In-draft trades, undo, and full draft board views • Rate My Team when you finish a real draft • Cloud sync so your leagues follow you across devices
BUILT FOR YOUR LEAGUE SETTINGS
• PPR, half-PPR, and custom scoring, including rules that differ by position • Snake and auction with custom draft and nomination order • Keepers, dynasty, and best ball • QB, RB, WR, TE, flex variants, PK, returners, and multi-flex • IDP (DL, LB, DB, and flexible IDP setups) • Distance scoring, yardage bonuses, and other custom rules • Roster mins and maxes by position, team count, and draft length
OFFLINE DRAFTING
Download projections, rankings, ADP, and expert analysis. Once synced, you can draft without Wi-Fi. Helpful in crowded draft rooms or anywhere signal is unreliable.
FROM THE CREATORS OF VALUE-BASED DRAFTING
Footballguys pioneered Value-Based Drafting (VBD). This app applies that to your league settings so you draft and set lineups with rankings and advice that fit your format, not a one-size-fits-all list.
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00129403:ios.name: EVO: Adapt and Dominate
bluejetty:00129403:ios.summary:
Have you ever dreamed of turning your cat or dog into a real fighting fantasy dragon? Then EVO is for you!
Natural selection in action, evolve!

bluejetty:00129403:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of turning your cat or dog into a real fighting fantasy dragon? Then EVO is for you!
Natural selection in action, evolve!
In the game EVO, you adapt your species to survive, and stay one step ahead of opponents. Choose your fantasy monster and go through the chain of evolution with him. Do you want to play as an electric cat? Or maybe a wolf or a skeleton? There are characters for every taste! Each monster has several stages of evolution, as well as additional improvements. Complete your collection and master the rich fantasy bestiary in its entirety. Can you make it to the end?
Survival of the fittest, choose your skills!
Enjoy a balanced game where your strategy will decide victory or defeat. Each game is an epic struggle for survival in the evolution game! The combat system looks simple, but its hard to master! At the start of the game, you get into a battle arena where you have to fight against other players and their monsters in pvp or pve mode. Feel the full experience of a multiplayer game - destroy all enemies and prove that you are the king of the hill! 
Evolution offers a variety of creatures to interact with each other, allowing a huge variety of strategies. When you finish off an enemy, you gain experience to reach new levels. When you level up, you are given one of 3 skills to choose from. It can be either a damage bonus or a special defense skill like heal, bonus HP or even invulnerability. Earn experience, level up and choose new skills to dominate the map. Use special science to get the apex of evolution. Come up with the perfect strategy for you and your fantasy monster, improve your abilities and defeat all enemies! 
Fight in different game modes, crush them all!
Fight with other players and go through the story campaign. In EVO you will find a lot of solo or multiplayer game modes. Win quick matches, build a squad for team fights, survive in knockout games, defeat a giant scary boss and find friends to fight together in a clan war. Entertainment for every taste! Raise your rank and stand at the top of not only the evolution chain, but also the rating ladder! Fight and win, it's all up to you!
Game Features:
- Evolve your fantasy monster
- Choose new skills to adapt
- Collect full bestiary
- Fight in different game modes in solo or multiplayer
- Win quick matches
- Pass the company
- Participate in clan war
- Defeat the giant boss
- Satisfying controls
- Easy and comfortable UI and player interfaces
- Addictive gameplay
- GET YOUR OWN DRAGON
Choose a character, upgrade and evolve in EVO. Fight in multiplayer against players from all over the world. Defeat bosses and take part in clan war. And most importantly, do it all COMPLETELY FREE. Download, play and turn your cat into a dragon! Do everything for evolution!

يضم فاذكروني كل ما يلزم المستخدم المسلم حيث يحتوي على القرآن الكريم، أوقات الصلاة ، اتجاه القبلة ،الأذكار والأوردة اليومية، التقويم الهجري، امساكية رمضان ودلي
bluejetty:00021125:ios.description:
}فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُواْ لِي وَلاَ تَكْفُرُونِ{ سورة البقرة /152
يضم فاذكروني كل ما يلزم المستخدم المسلم حيث يحتوي على القرآن الكريم، أوقات الصلاة ، اتجاه القبلة ،الأذكار والأوردة اليومية، التقويم الهجري، امساكية رمضان ودليل الحاج والمعتمر. 
ما يميز فاذكروني امكانية جدولة ختمة القرآن، حيث يمكنك اختيار عدد من الايام لختم المصحف الشريف ثم البدء بالقراءة، ليقوم التطبيق بحساب مستوى الانجاز يوميا وتذكيرك بالمدة المتبقية لانجاز ختمة القرآن بالاضافة الى امكانية تصحيح التقويم الهجري يدويا دون الحاجة الى انتظار تحديث التطبيق 
ما الجديد في تطبيق فاذكروني 
-عرض اوقات الصلاة والوقت المتبقي لدخول الصلاة التالية في مدينتك ، حيث يقوم فاذكروني بتحديد موقعك تلقائيا في أي مدينة كنت 
-قراءة القران الكريم،امكانية البحث عن آية محددة و نشر ايات مع الأصدقاء في فيسبوك وتويتر
-تذكير المستخدمين بقراءة أذكار الصباح والمساء وقراءة سورة الكهف في كل الجمعه 
-احياء سنة التكبير في العشر من ذي الحجة وسائر أيام التشريق، حيث يمكن للمستخدمين تفعيل التكبير بعد ادبار الصلوات 
تقبل الله منا ومنكم صالح الأعمال
fathkrony, the ultimate App any Muslim may need. featuring the full Quran with Arabic scripts, Prayers time according to your location, Qibla locator, an Islamic Hijri calendar, etc..
What’s Amazing in Fathkrony
•Accurate Prayer time calculator based on your current location, in addition to manual select of another city 
•Audio notifications for prayer time, with the ability to edit notification ringtone
•The Holy Quran, with the ability to schedule reading the Quran during selected number of days 
•Qibla compass to show you prayer direction to Kaaba 
•Hijrri calendar , and events list for Saudi Arabia
•prayers (Azkar) including multiple sections of azkar, such as: Morning Azkar, Evening Azkar, After Prayer Azkar and more, all prayers are based on the authorized book (Husn Al-Muslim)
•The remaining time for the next prayer, so you will never miss a prayer again 
What’s new in Fathkrony
•Search & Share any Aya in Quran with frinds on facebook and twitter 
•Reminder to read morning and evening Athkar, in addition to a reminder to read “Al Kahef” sora every Friday
•Automaticaly play Eid Takbeer after each prayer 
May Allah bless our prayers

bluejetty:00018377:ios.description:
SNBT Mobile puts your account information in the palm of your hand! Enjoy the convenience of managing your money 24/7 from virtually anywhere:
• Review your balance & transaction history
• Receive e-Alerts
• Transfer funds between SNBT accounts
• Schedule online bill payments
• Make loan payments 
• Make Person 2 Person payments
• Locate ATMs and SNBT offices
Our secure site and your password keep your private information safe and confidential. SNBT Mobile Banking is available to all SNBT personal banking customers who are enrolled in Bank Online. If you have questions please contact us at bankonline@snbt.com or 715-735-2356.
* Every mobile service carrier has a different rate plan for text messaging and data services access. You may be charged per use or pay a flat rate for unlimited usage each month. You may also have different fees for text messaging and data services access. Please contact your mobile carrier directly if you aren’t sure what fees you will be charged for using our mobile banking and text messaging services.
